name: Three Quarter Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Put your hands at the sides of your head with your elbows pointing toward your knees.
Tighten your abs and slowly curl your upper body up until it's almost upright.
Lower your upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A situp that stops about three quarters of the way up, just short of sitting fully upright. It works the abs, plus the front of the hips and the lower back.

name: 45 Degree Side Bend
instructions: Set up sideways on a 45-degree back extension bench: one hip against the pad, feet locked under the foot pads, body in a straight line.
Put your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out.
Bend sideways at the waist to lower your upper body toward the floor.
Lift back up, bending sideways until your upper body rises above the line of your legs. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side bend done lying on your side on a 45-degree back extension bench, hands behind your head. It works the abs, especially the obliques along the sides of your waist.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs off the floor with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Bring your right elbow toward your left knee as you straighten your right leg.
Switch sides, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee as you straighten your left leg. Keep alternating in a pedaling motion.
description: A crunch where you twist one elbow toward the opposite knee while your legs pedal in the air. It works the abs, especially the obliques at your sides, and the front of your hips.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold your arms straight by your sides, just off the floor.
Use your abs to lift your shoulders off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel by bending to the side.
Come back to the middle, then reach your left hand toward your left heel. Keep alternating sides.
description: A crunch-style move done on your back with your shoulders lifted, reaching side to side toward your heels. It works the abs, especially the obliques at your sides.

name: Single Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable pulley. Sit on the end of a flat bench below it, facing the cable, feet flat.
Reach up and grab the handle with one hand, palm facing away from you, arm straight.
Pull the handle straight down, bringing your elbow down to your side until your hand is level with your shoulder.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A lat pulldown done one arm at a time with a single cable handle while sitting on a bench. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and upper back.

name: Kneeling Chest Dip
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit you, then kneel on the pad and hold the handles with your palms facing down and your arms straight.
Lean your upper body forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip on an assisted machine, kneeling on a pad that takes some of your weight. Leaning forward makes it work the lower chest.

name: Assisted Close Neutral Grip Pullup
instructions: Set the assistance weight on an assisted pullup machine; more weight makes it easier. Kneel on the pad.
Grab the close parallel handles with your palms facing each other and start with your arms straight.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above your hands.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup on an assisted machine, kneeling on a pad that takes some of your weight, with your hands close and palms facing each other. It works the lats and biceps.

name: Assisted Pullup
instructions: Set the weight and height on the assisted pullup machine.
Grip the handles with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Kneel on the pad so your feet are off the floor, and hang with your arms straight.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the handles, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A pullup on a machine that takes some of your body weight, so it's easier than a full pullup. It works the lats, plus the biceps and forearms.

name: Kneeling Tricep Dip
instructions: Set the weight and height on the assisted dip machine.
Kneel on the pad facing the machine and hold the handles.
Bend your elbows to lower your body, keeping your back straight and upright, close to the machine.
Push yourself back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip on an assisted machine, kneeling on a pad that takes some of your weight. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Balance Board
instructions: Set a dome-shaped balance board on the floor, flat side up. Step on with both feet about hip-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hold your arms a little out from your sides.
Shift your weight onto one foot so that side of the board dips toward the floor.
Shift onto the other foot until the other side dips. Keep rocking slowly from side to side.
description: Balance work standing on a dome-shaped board with both feet, rocking it slowly from side to side. It works the quads, with the calves, hamstrings and glutes helping you stay steady.

name: Barbell Bench Front Squat
instructions: Stand just in front of a flat bench, facing away from it, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Rest a barbell across the front of your shoulders, just below your collarbone. Keep your elbows up and your upper arms level with the floor.
Bend your knees and hips to sit back and down until you're seated on the bench. Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A front squat where you sit down onto a bench at the bottom of each rep, with the bar resting on the front of your shoulders. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and hold it over your chest with your arms straight.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in toward your sides.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A press done lying on a flat bench, lowering a barbell to your chest and pushing it back up. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Bench Squat
instructions: Set a barbell in a squat rack at chest height, and place a flat bench behind where you'll stand.
Get under the bar so it rests across your upper back. Grip it with your palms facing forward, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back until the bench is just behind you, feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and hips to squat down until you touch the bench. Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat where you lower until you touch a bench behind you, so each rep reaches the same depth. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grip the barbell with your palms facing down, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar up to your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell row done bent forward at the hips, pulling the bar up to your lower chest. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Bend your knees and hips to grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Push through your heels and straighten your hips and knees to lift the bar off the floor, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar passes your thighs, drive your hips forward hard, shrug your shoulders and pull the bar up toward your chest.
Drop under the bar and catch it at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward and palms facing up.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight, then lower it back to the floor.
description: A barbell lift from the floor to your shoulders, then a press overhead. It works the quads and trains strength, power and coordination across your whole body.

name: Barbell Clean Grip Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Rest the barbell on your upper chest, fingers under the bar and elbows pointing forward and high.
Bend your knees and push your hips back, as if sitting back into a chair. Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A front squat with the barbell resting on your upper chest, fingers under the bar and elbows high. It works the glutes, plus the quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back against the bench.
Hold the barbell with your hands a little narrower than shoulder-width, and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A bench press with your hands closer together than usual and your elbows kept in near your body. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing forward.
Curl the bar up to shoulder level, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl, lifting a barbell from your thighs to your shoulders with your palms facing forward. It works the biceps.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to reach down. Grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you push through your heels and stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor by bending your hips and knees.
description: A barbell lift from the floor to standing, with your feet about shoulder-width apart. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads and your head lower than your hips.
Grip the bar with your palms facing your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack, then lower it slowly toward your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell press on a bench tilted so your head is lower than your hips. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Decline Close Grip to Skull Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Hold a barbell straight up over your chest with your hands close together.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, keeping your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms to press the bar back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps extension on a decline bench, hands close together, lowering the bar from over your chest to your forehead. It works the triceps.

name: Barbell Decline Wide Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads and your head lower than your hips.
Hold the barbell with your hands a little wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar to your chest, letting your elbows go out to the sides.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell press on a decline bench, head lower than your hips, with a wide grip. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you.
Pull your elbows back and curl the bar up, keeping it touching your body as it slides up your stomach.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest, with your elbows behind you.
Lower the bar slowly the same way until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell curl where you drag the bar up the front of your body and pull your elbows back, instead of swinging the bar out in an arc. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Barbell Front Chest Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the barbell against your upper chest with your hands shoulder-width apart and your elbows pointing forward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding the barbell in your hands against your upper chest. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and lift the bar forward and up until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs.
description: A standing raise, lifting a barbell with straight arms from your thighs to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the barbell across the front of your shoulders, against your collarbone, with your elbows raised in front so your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat with the barbell resting across the front of your shoulders instead of your back. It works the glutes, quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Rest the barbell across your upper back, just below your neck or a little lower.
Bend your knees and push your hips back and down, as if sitting into a chair.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor or slightly below, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat with the barbell across your upper back, going down until your thighs are level with the floor or lower. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Good Morning
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting across your upper back.
Keep your back straight and bend forward from your hips, pushing your hips back as if to touch a wall behind you.
Lower your upper body until it's level with the floor and you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward to stand back up.
description: A forward bend from the hips with a barbell across your upper back, keeping your back straight. It works the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the barbell behind your legs, resting it against the backs of your upper thighs.
Bend your knees and hips to lower your body, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding a barbell behind your legs instead of on your back. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie back on it with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack, then lower it slowly toward your chest, keeping your elbows at about 45 degrees from your sides.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell press done lying back on a bench set to 45 degrees. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Barbell Incline Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Lie face down with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell with your palms facing down, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar up toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell row done lying face down on a bench set to 45 degrees, pulling the bar up toward your chest. It works the upper back.

name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Sit on an incline bench in a rack, set to about 45 degrees. Grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing your feet.
Lift the bar off the rack and hold it straight above your shoulders, arms straight, shoulders resting back on the bench.
Keeping your arms straight, reach your shoulders up toward the ceiling to push the bar a few inches higher.
Lower slowly until your shoulders rest back on the bench.
description: A short straight-arm push on an incline bench where only your shoulders move the bar. It works the muscles along the sides of your ribs (serratus), plus the shoulders and upper back.

name: Barbell Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell across your upper back.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to squat down.
Jump up hard from the bottom, straightening your hips, knees and ankles and pushing off through your toes.
Land softly back into a squat and go straight into the next jump.
description: A squat that ends in a jump off the floor, with a barbell across your upper back. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves, and builds leg power.

name: Barbell Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting across your upper back.
Step forward with your right foot, keeping your upper body upright.
Bend your right knee to lower your body until your right thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your right heel to step back to standing, then lunge with your left leg. Keep alternating legs.
description: A forward lunge with a barbell across your upper back, alternating legs. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a flat bench and a loaded barbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about shoulder-width apart, knees bent. Hold the bar with your hands just outside your hips, palms facing down.
Push through your feet and drive your hips up until your body is level from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips slowly until they are just above the floor.
description: A hip lift with your upper back on a bench and a barbell across your hips. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and quads.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at the end and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the barbell straight up over your chest, hands shoulder-width apart and palms facing your feet.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly past your forehead to behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift the bar back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps exercise on a flat bench, bending your elbows to lower a barbell behind your head, then straightening them. It works the triceps.

name: Barbell Narrow Stance Squat
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with your feet about hip-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Keep your chest up as you bend your knees and push your hips back to lower yourself.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor or slightly below.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A barbell back squat with your feet closer together than usual, about hip-width apart. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Single Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Load one end of a barbell and leave the other end on the floor. Stand beside the bar, feet hip-width apart, with the loaded end just in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with a flat back. Grab the bar just behind the plates with one hand, palm facing in toward your body.
Pull the loaded end up toward your chest, driving your elbow up and back.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm row where one end of the barbell stays on the floor and you row the loaded end up beside your body. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Barbell Single Arm Side Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at your side in one hand, palm facing your leg.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the bar along the outside of your leg, keeping your arm straight and your chest up.
Go as low as you can while keeping your back straight.
Stand back up. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A deadlift with the barbell held in one hand at your side. It works the glutes, hamstrings, quads and lower back, and your core has to keep you from leaning.

name: Barbell Single Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand over a barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out.
Squat down with your back straight and chest up, and grip the middle of the bar with one hand, palm facing you.
Drive up hard through your hips, knees and ankles, then pull the bar up past your chest, keeping it close to your body.
Flip your elbow under the bar and punch your arm straight overhead, dropping into a squat to catch it.
Stand up with your arm locked straight, then lower the bar to the floor under control. Do all your reps, then switch arms.
description: An explosive one-arm lift that takes a barbell from the floor to straight overhead in one move, catching it in a squat. It works the shoulders, with the legs, hips and upper back driving the pull.

name: Barbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the barbell overhead with your hands wide apart and your arms straight.
Squat all the way down, pushing your hips back. Keep your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding a barbell overhead with straight arms and a wide grip. It works the quads, and it takes balance and flexible shoulders to keep the bar steady.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the slanted pad and your chest against it.
Grip the barbell with your palms facing up, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell curl done with your upper arms resting on a slanted pad, which keeps them from swinging. It works the biceps.

name: Barbell Press Situp
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads at the high end.
Hold a barbell on your chest, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing your feet.
Sit all the way up and press the bar overhead as you rise, until you're upright with your arms straight above your head.
Lower slowly back down, bringing the bar back to your chest as you lie back.
description: A situp on a decline bench where you press a barbell from your chest to straight overhead as you sit up. It works the abs, with the shoulders doing the press.

name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie face down on it, with your chest and stomach against the pad.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward, hands shoulder-width apart, arms hanging straight toward the floor.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up to shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell curl done lying face down on an incline bench, which stops you from swinging the weight. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Barbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your knees bent and your feet up on the bench.
Hold a barbell with your hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Bring the bar back up over your chest along the same arc.
description: A straight-arm move lying on a bench, lowering a barbell in an arc behind your head and back up. It works the lats, with help from the chest and triceps.

name: Barbell Rack Pull
instructions: Set a barbell on the pins of a power rack at knee height. Stand at the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Bend at your hips and knees to grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Straighten your hips and knees to stand up with the bar, pulling your shoulders back at the top.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the bar back to the pins.
description: A partial deadlift that starts from a power rack, with the bar at about knee height. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Take a barbell from a rack set just below hip height and hold it behind your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing back. Stand tall.
Keeping your chest up, bend your elbows out to the sides and lift the bar up the backs of your legs to about waist height.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A raise done standing tall with the barbell behind you, lifting it up the backs of your legs by bending your elbows out to the sides. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent, holding a barbell with your palms facing your thighs and your hands wide apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Pull the bar up to your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over barbell row with a wide grip, pulling the bar to your chest. It works the backs of the shoulders, plus the upper back and biceps.

name: Barbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting across your upper back.
Step back with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Bend both knees to lower your body until your left thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your left heel to bring your right foot back to standing.
Do the same stepping back with your left foot.
description: A reverse lunge, stepping backward with a barbell across your upper back. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with your palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up to shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell curl with your palms facing down instead of up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Barbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your arms straight down, holding a barbell with your palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up to shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A preacher curl with your palms facing down, done on a bench with a slanted arm pad. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and hold a barbell with your palms facing down.
Lean forward and rest your forearms on the bench, with your wrists hanging off the end.
Keep your forearms still and bend your wrists to lift the barbell as high as you can.
Lower the barbell slowly until your wrists hang down again.
description: A wrist curl with your palms facing down, lifting the bar by bending your wrists back. It works the muscles on top of your forearms.

name: Barbell Rollout From Bench
instructions: Kneel on the end of a flat bench, lower legs along it, with a loaded barbell on the floor in front of the bench.
Lean forward and grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing down, arms straight under your shoulders.
Roll the bar forward until your arms are stretched out in front and your body is nearly straight. Don't let your lower back sag.
Roll the bar back slowly until it is under your shoulders again.
description: An ab rollout with your knees up on a bench and a barbell rolling on the floor below you. It works the abs, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Barbell Rollout
instructions: Kneel behind a barbell on the floor and hold it with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Roll the barbell forward, reaching your arms out in front of you and keeping your abs tight.
Keep rolling until your body is fully stretched out and your arms are overhead.
Roll the barbell slowly back toward your knees.
description: A hard kneeling ab exercise that rolls a barbell forward until your body is stretched out long, then back again. It works the abs and also the lower back.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward. Hold a barbell with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips with your knees slightly bent, keeping your back straight.
Lower the bar toward the floor, keeping it close to your legs, until you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Push your hips forward to stand back up straight.
description: A barbell lift where you bend at the hips with your knees slightly bent, lowering the bar until the backs of your thighs stretch. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Rest a barbell across your thighs, just above your knees, and hold it steady with both hands.
Keep your back straight and lift your heels as high as you can, rising onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
description: A calf raise done sitting on a bench, with a barbell across your thighs for weight. It works the calves.

name: Barbell Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lean forward and rest your upper arms against your inner thighs, just above your knees, letting the bar hang in front of you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated barbell curl done leaning forward with your upper arms braced against your inner thighs, which stops them from swinging. It works the biceps.

name: Barbell Seated Good Morning
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting across your upper back.
Lean forward from your hips, lowering your torso toward the floor. Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Push through your heels to bring your torso back up until you're sitting tall.
description: A good morning done sitting on a bench: with a barbell on your upper back, lean forward from the hips, then sit back up. It works the glutes, plus the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell with your palms facing forward, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Lift it off the rack to shoulder level, elbows bent.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar slowly back to shoulder level.
description: A barbell press from your shoulders to overhead, done sitting on a bench. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Barbell Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward, hands shoulder-width apart, and raise it overhead.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your head.
Straighten your arms to raise the bar back overhead.
description: A seated triceps exercise, lowering a barbell behind your head and straightening your elbows to lift it back up. It works the triceps, with some help from the shoulders.

name: Barbell Seated Twist
instructions: Sit on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor. Rest a barbell across the back of your shoulders, hands wide, palms facing forward.
Keeping your hips and knees facing forward, turn your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Turn back through the middle and on to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated twist with a barbell across the back of your shoulders. It works the abs, especially the obliques along your sides.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your hips with your palms facing you.
Keep your arms and back straight the whole time.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears as high as you can.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug with a barbell held in front of your hips, lifting your shoulders toward your ears. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Barbell Side Split Squat
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back, hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward. Set your feet about twice shoulder-width apart, toes out a little.
Bend one knee and shift your hips toward that side, keeping the other leg straight, until the bent thigh is nearly level with the floor.
Stay low and shift across to the other side, straightening the first leg as you bend the other knee.
Keep alternating sides without standing up in between, with the bent knee pointing over your toes.
description: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back, shifting your weight from one bent leg to the other while the opposite leg stays straight. It works the quads and glutes.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back, hands just wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Stand a stride in front of a flat bench, facing away from it. Reach one foot back and rest the top of it on the bench.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is about level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat with a barbell on your back and your rear foot raised on a bench. It works the quads and glutes of the front leg.

name: Barbell Skier
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing your legs.
Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, back flat, so your arms hang straight down in front of your knees.
Keep your arms straight and swing the bar back past your hips as far as you can.
Swing it back down slowly until your arms hang straight again.
description: A bent-over barbell move where straight arms swing back past your hips, like pushing off with ski poles. It works the shoulders and triceps.

name: Barbell Standing Ab Rollout
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, bend forward, and hold a barbell on the floor in front of your feet with both hands.
Keeping your arms and back straight, roll the bar forward slowly until you're in a pushup position, hands under your shoulders.
Pull the bar back toward your feet with your abs until you're bent over again.
description: An advanced rollout done on your feet instead of your knees, rolling a barbell out until your body is stretched long and pulling it back. It works the abs, with help from the shoulders and lower back.

name: Barbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell behind your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing behind you.
Let your arms hang straight and keep them still.
Curl your wrists to lift the bar up and back, away from your legs.
Lower the bar slowly back to the start.
description: A wrist curl done standing with the barbell held behind your thighs, palms facing back. It works the forearms.

name: Barbell Standing Close Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with your palms facing forward and your hands close together.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms still.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing barbell curl with your hands close together and palms facing forward. It works the biceps, with the forearms helping.

name: Barbell Standing Front Raise Over Head
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight and your body still, raise the bar in front of you until it's straight above your head.
Lower slowly along the same path until the bar is back at your thighs.
description: A front raise that keeps going past shoulder height until the bar is straight overhead, arms straight the whole way. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on a step platform with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels as high as you can, using your calves.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A standing calf raise with a barbell across your upper back, done on a step platform. It works the calves.

name: Barbell Standing Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a barbell overhead with your arms straight and your palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly behind your head.
Straighten your arms to raise the bar back overhead.
description: A standing triceps exercise, lowering a barbell behind your head and straightening your arms to lift it back up. It works the triceps.

name: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell across your upper back, holding it with both hands.
Raise your heels as high as you can, balancing on the balls of your feet. Let your body rock slightly forward as you rise.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor, rocking slightly back.
description: A standing calf raise with a barbell across your upper back, rocking your body slightly forward and back as you rise and lower. It works the calves.

name: Barbell Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders. Rest a barbell across your upper back, hands wide, palms facing forward.
Keep your hips and feet facing forward and twist your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Turn slowly back to the center. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing twist with a barbell across your upper back, turning your shoulders while your hips stay still. It works the abs, especially the obliques along your sides.

name: Barbell Stepup
instructions: Stand facing a flat bench with a barbell resting across your upper back.
Put one whole foot flat on the bench.
Push through that heel to step up onto the bench, straightening your hip and knee.
Step back down to the floor, then step up with the other leg. Keep alternating legs.
description: A step-up onto a flat bench with a barbell across your upper back, alternating legs. It works the glutes, plus the quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Stiff Leg Good Morning
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Rest a barbell across your upper back, just below your neck.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward, keeping your back straight.
Lower until your torso is level with the floor and you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to stand back up tall.
description: A good morning with your legs nearly straight: lean forward from the hips with a barbell on your upper back until your torso is level with the floor. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward. Hold a barbell with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips to lower the bar toward the floor, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Use the backs of your thighs and your glutes to lift the bar and stand back up.
description: A deadlift where you bend at the hips with your knees only slightly bent, lowering the bar toward the floor. It works the hamstrings, plus the glutes and lower back.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing out, and a barbell on the floor centered between your feet.
Bend your knees and lower your hips to grip the bar with your palms facing you, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Push through your heels to lift the bar, straightening your hips and knees together and pushing your hips forward as you stand.
Lower the bar slowly back to the floor.
description: A deadlift with a wide stance and toes pointed out, lifting a barbell from the floor to standing. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings, quads and lower back.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward (away from your legs).
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with a flat back, arms hanging straight.
Pull the bar up to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over barbell row with your palms facing forward instead of toward your legs. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Let a barbell hang in front of your thighs, palms facing you, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows. Keep your back straight.
Lower the bar slowly back to your thighs.
description: A standing lift, pulling a barbell straight up the front of your body to your chin, elbows leading. It works the sides of the shoulders, plus the traps and biceps.

name: Barbell Wide Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands wide apart, wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the rack and hold it over your chest with your arms straight.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, letting your elbows flare out slightly.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A flat bench press with your hands set wide on the bar. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Barbell Wide Grip Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing you, hands wider than shoulder-width and arms straight.
Lift the bar straight up toward your chin until it reaches your upper chest, leading with your elbows. Keep your back straight.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: An upright row with your hands set wide, lifting a barbell from your thighs to your upper chest with your elbows leading. It works the sides of the shoulders, plus the upper back and biceps.

name: Barbell Wide Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Rest the barbell across your upper back, just below your neck or a little lower.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat with your feet set wider than shoulder-width. It works the quads, plus the glutes, hamstrings and calves.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with your palms facing up and rest your forearms along a flat bench, wrists just past its end.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingertips.
Curl the bar back up by bending your wrists toward you as far as they go.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A barbell wrist curl with your forearms resting along a bench and palms facing up. It works the forearm muscles that bend your wrist.

name: Barbell Zercher Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Hold the barbell in the inside bend of your elbows, with your hands gripping the bar to keep it steady.
Push your hips back and down to squat, keeping your chest up and your knees in line with your toes.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding the barbell in the bend of your elbows, in front of your body. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings, calves and abs.

name: Bench Kickback
instructions: Kneel on one knee near the end of a flat bench and put both hands on the bench in front of you, arms straight.
Let your other leg hang down beside the bench, knee bent, foot near the floor.
Keep your back flat and kick that leg back and up until it's straight and level with your body.
Lower it slowly back down beside the bench. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A glute kickback done kneeling on a flat bench, kicking one straight leg back and up. It works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Narrow Reverse Grip Inverted Row
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar at about hip height and lie on your back underneath it.
Grip the bar with your hands a little closer than shoulder-width, palms facing toward your face.
Straighten your legs with your heels on the floor and hang with your arms straight, body in a line from heels to shoulders.
Pull your chest up to the bar, keeping your body straight.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under a low bar, pulling your chest up with a narrow grip and your palms facing you. It works the upper back, with the biceps and forearms helping.

name: Cable Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand between two low cable pulleys with your feet shoulder-width apart and a handle in each hand.
Bring the handles up to shoulder height, palms facing forward. Keep your back straight.
Press one handle up and forward until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to shoulder height, then press the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing shoulder press between two low cables, pressing one handle overhead at a time while the other waits at your shoulder. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Cable Single Arm Tricep Extension
instructions: Set a cable pulley at the bottom of the machine and attach a single handle. Stand with your back to the machine.
Hold the handle in one hand behind your head, palm facing forward, elbow bent and pointing up. Hold that upper arm steady with your other hand.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow to push the handle straight up overhead.
Bend your elbow slowly to lower the handle behind your head. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm triceps extension done overhead, with a low cable pulling from behind you. It works the triceps.

name: Cable Crossover Reverse Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys of a cable crossover station at the bottom with a single handle on each. Stand in the middle, feet hip-width apart.
Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, palms facing your legs.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with your back flat, letting your hands hang together in front of your shins.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they're level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your hands meet in front of your shins again.
description: A rear fly done bent forward between two low cables, each hand holding the cable from the opposite side. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Cable Deadlift
instructions: Attach a handle to each low pulley. Stand between them with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to squat down, and grab a handle in each hand, palms facing you. Keep your arms straight and your shoulders back.
Stand up by straightening your hips and knees until you're upright.
Lower the handles slowly back down the same way.
description: A deadlift done with two low cable handles instead of a barbell, starting from a squat. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings, quads and lower back.

name: Cable Floor Seated Wide Grip Row
instructions: Attach a long straight bar to the low pulley. Sit on the floor facing the machine, legs straight and feet against its base.
Hold the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing down, and sit up tall with your arms straight.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, letting your elbows flare out to the sides.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A cable row done sitting on the floor with a long bar, hands wide and elbows out to the sides. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your back to a low pulley, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, so the cable runs between your legs.
Hold the handle in one hand, arm straight and in front of your thigh.
Keep your arm straight and raise the handle in front of you to shoulder height, palm facing down.
Lower it slowly back in front of your thigh.
description: A one-arm front raise, lifting a low cable handle from your thigh to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley. Stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing each other (thumbs up), arms straight.
Keeping your upper arms still, curl the rope up until your hands reach shoulder level.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A hammer curl on a low cable with a rope, palms facing each other throughout. It works the biceps and forearms, and the cable keeps tension on them the whole way.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
instructions: Strap the ankle nearer the machine into a cuff on a low pulley. Stand side-on to the machine, a step or two away.
Rest your near hand flat on the machine for balance and let the cable pull your cuffed leg out toward it.
Keeping the leg straight, sweep it across in front of your standing leg as far as you can.
Return slowly until the leg is back out to the side. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing cable move where you sweep one leg across your body against a low cable strapped to your ankle. It works the inner thighs.

name: Cable Incline Bench Pullover
instructions: Set an incline bench to about 60 degrees with its backrest toward a high pulley with a straight bar attached. Sit back, feet flat.
Reach up and grip the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you, arms straight overhead.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the bar down and forward in an arc until your arms point straight ahead at shoulder height.
Let the bar rise slowly back overhead, keeping your arms straight the whole time.
description: A straight-arm pullover done sitting back on an incline bench, pulling a high cable bar from overhead to straight out in front of you. It works the lats, with help from the triceps, rear shoulders and chest.

name: Cable Judo Flip
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley set at about head height. Stand facing away from the machine, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope over one shoulder and hold both ends by your chin, palms facing you, elbows in front of your chest.
Keeping your hands by your chin, bend forward at the waist and crunch down until your upper body is about level with the floor.
Rise slowly back to standing. Do all your reps with the rope over one shoulder, then switch shoulders.
description: A standing crunch facing away from a cable, with a rope pulled over one shoulder as you bend forward. It works the abs, with help from the obliques.

name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope with both hands and pull it down so your hands sit beside your head.
Keeping your hips still, round your back and crunch your chest down toward your thighs.
Rise slowly back to the start.
description: A crunch done kneeling at a cable machine, pulling a rope down as you curl your chest toward your thighs. It works the abs, with help from the obliques.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set both pulleys of a cable machine at the bottom. Stand between them with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left so the cables cross, palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and raise them out to the sides until they're level with the floor.
Lower your arms slowly back down.
description: A lateral raise with two low cables, crossed so each hand holds the opposite one, lifting your arms out to shoulder height. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Cable Incline Fly
instructions: Attach handles to both low pulleys. Stand in the middle of the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a handle in each hand, arms down and slightly out to your sides, palms facing forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms forward and up until your hands meet in front of your chest.
Lower your arms slowly back down to your sides, keeping the slight bend in your elbows.
description: A standing cable fly that sweeps your arms from low at your sides up to chest height, with no bench. It works the upper chest.

name: Cable Low Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the straight bar with your palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the bar go back slowly until your elbows are only slightly bent.
description: A seated cable row from a low pulley, pulling a straight bar to your lower chest. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Middle Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys of a cable machine at chest height. Stand in the middle with one foot slightly in front of the other.
Hold a handle in each hand with your arms out to the sides and your palms facing forward.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and lean forward slightly.
Bring your arms forward in a wide arc until your hands come together in front of you.
Open your arms slowly back out to the sides.
description: A standing cable fly with the pulleys at chest height, sweeping your arms together in front of you. It works the chest, with some help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Cable Single Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable pulley and stand facing it with one foot in front of the other.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Grab the handle with one hand, palm facing in toward your body, arm straight.
Pull the handle toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Straighten your arm slowly. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm cable row from a low pulley, leaning forward with one foot in front of the other. It works the upper back.

name: Cable Single Arm Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a single handle in one hand, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow at your side and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm curl with a single handle on a low cable pulley, which keeps the muscle working through the whole lift. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand side-on to the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle in your far hand in front of your hips, the cable crossing your body. Put your other hand on your hip.
Keeping your arm straight, raise it out to the side, palm facing down, until it's level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly back across your body. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm side raise with a low cable that runs across the front of your body. It works the side of the shoulder.

name: Cable Single Arm Kneeling High Row
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley. Kneel facing the machine and sit back on your heels.
Grab the handle with one hand, palm facing you, with that arm stretched up toward the pulley.
Keep your upper body tall and pull the handle down until your hand is in front of your shoulder and your elbow is at your side.
Let your arm rise slowly back toward the pulley until it's straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm cable pull done kneeling, bringing a handle down from a high pulley to the front of your shoulder. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
instructions: Attach a bar to a low pulley and set the preacher pad at chest height in front of it.
Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grip the bar with your palms facing up. Keep your back straight and your elbows in.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A preacher-bench curl using a low cable, so your upper arms stay fixed on the pad and the cable pulls the whole way. It works the biceps.

name: Cable Pull Through
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley with a rope attachment, feet shoulder-width apart. Reach between your legs and hold the rope with both hands.
Step forward until the cable is tight.
Push your hips back and lower your upper body until it's level with the floor, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to pull yourself back up to standing.
description: A cable exercise where you bend forward from the hips with a rope between your legs, then stand back up tall. It works the glutes, plus the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a long straight bar to a high pulley. Sit on the bench facing the machine, feet flat on the floor and knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly with your chest up and a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated pulldown, pulling a long bar from a high cable down to your upper chest. It works the lats, plus the biceps, upper back and backs of the shoulders.

name: Cable Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope with your palms facing each other and your elbows tucked in at your sides.
Push the rope down until your arms are straight, keeping your upper arms still.
Let your elbows bend slowly as the rope rises back up.
description: A triceps pushdown with a rope on a high cable, straightening your arms while your elbows stay at your sides. It works the triceps, with some help from the forearms.

name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides and push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let the bar rise slowly back up, keeping your upper arms still.
description: A standing cable exercise, pushing a short bar down from a high pulley by straightening your elbows. It works the triceps.

name: Cable Rear Delt Row
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley of a seated row machine. Sit with your feet on the foot plates, knees slightly bent.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing down and sit up tall, arms straight out in front at chest height.
Pull the rope toward your face, lifting your elbows high and out to the sides, until your hands are beside your face.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated cable row pulled up to your face with your elbows high and wide. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Cable Reverse Grip Pulldown
instructions: Attach a bar to the high pulley. Sit facing the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach up and grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing you, arms straight overhead.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, keeping your back straight and drawing your shoulder blades back and down.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead again.
description: A pulldown done sitting, pulling a bar from overhead down to your upper chest with your palms facing you. It works the upper back and lats, with extra help from the biceps.

name: Cable Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a short bent (EZ) bar. Rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing down, and start with your arms straight down the pad.
Curl the bar up toward your chin, keeping your upper arms on the pad and your palms facing down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A preacher curl on a low cable with your palms facing down instead of up. It works the biceps and puts more of the load on the forearms.

name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a bar to a low pulley and sit on a bench facing the machine.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down. Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists hanging past your knees.
Keep your forearms still and bend your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower your hands slowly back down.
description: A seated wrist exercise with a low cable, lifting the backs of your hands up with your palms facing down. It works the forearms.

name: Cable Seated Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Sit on a bench with your back to the machine, feet flat on the floor and knees bent.
Hold the rope with both hands behind your head.
Tighten your abs and slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest toward your knees.
Uncurl slowly back to upright.
description: A crunch done sitting with your back to a high cable, curling forward against a rope held behind your head. It works the abs, plus the obliques.

name: Cable Seated Single Arm Alternate Row
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and sit on a flat bench facing it, feet flat and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle with one hand, arm straight out in front of you.
Pull the handle toward your body, keeping your elbow close to your side and drawing your shoulder blade back.
Straighten your arm slowly, then row with the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated one-arm cable row from chest height, switching arms each rep. It works the upper back, especially the muscles that pull your shoulder blades together.

name: Cable Seated Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench placed between two low pulleys, one on each side, with your feet flat on the floor.
Lean forward until your chest rests over your thighs.
Hold the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left, arms hanging by your ankles, palms facing back.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they're level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your hands are back by your ankles.
description: A rear raise done sitting on the end of a bench, bent forward, with each hand pulling the low cable from the opposite side. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Internal Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Attach a single handle to a cable pulley set low, at about the height of your elbow when you sit on the floor.
Sit on the floor side-on to the machine, legs straight out in front and back upright.
Hold the handle in the hand nearer the machine, palm facing forward, thumb up. Bend that elbow 90 degrees and tuck it against your side.
Keep your elbow at your side and swing your forearm in across your belly until your palm faces your stomach.
Let it swing back out slowly toward the machine. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A seated cable move that swings the forearm in across your belly while the elbow stays pinned to your side. It works the front of the shoulder and the small muscles that steady the joint.

name: Cable Seated Wide Grip Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row, feet on the footrests and knees slightly bent. Hold the wide bar with your palms facing down.
Lean slightly forward from your hips with your back straight.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, elbows flared out to the sides, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let the bar move slowly forward until your arms are straight.
description: A seated cable row with a wide bar, pulled to your lower chest with your elbows out to the sides. It works the upper back.

name: Cable Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your back to the cable machine, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a handle from each low pulley.
Bring the handles up to shoulder height, palms facing forward and elbows bent and pointing out to the sides.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
description: A standing overhead press using two low cable handles. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Cable Shrug
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing you, arms hanging straight in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug with a straight bar on a low cable, lifting your shoulders toward your ears. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Cable Side Bend
instructions: Set a handle on the low pulley. Stand side-on to the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handle in the hand nearest the machine.
Rest your other hand on your hip and keep your back straight.
Bend sideways at the waist toward the machine, letting the handle lower toward your knee.
Pull yourself back up and lean slightly away from the machine, using the side of your waist.
Do all your reps on one side, then turn around and switch hands.
description: A standing side bend against a low cable, holding the handle in one hand. It works the abs, especially the obliques at the side of your waist.

name: Cable Side Crunch
instructions: Set a pulley at its highest point with a single handle. Stand side-on, right next to the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle beside your ear with your near hand, palm facing forward. Let your other arm hang at your side.
Keeping your hand by your head, bend sideways toward the machine, pulling your elbow down toward your hip.
Rise slowly back to upright. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing side bend against a high cable, holding the handle by your head and crunching down toward the machine. It works the abs, especially the obliques on the side nearest the cable.

name: Cable Standing Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley. Stand with your back to the machine, holding the bar behind your thighs, palms facing back.
Keep your arms straight and your hands about hip-width apart. Let your wrists bend down so the bar hangs low.
Curl your wrists to lift the bar up and back as far as you can, keeping your arms still.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A wrist curl done standing, holding a low cable bar behind your thighs with your palms facing back. It works the forearms.

name: Cable Standing Kickback
instructions: Strap one ankle into a cuff on a low pulley. Face the machine and rest both hands flat on the frame at about head height.
Stand on the other leg, knee slightly bent, and lean forward a little.
Kick the cuffed leg straight back as far as you can without arching your lower back.
Return slowly until your feet are together. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing kickback against a low cable strapped to your ankle, pushing one leg straight back. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings.

name: Cable Standing Lift
instructions: Set a pulley low and stand side-on to the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle with both hands beside the hip nearest the machine, arms straight.
Keep your back straight and lift the handle up across your body to above your far shoulder, turning your torso.
Lower it slowly back to your hip. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A cable move that lifts a low handle up and across your body in a diagonal line, using both hands. It works the abs and obliques, with help from the lower back.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a pulley set at about shoulder height. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, and step back until your arms are straight and the cable is tight.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and out to the sides, drawing your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A rope pull on a cable machine, drawing the rope toward your face with your elbows high. It works the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Cable External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Set a cable pulley at elbow height, attach a single handle, and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the handle in the hand farther from the machine, palm facing your stomach, thumb up.
Bend that elbow 90 degrees and tuck it against your side, forearm across your belly.
Keep your elbow at your side and swing your forearm out, away from the machine, until your hand points out to the side.
Let it come back slowly across your belly. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A standing cable move that swings the forearm outward while the elbow stays pinned to your side. It works the rear shoulders and the small muscles that steady the joint.

name: Cable Standing Twist Row
instructions: Attach a V-bar to a pulley at chest height and stand facing it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with both hands, palms facing down, and step back until the cable is tight and your arms are straight.
Keeping your back straight, pull the bar toward your torso and twist your upper body to one side as you pull.
Return slowly, untwisting until your arms are straight.
Twist to the other side on the next rep. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing cable row with a twist: as you pull the bar in, you turn your upper body to one side. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps, shoulders and obliques.

name: Cable Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley. Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down and your arms straight.
Keep your arms straight and pull the bar down to your thighs.
Let the bar rise slowly back up without bending your elbows.
description: A standing cable pulldown with straight arms, sweeping a bar from a high pulley down to your thighs. It works the lats.

name: Cable Straight Back Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the V-shaped handle with your palms facing each other. Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from your hips.
Pull the handle toward your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the handle go back slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated cable row with a V-shaped handle, pulling it toward your body with your back kept straight. It works the upper back, plus the biceps, forearms and shoulders.

name: Cable Twist
instructions: Set a pulley at chest height and stand side-on to the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle with both hands, arms almost straight and pointing toward the machine at chest height.
Twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body.
Turn slowly back toward the machine. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing twist against a chest-height cable, turning your torso with your arms held out in front. It works the abs, especially the obliques at your sides.

name: Cable Twisting Pull
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley. Hold it in one hand and step back from the machine until your arm is straight.
Take a wide split stance, one foot well behind the other, and bend forward at the hips with your back straight.
Pull the handle toward your body, twisting your torso as you pull.
Return slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps with one hand, then switch hands.
description: A one-arm cable row from a bent-forward split stance, with a twist of the torso as you pull. It works the lats, with help from the shoulders and biceps.

name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley with a bar attached, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing you.
Keep your back straight and pull the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: An upright row with a bar on a low cable pulley, pulled from your thighs up to your chin. It works the sides of the shoulders, with help from the traps and biceps.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a bar to a low pulley. Sit on a bench facing the machine, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart. Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists past your knees.
Keep your forearms still and curl your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower the bar slowly until your wrists bend back down.
description: A seated wrist curl with your palms facing up, using a low cable. It works the muscles on the underside of your forearms.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Grip a pair of parallel bars and push yourself up until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower yourself, leaning your body forward and bending your knees as you go, until your shoulders drop below your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip on parallel bars with your body leaning forward and your knees bent. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Narrow Neutral Grip Chinup
instructions: Hang a V-shaped handle (the kind used for cable rows) over a pullup bar. Grab both grips, hands close together and palms facing each other, and hang with arms straight.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above your hands.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chinup on a V-shaped handle hooked over the bar, with your hands close together and palms facing each other. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Circles Knee Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your heels a little, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Keeping your knees bent, circle them clockwise.
Switch and circle them counterclockwise.
description: A warm-up where you circle your bent knees one way, then the other. It loosens the knees and ankles and works the calves.

name: Close Grip Pushup
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup, arms straight and body in a straight line, with your hands close together under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms until your arms are straight again.
description: A pushup with your hands close together and your elbows tucked in. It mainly works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Cocoons
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms stretched out on the floor past your head.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor at the same time, pulling your knees in toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins so you finish balanced on your butt, curled up in a ball.
Uncurl slowly and stretch back out flat.
description: A full-body crunch that goes from lying stretched out to curled in a ball, hugging your knees. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Cross Body Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hands behind your head, elbows pointing out.
Lift your upper body and twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee, lifting that knee to meet it.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Bring your left elbow toward your right knee on the next rep. Keep alternating sides.
description: A crunch with a twist, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Overhead Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Stretch your arms straight above your head.
Tighten your abs and curl your upper body off the floor toward your knees, keeping your arms overhead.
Lower your upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A crunch done with your arms stretched overhead, which makes it harder than a plain crunch. It works the abs.

name: Crunch Floor
