instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Put your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Tighten your abs and lift your shoulders off the floor, curling forward toward your knees.
Lower your shoulders slowly back to the floor.
description: A basic crunch done lying on your back with your knees bent, lifting your shoulders off the floor. It works the abs.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms pointing straight up at the ceiling.
Lift your legs off the floor with your hips and knees bent at right angles. Press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor, straightening them until they hover just above it.
Bring them back up, then do the same with your left arm and right leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A lying ab exercise: lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor while your lower back stays pressed down. It works the abs, with help from the hips and lower back.

name: Feet Elevated Pushup
instructions: Place your feet on a flat bench and your hands flat on the floor, about shoulder-width apart. Straighten your arms and body.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest until it's just above the floor, keeping your body straight from head to heels.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your feet up on a bench, which shifts more of your weight onto your hands. It works the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Decline Situp
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the pads and your knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head, or cross them over your chest.
Tighten your abs and curl your upper body up off the bench toward your knees.
Lower yourself slowly back down to the bench.
description: A full situp on a decline bench, with your head starting lower than your feet. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Diamond Pushup
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup with your hands close together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching to make a diamond shape.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your hands together under your chest, thumbs and index fingers touching in a diamond shape. It mainly works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a low step, heels off the edge. Hold the edge of a bench in front, palms facing down.
Bend at the hips until your upper body is close to level with the floor, keeping your arms and legs straight.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly until they dip below the step.
description: A calf raise done bent forward at the hips, hands on a bench and the balls of your feet on a step. It works the calves.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms still and curl one dumbbell up to shoulder level.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing dumbbell curl done one arm at a time, palms facing forward, with your upper arms kept still. It works the biceps and also the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell straight overhead while the other stays at your shoulder.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then press the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing overhead press, pushing up one dumbbell at a time while the other waits at your shoulder. It works the front of the shoulders, with the triceps and abs helping.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms straight and palms facing your feet.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, bending your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Push the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
description: A chest press lying on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Bench Seated Press
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows out to the sides.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight over your head. Keep your back upright.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
description: An overhead dumbbell press done sitting upright on a flat bench with no back support. It works the front of the shoulders and the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Bench Squat
instructions: Stand with your back to a flat bench, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to sit down until your butt touches the bench. Keep your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand back up straight.
description: A squat down to a bench behind you with a dumbbell in each hand, so the bench sets how low you go. It works the glutes and quads.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bent Over Row
instructions: Put one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, other foot on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, palm facing in.
Keep your back flat and let the dumbbell hang straight down with your arm straight.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm dumbbell row with one knee and hand braced on a bench. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips with your back straight. Let your arms hang straight down, elbows slightly bent.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest.
Lower them slowly until your arms hang straight again.
description: A row done bent forward at the hips, pulling a dumbbell in each hand up toward your chest. It works the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight and palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms still and curl both dumbbells up to shoulder level.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing forward. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing you.
Squat down, lowering the dumbbells toward the floor, with your back straight and chest up.
Straighten your hips and knees fast, driving through your heels.
Shrug and pull the dumbbells up close to your body. Catch them at your shoulders in a squat, elbows forward and palms up.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the floor beside your feet.
description: A fast, full-body lift that pulls two dumbbells from near the floor to your shoulders and catches them in a squat. It works the glutes, plus the hamstrings, quads and calves.

name: Dumbbell Close Grip Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold two dumbbells above your chest, arms straight, palms facing each other, dumbbells pressed together.
Keep the dumbbells touching and your elbows close to your sides as you lower them to the middle of your chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dumbbell bench press with the dumbbells pressed together, palms facing each other and elbows tucked in. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest that elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Let your arm hang straight with your palm facing away from your thigh.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A seated curl, one arm at a time, with your elbow braced against your inner thigh so you can't swing the weight. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl one dumbbell up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, thumb up.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A hammer curl, thumbs up, that brings each dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointing forward. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down, palms facing your body.
Bend at your hips and knees to lower the dumbbells toward the floor beside your feet. Keep your back straight.
Push through your heels and straighten your hips and knees to stand back up.
description: A deadlift with a dumbbell in each hand, lifted from beside your feet to standing. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing toward your feet.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, until your elbows are bent to 90 degrees.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dumbbell press on a decline bench, with your head lower than your hips. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Decline Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms straight and palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring them back up along the same arc until they are above your chest again.
description: A chest fly on a decline bench, opening the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc and bringing them back together. It works the lower chest.

name: Dumbbell Decline Hammer Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms straight and palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your palms facing each other.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
description: A decline dumbbell press with your palms facing each other the whole way. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Chest Supported Shrug
instructions: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees. Lie chest down on it with your head over the top and your feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down, palms facing each other.
Keeping your arms straight, raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as you can.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug done lying chest down on an incline bench, which stops your body from swinging. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Decline Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Straighten your arms up over your chest, keeping your elbows in.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells slowly beside your head.
Straighten your arms to raise the dumbbells back up.
description: A lying triceps extension on a decline bench, lowering two dumbbells beside your head by bending your elbows. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Decline Twist Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight up over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Turn your wrists as you lower them, so your palms face up at the bottom.
Reverse the motion, turning your palms back toward your feet as the dumbbells come up over your chest.
description: A decline chest fly that turns the wrists as the dumbbells open out and come back. It works the lower chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Hold the dumbbells straight up over your chest with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keep that bend and lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up over your chest along the same arc.
description: A chest exercise lying on a flat bench, opening your arms wide with a dumbbell in each hand and bringing them back together. It works the chest.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and lift both dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.
description: A standing raise that lifts two dumbbells straight out in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Full Can Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight. As you lift, turn your hands so your thumbs point up.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Lower them slowly back to your sides.
description: A side raise with your thumbs turned up, so your palms face forward at the top. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your palms facing in (thumbs up) the whole time.
Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A curl done with your palms facing each other, thumbs up, one arm at a time. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Sit with your back flat against it and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward, and press them up until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dumbbell press on a bench set to a 45-degree incline. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight and palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms still and curl both dumbbells up to shoulder level.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-dumbbell curl done sitting back on an incline bench, which stretches the biceps more at the bottom. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Lie back and press the dumbbells up until they are directly above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring them back up along the same arc until they are above your chest again.
description: A chest fly on a 45-degree incline bench, opening the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc. It works the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight, palms facing your body.
Keep your upper arms still and your palms facing in (thumbs up) as you curl both dumbbells up to shoulder level.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A hammer curl done sitting back on an incline bench, with your palms facing in the whole time. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells to shoulder level, palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
description: An incline dumbbell press done with your palms facing each other. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Inner Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Let your arms hang down and angled out to the sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms still and angled out, away from your body, the whole time.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done lying back on an incline bench with your arms angled out to the sides, away from your body. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to about 45 degrees. Lie on your side against the backrest with your feet stacked on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip, palm facing your thigh and elbow slightly bent.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side and up in an arc until your arm points straight up at the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to your hip. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm side raise done lying on your side on an incline bench, lifting the dumbbell from your hip until your arm points straight up. It works the side of the shoulder.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Grip Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Sit back against it with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, elbows bent, palms facing toward your face (a reverse grip).
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
description: An incline dumbbell press with a reverse grip, palms facing toward your face. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, feet flat. Let a dumbbell hang in each hand, palms facing back.
Keeping your arms straight, raise both dumbbells in front of you until your arms are about level with the floor.
Lower slowly until your arms hang straight down again.
description: A front raise done sitting back on an incline bench, so your arms start from behind your body. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Lean your chest against the pad with your feet on the floor behind it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing each other.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, until they're level with the floor.
Lower them slowly back down.
description: A rear raise done chest-down on an incline bench, lifting the dumbbells out to the sides. It works the back of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Incline Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees.
Lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, your chest against the pad and your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down from your shoulders.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest.
Lower them slowly until your arms hang straight again.
description: A two-dumbbell row done lying face down on an incline bench, so your chest is supported. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Sit with a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs, then lean back against the pad.
Use your thighs to help lift the dumbbells to your shoulders. Press them up until your arms point up, elbows slightly bent, palms facing your feet.
Push the dumbbells a little higher by reaching your shoulders up off the bench. Move only your shoulders, not your arms.
Let your shoulders sink back to the bench.
description: A small reaching move done lying back on an incline bench, pushing the dumbbells up by moving only your shoulders. It works the serratus, the muscles along the sides of your ribs.

name: Dumbbell Incline Shrug
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit back on it with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet flat on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and shrug your shoulders up toward your ears as high as you can.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug done sitting back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand. It works the traps, the muscles that run from your neck to your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Twisted Flyes
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lie back and press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Turn your wrists as you lower them, so your palms face up at the bottom.
Reverse the motion, turning your palms back toward your feet as the dumbbells come up over your chest.
description: An incline chest fly that turns the wrists as the dumbbells open out and come back. It works the upper chest.

name: Dumbbell Iron Cross
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor, holding the dumbbells straight out in front at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Stand up, and as you rise, sweep your straight arms out to the sides until your body makes a T, palms facing forward.
Squat back down while bringing your arms back together in front of you.
description: A squat paired with an arm sweep: you stand up from a squat while moving straight arms from in front of you out to a T. It works the shoulders, plus the quads and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Kickback
instructions: Put one knee and the hand on the same side on a flat bench, with your other foot on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, palm facing your body. Raise your upper arm level with your back, forearm hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow to push the dumbbell back until your arm is straight.
Bend your elbow slowly to bring the dumbbell back down. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm triceps kickback with one knee and one hand braced on a flat bench. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body. Keep your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're level with the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms slowly back down.
description: A standing raise, lifting a dumbbell in each hand out to your sides up to shoulder height. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lateral to Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, until they're level with the floor.
Keep them at shoulder height and sweep your arms forward until they're straight out in front of you.
Lower the dumbbells slowly from the front back to your sides.
description: A lateral raise where you sweep your arms forward at shoulder height, then lower them from the front. It works the side and front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body into a lunge. Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Push through your right heel to step back to standing, then lunge with your left leg. Keep alternating legs.
description: A forward lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand, alternating legs. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Dumbbell Cross Face Lying Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand straight up over your chest, palms facing your feet.
Keep one upper arm still and bend that elbow to lower the dumbbell across your face toward your opposite shoulder. Keep the other arm straight up.
Straighten your elbow to raise the dumbbell back up. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A lying triceps extension where you lower one dumbbell at a time across your face toward the opposite shoulder. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Elbow Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, arms straight up over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
description: A close-grip dumbbell press lying on a flat bench, palms facing each other and elbows tucked in. It works the triceps, with help from the chest.

name: Dumbbell Lying Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your knees just past the end, and hold the bench near your head.
Hold a dumbbell upright between your feet, legs straight.
Keep your hips pressed into the bench and bend your knees to curl your heels up until your lower legs point straight up.
Lower slowly until your legs are straight.
description: A hamstring curl done lying face down on a bench, holding a dumbbell between your feet. It works the hamstrings on the back of the thigh.

name: Dumbbell Lying Hammer Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight up and palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, until your elbows are bent to 90 degrees.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
description: A flat-bench dumbbell press with your palms facing each other. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lying Single Arm Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in one hand.
Hold the dumbbell next to your shoulder with your palm facing toward your feet.
Press it straight up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A flat bench dumbbell press done one arm at a time. It works the chest, with the triceps and shoulders helping, and makes your body work to stay steady.

name: Dumbbell Lying Single Arm Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging straight toward the floor.
Keep your arm straight and raise the dumbbell out to the side, away from your body.
Lower it slowly until it hangs straight down again. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm raise out to the side while lying face down on a flat bench. It works the back of the shoulders, with the upper back helping.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench, propped up on your bottom elbow near the edge.
Hold a dumbbell by the middle of the handle in your bottom hand, forearm sticking out past the edge of the bench.
Start with your palm facing the ceiling and the dumbbell lying level along the bench.
Keep your elbow still and turn your forearm until your palm faces your feet and the dumbbell stands upright.
Turn it back slowly until your palm faces the ceiling. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A forearm twist done lying on your side on a bench, turning a dumbbell from level to upright. It works the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with the floor.
Lower them slowly back down.
description: A rear raise done lying face down on a flat bench, which keeps you from swinging the weights. It works the backs of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench, propped up on your bottom elbow near the edge.
Hold a dumbbell by the middle of the handle in your bottom hand, forearm sticking out past the edge of the bench.
Start with your palm facing your feet and the dumbbell standing upright.
Keep your elbow still and turn your forearm until your palm faces the ceiling and the dumbbell lies level along the bench.
Turn it back slowly until the dumbbell stands upright again. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A forearm twist done lying on your side on a bench, turning a dumbbell from upright to level. It works the forearms and biceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Straighten your arms up over your chest, keeping your elbows in.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms to raise the dumbbells back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps extension on a flat bench, lowering two dumbbells beside your head by bending your elbows. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Neutral Grip Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand straight up over your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows pointing up and bend them to lower the dumbbells down beside your head.
Straighten your elbows to raise the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.
description: A lying triceps extension with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing each other, lowering the weights beside your head. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Kickback
instructions: Stand with one foot a step in front of the other, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with your back straight. Rest your free hand on your front thigh.
Bring your working elbow up close to your side, bent at 90 degrees.
Straighten your arm back behind you until it is fully straight, keeping your upper arm still.
Bend your elbow slowly to bring the dumbbell back down. Do all your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm triceps move done bent forward, straightening your arm back behind you with a dumbbell. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing your body.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with your arm straight until your arm is level with the floor, palm facing down.
Lower it slowly back to your side.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A lateral raise done one arm at a time, lifting a dumbbell out to the side until your arm is level with the floor. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Lateral Raise with Support
instructions: Stand beside an incline bench with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
Hold the bench with your other hand for support and keep your back straight.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side with your arm straight and your palm facing down, until your arm is level with the floor.
Lower it slowly back to your side. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm raise out to the side while you hold a bench with your other hand for balance. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down, and rest that forearm on your thigh with your wrist just past your knee.
Lower the dumbbell slowly by bending your wrist down.
Lift the back of your hand up as far as you can, keeping your forearm on your thigh. Do all your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm wrist curl with your palm facing down, lifting the back of your hand while your forearm rests on your thigh. It works the muscles on top of your forearm.

name: Supported Dumbbell Single Arm Reverse Fly
instructions: Stand facing the top of an incline bench's backrest, about a step away. Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, resting one hand on top of the backrest.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, arm hanging straight down, palm facing in toward your body.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow and raise the dumbbell forward and up until your arm points straight ahead, about level with your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm hangs straight down. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm raise done bent forward with your free hand braced on an incline bench, lifting the dumbbell out in front of you to shoulder height. It works the shoulders and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight overhead, keeping the other at your shoulder.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing overhead press with dumbbells, one arm at a time. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps, and your core has to keep you from leaning.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Tricep Extension on Bench
instructions: Sit on a flat bench, back straight and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other on your hip.
Press the dumbbell straight up overhead, keeping your upper arm close to your head and your elbow pointing up.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arm still.
Straighten your arm to lift the dumbbell back overhead. Do all your reps, then switch arms.
description: An overhead triceps extension done sitting on a bench, one arm at a time, lowering a dumbbell behind your head. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thighs, arm straight and palm facing your body.
Lift the dumbbell straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbow. Keep your back straight.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: An upright row with one dumbbell, lifted from your thighs toward your chin with the elbow leading. It works the sides of the shoulders, plus the upper back and biceps.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and rest that forearm on your thigh.
Let your wrist bend back so the dumbbell rolls down toward your fingers.
Curl your wrist back up, bringing the dumbbell toward your forearm. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated one-arm wrist curl with your palm facing up and your forearm resting on your thigh. It works the forearm muscles that bend your wrist.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest your forearms across it, hands past the far edge. Hold the dumbbells upright, palms facing each other (thumbs up).
Keeping your forearms on the bench, bend your wrists to let the dumbbells tip forward and down toward the floor.
Tilt your wrists back up until the dumbbells stand upright again.
description: A wrist exercise done kneeling at a bench with your forearms resting on it, tipping upright dumbbells forward and back with your thumbs up. It works the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Single Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and rest one forearm on it, with your hand just past the far edge.
Hold a dumbbell upright in that hand, palm facing in and thumb on top.
Keep your forearm on the bench and bend your wrist to tip the top of the dumbbell forward and down.
Lift it back up to upright using only your wrist. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A wrist exercise done kneeling at a bench with your forearm resting on it, tipping an upright dumbbell forward and back with your thumb on top. It works the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Single Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lean over it, holding a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest that forearm across the bench with your wrist and hand hanging off the far edge.
Bend your wrist to curl the dumbbell up toward your forearm as far as you can.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your wrist bends back. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm wrist curl with your palm facing up and your forearm resting on a bench. It works the muscles on the palm side of the forearm.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms across the bench so your wrists hang off the far edge.
Bend your wrists back to lift the dumbbells up toward you as far as they go.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A wrist curl with your palms facing down and forearms resting across a bench. It works the muscles on the top of the forearm.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms across the bench so your wrists hang off the far edge.
Curl the dumbbells up toward you by bending your wrists as far as they go.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A dumbbell wrist curl with your palms facing up and forearms resting across a bench. It works the forearms, mainly the muscles on the palm side.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your feet flat and the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms facing each other (thumbs up).
Keep your upper arms on the pad and your palms facing each other the whole time.
Curl both dumbbells up until your forearms are upright, close to your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A preacher curl done with your palms facing each other, thumbs up, both arms at once, with the pad keeping your upper arms still. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and your toes turned out.
Hold one dumbbell upright by its top end, palms facing up under the top plate, arms hanging straight down.
Bend your knees and lower your hips until your thighs are about level with the floor, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
description: A wide-stance squat with your toes turned out, holding one dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, quads and inner thighs.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your chest against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up, upper arm on the pad and arm straight. Rest your other hand on the pad.
Keep your upper arm on the pad and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm curl on a preacher bench, with your upper arm braced on the pad so your shoulder can't help. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronated Grip Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with straight arms above your forehead, palms facing toward your feet.
Keep your upper arms still, elbows pointing up, and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells back beside your head.
Straighten your elbows slowly to raise the dumbbells back above your forehead.
description: A lying triceps extension with a dumbbell in each hand and your palms facing toward your feet. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
instructions: Set a bench to a 45-degree incline and lie face down on it, chest and stomach against the pad.
Let your arms hang straight down with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your upper arms still, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-arm curl lying chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down. The bench stops you from swinging, so the biceps do the work.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Kneel with one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, other foot on the floor, back flat and level.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, arm hanging straight down, palm facing back toward your legs.
Pull the dumbbell up with your elbow pointing out to the side, until your upper arm is level with your back.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm row braced on a bench, pulling with your elbow out wide instead of close to your side. It works the rear shoulders and the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Rear Fly
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench, feet flat. Lean forward from your hips until your chest is over your knees, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, hanging beside your lower legs, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A rear fly done sitting on the end of a bench, leaning forward over your knees. It works the rear shoulders and the upper back.

name: Head Supported Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a bench to an incline and stand facing its top end, feet shoulder-width apart, with a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly, bend forward at the hips, and rest your forehead on the top of the bench, arms hanging down.
Raise your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, until they're level with the floor.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A bent-over rear raise with your forehead resting on an incline bench, which keeps your upper body still. It works the backs of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, with a slight bend in your elbows, until they are level with the floor.
Lower them slowly back down.
description: A rear raise done standing and bent forward at the hips, lifting two dumbbells out to the sides. It works the backs of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step back with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge.
Bend your left knee until your left thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your left heel to step back up to standing. Then do the same, stepping back with your left foot.
description: A lunge done by stepping backward while holding a dumbbell in each hand. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight, palms facing behind you.
Keep your upper arms still and curl both dumbbells up to shoulder level, palms facing down.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done with your palms facing down instead of up, both arms at once. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, chest on the pad, legs straight and toes on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A reverse fly done lying face down on an incline bench, so the bench holds your body still. It works the rear shoulders and the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your feet flat and the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl both dumbbells up until your forearms are upright and your palms face away from you.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A preacher curl done with your palms facing down instead of up, both arms at once. It works the biceps and puts more of the work on the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang off past your knees.
Curl your wrists up slowly, lifting the dumbbells toward your body.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back down.
description: A wrist curl done with your palms facing down, lifting the backs of your hands. It works the muscles on the top of your forearms.

name: Dumbbell Incline Rotation Reverse Fly
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, chest on the pad, legs straight and toes on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing back toward your legs so the dumbbells line up end to end.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are level with your shoulders, turning your hands as you lift so your palms end up facing the floor.
Lower slowly, turning your palms back toward your legs.
description: A reverse fly on an incline bench that turns your hands from palms back to palms down as you lift. It works the rear shoulders and the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Front Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight down at your sides, palms facing your body.
Keep your arm straight and raise one dumbbell in front of you until your arm is level with the floor.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A front raise done sitting on a bench, lifting one dumbbell at a time straight out in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then press the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated overhead press, one dumbbell at a time. It works the front of the shoulders, with the triceps and chest helping.

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl
instructions: Sit tall on the end of a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-arm dumbbell curl done sitting on the end of a bench, which keeps your body from swinging the weight up. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and raise the dumbbells in front of you, palms facing down, until they reach shoulder height.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.
description: A front raise done sitting on a bench, which cuts down on swinging. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Inner Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up and out, so they finish wide, just outside your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A seated curl where the dumbbells travel out wide and finish outside your shoulders, both arms at once. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat on the floor, knees slightly bent, and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Hold your upper arms close to your sides with your elbows bent at a right angle.
Straighten both arms back behind you, keeping your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows slowly back to a right angle.
description: A triceps kickback done sitting on the end of a bench, leaning forward and straightening both arms back behind you. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and raise the dumbbells out to your sides, elbows slightly bent, until your arms are level with the floor.
Lower them slowly back down.
description: A side raise done sitting on a bench, which cuts down on swinging. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, and lean forward.
Rest your forearms on your thighs with your wrists just past your knees. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, dumbbells upright.
Keep your forearms on your thighs and let your hands drop forward, so the dumbbells tip away from you.
Bend your wrists back up until the dumbbells stand upright again.
description: A seated wrist exercise with your palms facing each other: the dumbbells tip forward and your wrists lift them back up. It works the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench, feet flat on the floor, with a dumbbell in one hand and your other hand on the bench.
Lean forward from the waist with your back straight until your upper body is level with the floor.
Keep your elbow close to your side and straighten your arm back behind you.
Bend your elbow slowly to lower the dumbbell. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated one-arm move where you lean forward and straighten your arm back behind you. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Rotate
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat and lean forward. Rest one hand on your thigh.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, that arm hanging straight down outside your knee, palm facing behind you.
Keeping your arm still, turn your forearm so your thumb swings forward and your palm ends up facing your knee.
Turn it back slowly to the start. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated forearm twist: lean forward with one arm hanging and turn the dumbbell a quarter turn and back. It works the forearms, with some help from the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with a step in front of you and put the ball of one foot on the edge of the step.
Hold a dumbbell on top of that thigh, near your knee.
Raise your heel as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A seated calf raise for one leg at a time, with a dumbbell on your thigh for extra weight. It works the calves.

name: Dumbbell Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang just past your knees.
Curl your wrists up as far as you can.
Lower your wrists slowly back down.
description: A seated wrist curl with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and forearms resting on your thighs. It works the forearm muscles that bend your wrist.

name: Dumbbell Seated Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest your upper arms on the pad, arms straight and palms facing up.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-arm dumbbell curl at a preacher bench, with your upper arms braced on the pad to stop any swinging. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet wide. Lean forward and rest your free hand on your knee.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, the back of that arm against your inner thigh, arm straight, palm facing toward you.
Keep your upper arm against your thigh and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, the back of your hand leading.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A seated concentration curl done with your palm turned down instead of up. It works the biceps and the top of the forearm.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Grip Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with an upright back support, feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other, elbows pointing forward.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight above your head, keeping your palms facing each other.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with your palms facing each other the whole time. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
description: A shoulder press done sitting on a bench, pushing two dumbbells overhead. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell hanging at each side, palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and raise your shoulders as high as you can, as if trying to touch your ears with them.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug with a dumbbell hanging at each side, lifting your shoulders toward your ears. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell hanging at your side in one hand and your other hand behind your head.
Keeping your back straight, bend sideways at the waist toward the dumbbell, lowering it down your leg as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly to standing straight.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing side bend with one dumbbell, lowering it down the side of your leg and coming back up. It works the obliques along your sides, plus the abs.

name: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your legs straight and your head resting on your lower arm.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand with your palm facing down.
Keep your arm straight and raise the dumbbell until your arm points straight up.
Lower it slowly back down. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm raise done lying on your side on a bench, lifting the dumbbell until your arm points straight up. It works the sides of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the floor, holding a dumbbell on that side. Bend your other knee to lift that foot behind you.
Raise your heel as high as you can, rising onto the ball of your foot.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A calf raise on one leg while holding a dumbbell for extra weight. It works the calves and tests your balance.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a flat bench, facing away from it, with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your body.
Reach one foot back and rest the top of it on the bench.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is about level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat with your rear foot raised on a bench and a dumbbell in each hand. It works the quads and glutes of the front leg.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Lift your other leg straight out in front of you and reach your free arm forward.
Bend your standing leg and sit your hips back as if into a chair, keeping your chest up and your front leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A squat on one leg with the other leg held out in front, holding a dumbbell for extra weight. It works the glutes and quads and takes good balance.

name: Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower your body, as if sitting back into a chair.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to shoulder level, then press the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing dumbbell shoulder press done one arm at a time. It works the front of the shoulders, with the triceps and abs helping keep you steady.

name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arm straight and your body still, raise one dumbbell in front of you until your arm is level with the floor.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh, then raise the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A front raise done one arm at a time, lifting a dumbbell straight out in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a low step, feet about shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A standing calf raise holding a dumbbell in each hand, with the balls of your feet on a low step. It works the calves.

name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and lift the dumbbells in front of you, all the way up above your head.
Lower them slowly back to your thighs.
description: A front raise that keeps going past shoulder height until the dumbbells are above your head. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Standing Kickback
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, back straight.
Hold your upper arms close to your sides with your elbows bent.
Straighten both arms back behind you, keeping your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the dumbbells back down.
description: A triceps kickback done standing and bent forward at the hips, straightening both arms back behind you. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Concentration Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent. Lean forward from your hips until your back is nearly level with the floor.
Rest your free hand on your thigh just above the knee. Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm hanging straight down, palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm hanging still and curl the dumbbell up toward your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm curl done standing but bent far forward, with the working arm hanging straight down. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and one hand on your hip. Hold a dumbbell straight overhead in the other hand, palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm still and close to your head.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arm to raise the dumbbell back overhead. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: An overhead triceps extension done standing, one arm at a time, lowering a dumbbell behind your head. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Palm in Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the top of an upright bench with one hand for balance.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand at shoulder height, palm facing in toward your head.
Keep your back straight and press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A standing one-arm overhead press with your palm facing in, your free hand holding a bench for balance. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and abs.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your arm straight, close to your body, palm facing behind you.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your palm facing down as it rises.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm curl with your palm facing down instead of up. It works the biceps and the muscles on top of the forearm.

name: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
description: A shoulder press done standing, pushing two dumbbells overhead from shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Standing Palms in Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing each other.
Press both dumbbells up until your arms are straight overhead. Keep your back straight.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.
description: An overhead dumbbell press with your palms facing each other the whole time, which can be easier on the shoulders. It works the front of the shoulders, plus the triceps and chest.

name: Dumbbell Standing Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing behind you.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells up to shoulder height without turning your wrists.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done with your palms facing down instead of up. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Stepup
instructions: Stand facing a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your whole right foot on the bench or step.
Push through your right heel to lift yourself up, straightening your right leg.
Bring your left foot up so you stand tall on top.
Step down with your left foot, then your right. Do all your reps leading with your right leg, then switch legs.
description: A step-up onto a bench or step while holding a dumbbell in each hand. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your head at one end and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands, arms straight up over your chest.
Keep your arms straight and lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc.
Bring it back up along the same arc until it's over your chest.
description: A lying dumbbell exercise: with straight arms, lower one dumbbell in an arc behind your head, then bring it back over your chest. It works the chest, plus the lats and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your back straight and bend forward at your hips, lowering the dumbbells toward the floor.
Keep your knees slightly bent and go down until you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Lift your upper body back up to standing.
description: A deadlift with your legs nearly straight, lowering two dumbbells toward the floor by bending forward at the hips. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lie face up on a flat bench, feet on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms straight, palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows out to the sides and lower the dumbbells until they touch the middle of your chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
description: A lying triceps press where your elbows bend out to the sides and the dumbbells come down to your chest. It works the triceps, with help from the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your thighs and arms straight.
Keep your back straight and lift the dumbbells up toward your chin, leading with your elbows and keeping them high.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: An upright row with two dumbbells, lifted from your thighs to your chin with your elbows leading. It works the sides of the shoulders, with help from the traps and biceps.

name: Dumbbell W Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward, feet hip-width apart. Tuck your elbows down by your ribs so your arms form a W.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly out until your arms are straight overhead in a wide V.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height, elbows tucked in.
description: A standing dumbbell press that starts with your elbows tucked in by your ribs and ends with your arms in a wide V overhead. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps.

name: Elbow to Knee
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head, elbows pointing out. Lift both feet just off the floor, legs straight.
Lift your upper body and twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee as you pull that knee in.
Keep your right leg straight and off the floor while you twist.
Untwist and straighten your left leg, then bring your left elbow toward your right knee. Keep alternating sides.
description: A lying twist crunch: one elbow comes toward the opposite knee while the other leg stays straight and off the floor, then you switch. It works the abs and obliques.

name: EZ Bar Anti Gravity Press
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 45 degrees, chest at the top of the pad, toes on the floor behind you.
Hold an EZ bar in front of your shoulders with your elbows bent, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing down.
Push the bar forward until your arms are straight out in front of your head.
Bend your elbows to bring the bar slowly back in front of your shoulders.
description: A shoulder press done lying face down on an incline bench, pushing an EZ bar straight out in front of you instead of overhead. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps.

name: EZ Bar Close Grip Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar with your palms facing forward and your hands close together.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing EZ bar curl with your hands close together and palms facing forward. It works the biceps, with the forearms helping.

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar (the bar with bends in it) with your palms facing up.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms still.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl with an EZ bar, the bar with bends in it, using a palms-up grip. It works the biceps.

name: EZ Bar Decline Close Grip Face Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your legs hooked under the leg pads.
Hold an EZ bar with your hands close together on the inner bends, palms facing toward your feet.
Press the bar straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your face.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
description: A close-grip EZ bar press done head-down on a decline bench, lowering the bar toward your face. It works the triceps, with some help from the chest and shoulders.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Grip Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Hold an EZ bar in front of your thighs, palms facing your legs, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar up until it's in front of your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done with your palms facing down instead of up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your feet flat on the floor and the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with your arms straight down the pad, palms facing down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Curl the bar up until your forearms are upright and the bar is near your chin.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
description: A preacher curl done with your palms facing down. The angled pad keeps your upper arms still, so the biceps and forearms do the work.

name: Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat on the floor. Hold a barbell with your palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang off past your knees. Let the bar roll down into your fingers.
Curl your fingers to roll the bar up into your palms.
Uncurl slowly, letting the bar roll back down to your fingers.
description: A seated forearm exercise where you roll a barbell from your fingers up into your palms. It works the forearms and grip.

name: Prone Bench Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench, hips at the end, legs straight out behind you. Hold the bench legs by your head.
Keep your hips on the bench and your legs straight.
Raise one leg a little above your body as the other drops a little below it.
Switch the legs in short up-and-down kicks. Keep alternating sides.
description: Small up-and-down leg kicks done face down on a bench, legs straight out past the end. Lifting each leg behind you works the glutes.

name: Front Plank with Twist
instructions: Start in a plank on your forearms, elbows under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Turn your body to the right onto your left forearm and reach your right arm up toward the ceiling, keeping your hips up.
Lower your arm and turn back to the forearm plank.
Twist to the left side next. Keep alternating sides.
description: A forearm plank that turns into a side plank with your top arm reaching up, then back. It works the abs and obliques, with help from the shoulders.

name: Gorilla Chin
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. Bend your knees so your feet are behind you.
Pull yourself up and lift your knees toward your chest at the same time.
Stop when your chin reaches the bar and your knees are tucked up to your chest.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and your knees drop back down.
description: A chinup where you tuck your knees up to your chest as you pull. It works the abs, along with the biceps and forearms.

name: Groin Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped out to the sides. Cross your arms over your chest.
Keep your legs still and curl your head and shoulders up until your shoulder blades leave the floor.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
description: A crunch done with the soles of your feet together and your knees dropped open to the sides. It works the abs.

name: Handstand Pushup
instructions: Place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart and kick up into a handstand, body straight. Use a wall for balance if you need it.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your hands until your arms are straight again.
description: A pushup done upside down in a handstand, lowering your head toward the floor and pressing back up. It works the triceps and shoulders and takes strong balance.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight, hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you.
Without swinging, bend your knees and raise them in front of you until your thighs are level with the floor.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight again.
description: A hanging core exercise where you lift your bent knees up to hip height. It works the abs and the muscles at the front of the hips.

name: Hanging Pike
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you. Bend your knees.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, then keep rolling your hips up toward the bar.
Straighten your legs so they point straight up past the bar, with your body upside down.
Bend your knees and lower slowly back to the hang.
description: An advanced hanging move where you roll your hips up until you're upside down with your legs pointing straight up. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips and the shoulders.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you.
Keep your legs straight and raise them in front of you without swinging.
Keep lifting, curling your hips up, until your feet reach the bar.
Lower your legs slowly until you're hanging straight again.
description: A hanging leg raise that goes past level, curling your hips up until your feet reach the bar. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight and your palms facing away from you.
Keep your legs straight and together and lift them in front of you until they're level with the floor, or as high as you can.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
description: A hard hanging ab exercise: hang from a pullup bar and lift your straight legs in front of you to hip height. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight.
Lift your straight legs up in front of you until they are at least level with the floor.
Twist your hips to swing your raised legs over to one side.
Sweep them straight across to the other side without stopping in the middle, keeping them raised. Keep alternating sides.
description: A hanging core move where you hold your straight legs up and sweep them from one side to the other. It works the abs and obliques, and the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: Bent Knee Hip Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest your arms at your sides, palms down.
Lift your feet and bring your knees in over your chest.
Curl your hips off the floor, pushing your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your feet, slowly back to the floor.
description: A lying ab move where you pull your bent knees in and curl your hips up off the floor. It works the abs.

name: Bench Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down along a flat bench with your hips at one end and your upper body hanging down off it.
Place your hands behind your head.
Keeping your back straight, raise your upper body until it's level with your legs.
Lower slowly until your upper body hangs down again.
description: A back raise done face down on a flat bench, with your upper body hanging off the end. It works the lower back, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Hyperextension
instructions: Adjust a 45-degree hyperextension bench so your upper thighs rest on the pad, and hook your feet in place.
Cross your arms over your chest or put your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body toward the floor, keeping your back straight.
Raise it back up until your body is in a straight line with your legs.
description: A back extension on a 45-degree bench: lower your upper body toward the floor, then raise it until it lines up with your legs. It works the lower back, plus the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Hands Elevated Close Grip Pushup
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar at about hip height and leave it locked. Grip it with your hands closer than shoulder-width, palms facing down.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight from head to heels and your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows, keeping them close to your sides, and lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
