description: A pushup with your hands close together on a bar at hip height. The close hands put more of the work on the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Straight Leg Incline Hip Raise
instructions: Lie on your back on an incline bench with your head at the high end and your legs straight down the bench.
Reach back and grip the bench behind your head.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them until they point straight up, then lift your hips off the bench.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A straight-leg raise on an incline bench that ends by lifting your hips off the pad. It works the abs, with help from the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: Hands Elevated Pushup
instructions: Place your hands flat on a step, a bit wider than your shoulders, and walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Keep your body straight and bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the step.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your hands up on a step, which makes it easier than a floor pushup. It works the chest, mainly the lower part, plus the shoulders and triceps.

name: Decline Twisting Situp
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench, head lower than your hips, and hook your feet under the foot pads at the high end.
Place your hands behind your head, elbows out to the sides.
Sit up, and as you rise, twist your upper body to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly until your back is on the bench. Do all your reps twisting to one side, then switch.
description: A situp on a decline bench, head lower than your feet, with a twist at the top. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Inverted Row with Straps
instructions: Set the straps so the handles hang at chest height. Stand facing the anchor and hold the handles with your palms facing down.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your body is at an angle, heels on the floor.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest up to the handles.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row on suspension straps, leaning back and pulling your chest up to the handles. It works the upper back.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at waist height. Stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the bar with your palms facing down, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Walk your feet forward under the bar and lean back until your arms are straight, keeping your body straight and your heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row hanging back from a waist-high bar and pulling your chest up to it. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Isometric Wipers
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands much wider than your shoulders and your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your arms to lower your chest close to the floor.
Staying low, shift your chest sideways over one hand.
Slide across to the other hand without pushing back up. Keep alternating sides.
description: A wide pushup held low, shifting your chest from one hand to the other without pushing back up. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders, triceps and core.

name: Jackknife Situp
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time, reaching your hands toward your toes so your body folds into a V.
Lower your legs and upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A situp where your legs and upper body lift together and meet in the middle, folding you into a V. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Janda Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms crossed over your chest.
Curl your upper body up off the floor slowly until you're sitting almost upright.
Lower yourself slowly back to the floor.
description: A slow situp with your arms crossed, done to work the abs while using the muscles at the front of your hips as little as possible.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to lower into a squat, bringing your hands together in front of your chest.
Jump up as hard as you can, straightening your hips, knees and ankles and swinging your arms down to your sides.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and go straight into the next squat.
description: A squat that ends in a jump, using just your body weight. It builds leg power and works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Kettlebell Advanced Windmill
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out. Put your left hand on your hip.
Hold a kettlebell straight overhead in your right hand, palm facing forward. Keep your eyes on it and your arm straight up throughout.
Keep both legs straight and bend at your hips to lower your upper body down and to the left.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your left thigh, then push through your left heel to stand back up.
Do all your reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing bend down and to the side with a kettlebell held straight overhead the whole time. It works the abs and obliques, and the shoulder holding the bell.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Shrug and pull one kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Turn your wrist to catch it at your shoulder, palm facing in, with the kettlebell resting on the outside of your forearm.
Lower it back down, then clean the other kettlebell. Keep alternating sides.
description: A kettlebell clean done one arm at a time, pulling each bell from in front of your thighs up to rest at your shoulder. It works the forearms, plus the shoulders, upper back and core.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Press on Floor
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand, arms straight up over your chest, palms facing toward your feet.
Lower one kettlebell toward your shoulder while the other arm stays straight up.
Press it back up as you lower the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A floor press where you lie flat and press two kettlebells up one at a time. It works the middle of the chest, plus the shoulders and triceps.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one kettlebell straight up until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then press the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing overhead press with two kettlebells, pressing one arm at a time and switching each rep. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and abs.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Renegade Row
instructions: Get into a pushup position with straight arms, gripping the handles of two kettlebells on the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Row one kettlebell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it back to the floor, then row the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A row done from the top of a pushup, pulling one kettlebell up at a time while the other arm holds you up. It works the upper back, plus the abs and shoulders as you stay steady.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, holding a kettlebell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at your hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull one kettlebell up toward your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and drawing your shoulder blade back.
Lower it until your arm is straight, then row the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: A bent-over row with two kettlebells, pulling one up at a time and switching each rep. It works the upper back.

name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height, palm facing you.
Press the kettlebell overhead, turning your palm to face forward as your arm straightens.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder, turning your palm to face you again.
description: A one-arm overhead press with a kettlebell, turning your palm from facing you to facing forward as you press. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Kettlebell Bent Press
instructions: Stand with your feet wide. Hold a kettlebell at your right shoulder, palm facing forward, the bell resting outside your forearm.
Push your hips to the right and bend your upper body down to the left, sliding your left hand toward your left knee.
Keep the kettlebell still as your body drops under it, until your right arm is straight overhead.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell the whole time.
Stand back up with your arm straight, then lower the kettlebell slowly to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm kettlebell lift where you bend your body sideways under the bell, instead of pressing it up, until your arm is straight overhead. It works the abs, obliques and shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Clean From the Hang Position
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side, arm straight, palm facing your thigh.
Pull the kettlebell up fast toward your shoulder in one move, keeping your body upright.
Turn your wrist as it reaches shoulder height so the bottom of the kettlebell points up. Catch it there, elbow bent, holding it upside down.
Lower the kettlebell back to your side by reversing the move. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm kettlebell clean that ends with the kettlebell upside down at your shoulder, so you have to grip hard to keep it balanced. It works the biceps and forearms, plus the shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Double Push Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly to dip down.
Straighten your hips, knees and ankles hard, using that drive to push the kettlebells overhead until your arms are locked straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebells back to your shoulders.
description: An overhead press with two kettlebells, using a quick knee dip and leg drive to help push them up. It works the front of the shoulders, with the legs adding power.

name: Kettlebell Double Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back flat and your chest up.
Straighten your hips, knees and ankles in one fast move, pulling the kettlebells up toward your shoulders.
Turn your wrists as the kettlebells reach shoulder height and punch them straight overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the kettlebells back down in front of your thighs.
description: A fast lift that takes two kettlebells from in front of your thighs to straight overhead in one move. It works the shoulders, with the upper back, forearms and abs helping.

name: Kettlebell Double Windmill
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, a kettlebell in each hand. Press the right one straight overhead and let the left hang at your side.
Turn your left foot out about 45 degrees to the left.
Bend sideways at the waist to the left, keeping your right arm straight overhead.
Lower the left kettlebell down toward your left foot.
Push through your right foot to stand back up. Do all your reps, then switch sides.
description: A windmill with two kettlebells: one held straight overhead while you bend sideways and lower the other toward your foot. It works the abs and obliques, with help from the shoulders and hamstrings.

name: Kettlebell Figure 8
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Pass the kettlebell back between your legs and take it with your other hand behind your leg.
Bring it around the outside of that leg to the front, then pass it back between your legs to your first hand.
Keep passing it around and between your legs in a figure 8 at a steady pace.
description: A drill where you pass a kettlebell around and between your legs in a figure 8 while leaning forward. It works the abs, with the shoulders and forearms helping.

name: Kettlebell Front Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, holding a kettlebell in each hand up at your shoulders.
Keeping your chest up, sit your hips down and back as if into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor or lower, as far as you can comfortably go.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat with a kettlebell held at each shoulder. It works the glutes and quads, and holding the weight in front keeps your upper body upright.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one kettlebell close to your chest with both hands on the sides of its handle.
Keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding one kettlebell close to your chest with both hands. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with your back straight, letting the kettlebell swing back between your legs.
Straighten your hips and knees quickly to swing the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Turn your wrist as it reaches your shoulder and catch it resting on your forearm, with your elbow tucked in.
Lower the kettlebell and let it swing back down between your legs.
description: A kettlebell swung from between your legs up to rest at your shoulder, powered by a quick drive of the hips. It works the hamstrings, with the glutes, quads and calves helping.

name: Kettlebell Lunge Pass Through
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Pass the kettlebell under your front thigh to your other hand.
Push off your front foot to stand back up, holding the bell in the new hand.
Lunge with the other leg and pass the bell back under that thigh. Keep alternating sides.
description: A forward lunge where you pass a kettlebell under your front thigh from one hand to the other, switching legs each rep. It works the glutes and quads and tests your balance.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean and Jerk
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand, palm facing your body.
Bend your knees and hinge at your hips to lower the kettlebell between your legs.
Stand up fast, pulling the kettlebell to your shoulder. Let it rest on the back of your forearm, palm facing in.
Dip your knees slightly, then straighten them hard and punch the kettlebell straight up until your arm locks out overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder, then back down between your legs.
description: A one-arm kettlebell lift in two parts: you pull it from between your legs to your shoulder, then use a quick knee dip to drive it overhead. It works the front of the shoulders, plus the triceps and core.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart.
Press a kettlebell straight overhead with one hand and lock your arm. Let your other arm hang at your side.
Keep the kettlebell steady over your shoulder as you push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down as low as you can.
Stand back up with the kettlebell still overhead.
description: A one-arm squat with a kettlebell held straight overhead the whole time. It works the legs and glutes, while your shoulder and core keep the bell steady.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly and tighten your abs.
Straighten your legs hard and use that push to press the kettlebell up until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to your shoulder, bending your knees slightly as it comes down. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm kettlebell overhead press that starts with a small knee dip, so your legs help drive the weight up. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and abs.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
instructions: Stand with one foot in front of the other, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with your back straight, resting your free hand on your front knee.
Let the kettlebell hang with your palm facing down, then row it up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm kettlebell row from a split stance, with your free hand braced on your knee. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand between your legs.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back, lowering the kettlebell toward the floor.
Straighten your hips and knees fast and use that drive to swing the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Turn your hand as it reaches shoulder height and punch the kettlebell straight up until your arm is straight overhead.
Bring the kettlebell back down between your legs to start the next rep.
description: An explosive one-arm move that swings a kettlebell from between your legs to straight overhead in one motion. It works the shoulders, plus the upper back, forearms and abs.

name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands.
Lift your left foot and stretch that leg out in front of you, level with the floor.
Squat down slowly on your right leg, keeping your right foot flat and your left leg out in front.
Push through your right heel to stand back up.
Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg squat holding a kettlebell at your chest, with the other leg held straight out in front. It works the glutes, quads, hamstrings and calves, and takes real strength, balance and flexibility.

name: Kettlebell Seated Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and wide apart. Hold a kettlebell at one shoulder, palm facing forward, bell resting outside your forearm.
Reach your free arm out to the side for balance.
Sit tall and press the kettlebell straight up until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm kettlebell press done sitting on the floor with your legs spread wide, so your legs can't help drive the weight. It works the front of the shoulders and the triceps.

name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one kettlebell straight overhead while the other stays at your shoulder.
Lower that kettlebell as you press the other one up, like a seesaw. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing overhead press with two kettlebells, one going up as the other comes down. It works the front of the shoulders and tests your coordination.

name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out.
Hold one kettlebell in both hands in front of you, arms hanging straight down.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat, keeping your back straight.
Push through your heels to stand up fast, pulling the kettlebell up to your chin with your elbows high and wide.
Lower the kettlebell back down in front of you.
description: A wide-stance squat that ends with a fast pull of a kettlebell up to your chin. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders, with the shoulders, glutes and hamstrings helping.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out, holding a kettlebell in both hands with straight arms.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back, swinging the kettlebell back between your legs with your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, arms straight.
Let it swing back down between your legs and go straight into the next swing.
description: A kettlebell swung from between your legs up to shoulder height by driving your hips forward. It works the glutes, with the hamstrings and abs helping.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to squat down, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Drive up hard through your heels from the bottom, pressing both kettlebells straight overhead as you stand.
Straighten your arms fully at the top, then bend your elbows to lower the kettlebells back to your shoulders.
description: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press, with a kettlebell at each shoulder. It works the shoulders, with the quads, glutes and abs helping drive the weight up.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up
instructions: Lie on your back, left leg straight, right knee bent and right foot flat. Hold a kettlebell straight up above your right shoulder.
Roll onto your left side and push up onto your left hand, keeping the kettlebell straight up the whole time.
Press through your right foot and left hand to lift your hips off the floor.
Sweep your left leg under you and set that knee down, then lift your hand so you kneel upright, bell still overhead.
Stand up from the kneel, then reverse the steps back down to the floor. Switch the kettlebell to your left hand to do the other side.
description: A Turkish get-up: rise from lying on your back to kneeling, then to standing, with a kettlebell held straight overhead the whole way. It works the glutes, legs, abs and shoulders.

name: Kettlebell Two Arm Clean
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at your hips, lowering the kettlebells between your legs toward the floor.
Straighten your hips and knees hard, using that drive to pull the kettlebells up toward your shoulders.
Turn your hands in as the bells reach your shoulders, catching them with elbows tucked and each bell resting on the back of your forearm.
Lower the kettlebells back down between your legs.
description: A fast lift, driven by your hips, that brings two kettlebells from between your legs up to rest at your shoulders. It works the shoulders, with help from the upper back and forearms.

name: Kettlebell Two Arm Military Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Press both kettlebells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
description: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell in each hand, pressed from your shoulders until your arms are straight. It works the front of the shoulders, plus the triceps and upper back.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell straight overhead in your right hand.
Turn your left foot out about 45 degrees and keep your right foot pointing forward.
Keep your right arm straight and your eyes on the kettlebell as you bend your upper body to the left.
Slide your left hand down your left leg toward the floor, going as low as you can.
Push through your right foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side bend with a kettlebell held straight overhead while your free hand slides down your leg toward the floor. It works the abs and obliques, and your shoulder works to hold the weight steady.

name: Kick Out Sit
instructions: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your thighs are level with the floor, feet hip-width apart.
Hold your arms straight out to your sides at shoulder height.
Straighten one knee to kick that leg out in front of you, level with your hip.
Lower the foot back to the floor, then kick out the other leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A wall sit where you kick one leg straight out at a time while holding the low position. It works the quads, with help from the glutes.

name: Landmine 180
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell into a landmine or a corner so it stays on the floor.
Stand facing the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold the loose end with both hands, arms straight, beside one hip.
Turn your hips and shoulders to swing the bar end in an arc across the front of your body to your other hip.
Swing it back the other way, keeping your arms straight. Keep alternating sides.
description: A twisting core move with a barbell anchored at one end, swinging the free end in an arc from hip to hip. It works the abs and obliques.

name: Leg Pull in Flat Bench
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, hips near one end, and hold the sides of the bench by your hips.
Lift your legs and bend your knees in toward your chest.
Straighten your legs out in front of you until they're just above the level of the bench.
Bend your knees and pull them back in toward your chest.
description: A lying ab move on a bench where you pull your knees in to your chest, then push your legs straight out. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Alternating Narrow Grip Seated Row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate to fit you. Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Hold the narrow handles with your palms facing each other. Keep your chest up and your shoulders back.
Pull one handle toward your body while the other stays still, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let it return slowly until your arm is straight, then pull with the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A chest-supported machine row that pulls narrow handles one arm at a time. It works the upper back.

name: Assisted Chinup
instructions: Set the weight stack to the amount of help you need, then kneel on the pad.
Grab the handles above you, hands about shoulder-width apart. Hang with your arms straight and your body upright.
Pull yourself up, leading with your chest, until your chin is above the handles.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A chin-up on a machine that takes some of your body weight, so you can do full reps before you can do them alone. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body. Sit with your back against the pad, secure your feet and hold the handles.
Lean forward slowly, letting your back round slightly, until you feel a stretch in your lower back.
Push back against the pad with your back muscles until you're sitting upright again.
description: A seated machine exercise where you lean forward, then push your upper body back against a pad. It works the lower back, plus the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Landmine T-Bar Row
instructions: Load one end of a barbell with plates and wedge the other end in a landmine holder or a corner.
Straddle the bar, facing the plates. Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, back flat.
Grip the bar just behind the plates with both hands, one in front of the other, palms facing each other.
Pull the bar up until the plates nearly touch your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row with one end of a barbell fixed to the floor, pulling the loaded end up to your chest. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit with your upper arms resting on the pad in front of you, at shoulder height.
Grip the handles with your palms facing up, arms straight.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl on a machine, with your upper arms resting on a pad at shoulder height. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit in the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grab the handles with your palms facing down and your elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Push the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Let the handles come back slowly until your elbows are bent to 90 degrees again.
description: A chest press done sitting in a machine, pushing the handles forward from your chest. It works the chest.

name: Machine Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside a lever deadlift machine, between the two handles, feet about hip-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor and grip the handles at your sides, palms facing in toward your legs.
Keep your chest up and your back flat, and push through your feet to stand up straight.
Bend your knees and hips to lower slowly until your thighs are about level with the floor again.
description: A deadlift done on a lever machine, holding handles at your sides instead of a bar in front. It works the glutes, hamstrings and quads.

name: Front Pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees fit under the pads and your feet are flat on the floor.
Grab the handles with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Sit upright with your chest lifted, shoulders back and a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down toward your chest.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated pulldown on a lever machine, pulling handles from overhead down to your chest. It works the lats, the wide muscles along the sides of your back.

name: High Row
instructions: Adjust the seat and foot platform to fit you. Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the platform.
Reach up and hold the handles with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the handles down and back toward your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated machine row that pulls handles down and back from above your head, with your chest against a pad. It works the upper back, plus the biceps and the backs of the shoulders.

name: Kneeling Twist
instructions: Kneel on the machine's turning pad with your upper body facing forward. Hold the handles in front of your chest.
Keep your upper body still and braced on the handles.
Twist your hips to turn the pad to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return slowly to the middle, then twist to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A machine twist done kneeling: your hips turn the pad side to side while your upper body stays braced on the handles. It works the abs and the obliques at your sides.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit with your back against the pad.
Bend your elbows and rest your arms against the side pads, holding the handles with your palms facing down.
Raise your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are level with the floor. Keep your elbows bent the whole time.
Lower your arms slowly back to your sides.
description: A shoulder raise done sitting at a machine, lifting your bent arms out to the sides against pads. It works the side of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body.
Sit with your back against the backrest and the foot pad resting against the front of your ankles.
Hold the handles or the sides of the seat to stay steady.
Straighten your knees to lift the pad until your legs are straight.
Lower the pad slowly back down.
description: A seated machine exercise, straightening your knees to lift a pad with your lower legs. It works the quads on the front of the thigh.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body. Lie face down with your legs straight and the pad against the backs of your ankles.
Hold the handles or the sides of the machine.
Keep your hips on the pad and curl your heels up toward your glutes as far as you can.
Lower your legs slowly until they're straight again.
description: A machine curl done lying face down, bending your knees to lift a pad behind your ankles. It works the hamstrings on the back of the thigh.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grip the handles with your palms facing forward, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles up until your arms are straight, without locking your elbows.
Lower the handles slowly back down.
description: A seated shoulder press on a machine, pushing the handles up overhead. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper chest.

name: Narrow Grip Seated Row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests. Sit with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Lean slightly forward with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and pull both handles toward your body.
Let the handles go forward slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated machine row with your chest against a pad, pulling narrow handles with your palms facing each other. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Single Arm Landmine Row
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner and load the other end. Stand beside the loaded end, facing away from the anchor.
Push your hips back, bend your knees and lean forward until your chest is angled toward the floor, back flat.
Grab the bar just behind the plates with one hand, palm facing your body, arm straight.
Pull the bar up toward your lower chest, driving your elbow back.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm row where you pull up the loaded end of a barbell while the other end stays on the floor. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Overhand Tricep Dip
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, and sit with the pad holding your legs in place.
Grip the handles at your sides with your palms facing down. Start with the handles at chest level, elbows bent and pointing back.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Let the handles rise slowly until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
description: A dip done on a seated machine, pushing handles down from chest level while your body stays in place. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit in the machine with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and your elbows on the pad as you curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower the handles slowly back down.
description: A machine curl with your upper arms resting on a pad, which stops you from swinging. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down on the machine's pad with your hips at the back edge and your legs hanging straight down.
Hold the handles at the front, palms facing each other, and hook your ankles between the roller pads.
Keep your legs straight and raise them up behind you until they are level with your body.
Lower slowly until your legs hang straight down again.
description: A machine exercise where you lie face down and swing your straight legs up behind you against a weighted lever. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat height so your knees fit under the pad.
Put the balls of your feet on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge. Hold the handles or the sides of the seat.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A calf raise done sitting in a machine, with a pad holding your knees down. It works the calves.

name: Seated Crunch
instructions: Sit on the ab crunch machine with the pad across your upper chest. Hook your feet behind the roller pads near the floor.
Hold the handles at each end of the chest pad, palms facing you.
Curl your upper body forward and down, pushing the pad toward your thighs.
Return slowly until you are sitting upright.
description: A machine crunch done sitting up, curling your chest down toward your thighs against a weighted pad. It works the abs, with some help from the obliques.

name: Seated Fly
instructions: Sit on the fly machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat. Set the seat so the handles line up with your chest.
Grab the upright handles with your arms out to the sides, elbows slightly bent, palms facing forward.
Bring your arms together in a wide arc until the handles meet in front of your chest.
Let your arms open slowly back out to the sides.
description: A machine fly done seated, sweeping your arms from out wide to together in front of your chest. It works the chest, with help from the front of the shoulders.

name: Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees bend at a right angle. Sit with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Rest the outsides of your thighs against the pads and hold the side handles to keep steady.
Push your knees apart slowly against the pads.
Bring your legs slowly back together.
description: A seated machine exercise where you push your knees apart against pads on the outsides of your thighs. It works the outer hips.

name: Seated Hip Adduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit with your back against the backrest.
Put your feet on the footrests, start with your legs wide apart, and hold the handles to keep steady.
Squeeze your legs together slowly, using your inner thighs.
Let your legs open slowly back out wide.
description: A seated machine exercise where you squeeze your legs together from a wide start. It works the inner thighs.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad. Rest the backs of your lower legs on the lower pad, just above your heels, and lower the thigh pad onto your thighs.
Hold the handles at your sides.
Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back under the seat as far as you can.
Let the pad rise slowly until your legs are straight again.
description: A machine curl done sitting down, bending your knees against a pad under your lower legs. It works the hamstrings on the back of the thigh.

name: Neutral Grip Seated Reverse Fly
instructions: Sit facing the machine, chest against the pad, feet flat on the floor. Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Grab the handles in front of you with your palms facing each other (thumbs up), arms almost straight.
Sweep your arms back and out to the sides until they're in line with your shoulders.
Return slowly until your hands are back in front of you.
description: A machine fly done facing the chest pad, moving your arms backward with your palms facing each other. It works the back of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Seated Reverse Fly
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grab the handles with your palms facing down, arms slightly bent.
Open your arms wide, pulling the handles out and back away from your body.
Let the handles come back slowly to the front.
description: A reverse fly done sitting in a machine with your chest against a pad, opening your arms wide and back. It works the backs of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Shrug
instructions: Stand inside a plate-loaded shrug machine, between the handles, with your feet hip-width apart.
Grip the handles at your sides with your palms facing your thighs, and stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can, keeping your arms straight.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug done standing between the handles of a plate-loaded lever machine. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height. Stand with your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width apart, and hold the handles.
Raise your heels as high as you can, pushing up onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A calf raise on a standing machine, with pads on your shoulders adding weight as you lift your heels. It works the calves.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Stand on the footplates of a lever T-bar row machine, facing the handles. Bend your knees and lean forward from your hips, back flat.
Grip the handles with your arms straight, palms facing each other.
Pull the handles up toward your stomach, bringing your elbows back past your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row on a lever machine, standing on footplates with no chest pad. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on the machine and lean forward so your upper arms rest on the arm pad in front of you.
Grip the handles near your chin, palms facing away from you.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and straighten your elbows, pushing the handles forward and down until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring the handles back toward your chin.
description: A seated machine extension where your upper arms rest on a pad and you straighten your elbows to push the handles forward. It works the triceps.

name: Side Lying Quads Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Bend your top knee and hold your ankle or foot with your hand.
Pull your foot gently toward your glutes until you feel a stretch in the front of your thigh.
Hold for the set time, then let go and switch sides.
description: A stretch for the front of the thigh, done lying on your side and pulling your top foot back toward your glutes. It stretches the quads.

name: Lying Leg Raise Flat Bench
instructions: Lie face up on a flat bench, pressing your back into it, and put your hands under your glutes for support.
Keep your legs straight and together and lift them until they point at the ceiling.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
description: A leg raise done lying on a flat bench, lifting your straight legs until they point at the ceiling. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Wall March Sit
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Slide down the wall until your knees are bent at a right angle.
Lift your right foot and bring that knee toward your chest, then lower it.
Lift your left knee toward your chest the same way. Keep alternating sides, staying low against the wall.
description: A wall sit where you lift one knee at a time toward your chest, like marching in place. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Monster Walk
instructions: Stand with your feet close together, knees slightly bent and hands on your hips.
Take a wide step to the side with one foot.
Bring your other foot in until your feet are close together again.
Do all your reps to one side, then switch.
description: A side-stepping walk with your knees slightly bent and hands on your hips. It works the glutes, especially at the sides of your hips.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank with your arms straight, hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Drive your right knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, bringing your left knee toward your chest as your right leg goes back.
Keep alternating legs at a steady pace, like running, and keep your hips low.
description: A running motion done in a high plank, driving your knees toward your chest one at a time. It raises your heart rate and works the abs, shoulders and triceps.

name: Ring Muscle Up
instructions: Hang from gymnastic rings with your arms straight, using a false grip: wrists hooked over the rings.
Pull yourself up hard and fast, bringing your chest toward the rings.
Lean forward at the top of the pull and bring your hands from below the rings to above them.
Press up by straightening your arms until you're holding yourself above the rings.
Lower yourself back down slowly, reversing the movement.
description: An advanced gymnastics move on rings that joins a pullup and a dip in one motion, ending with your arms straight above the rings. It mainly works the lats and takes great upper body strength.

name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench so your head is lower than your feet. Hook your ankles under the foot rollers.
Place your hands behind your head, elbows out to the sides.
Curl your head and shoulders up off the bench, keeping your lower back on the pad.
Lower slowly back down.
description: A crunch on a decline bench, head lower than your feet, which makes it harder than a crunch on the floor. It works the abs.

name: Oblique Crunches Floor
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and let both legs drop to one side, stacked, so your knees rest on the floor.
Place one hand behind your head and rest the other across your stomach.
Curl your head and shoulders up off the floor, keeping your knees down.
Lower slowly back down. Do all your reps on one side, then drop your knees to the other side.
description: A floor crunch done with both knees dropped to one side, which puts more of the work on the side of your waist. It works the abs and the obliques.

name: Single Arm Chinup
instructions: Stand facing a pullup bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with one hand, palm facing you, and hold that wrist with your other hand for support.
Hang with your arm straight and your body held straight and tight.
Bend your elbow to pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: An advanced chinup done with one arm, your free hand holding the working wrist for support. It works the lats and takes a very strong grip.

name: Single Arm Dip
instructions: Sit next to a flat bench with your side to it and place the hand nearest it on the bench, beside your hip.
Stretch your legs out straight in front of you, off the floor, and straighten that arm to lift your hips. Reach your free arm forward.
Bend your elbow to lower your hips toward the floor, keeping your side close to the bench.
Push through your palm to straighten your arm. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm dip with your hand on a bench beside you and your legs stretched out in front. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Medicine Ball Single Arm Slam
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball in one hand in front of your waist.
Bend your knees slightly and tighten your abs.
Lift the ball above your head until your arm is straight.
Slam the ball down onto the floor as hard as you can, driving with your abs and shoulder.
Catch the ball on the bounce and lift it overhead again.
description: A slam done with one arm: lift a medicine ball overhead, then throw it hard into the floor. It works the abs, with help from the shoulders and back.

name: Outside Leg Kick Pushup
instructions: Start in a pushup position, hands under your shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, then push back up.
As you push up, lift your right hand off the floor and bring it to your hip, and kick your left leg out in front of you, turning your hips open.
Bring your hand and leg back to the pushup position.
On the next rep, lift your left hand and kick out your right leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A pushup that adds a twist at the top: one hand comes off the floor while the opposite leg kicks out in front. It works the chest, shoulders and arms, plus the glutes and core as you kick and turn.

name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, or sit up straight.
Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand reaches down toward the opposite shoulder blade.
Pull the elbow gently toward the other side of your head with your free hand until you feel a stretch.
Hold for the set time, then let go and switch sides.
description: A stretch for the back of the upper arm: bend one arm overhead and gently pull the elbow across with your other hand. It stretches the triceps and shoulders.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Stand over a barbell on the floor, feet shoulder-width apart. Bend down and grip it with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the bar off the floor by straightening your hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull hard and fast once the bar passes mid-thigh, shrugging your shoulders and lifting your elbows high and out to the sides.
Drop under the bar as it peaks, swing your elbows around and catch it on the front of your shoulders in a squat.
Stand up with the bar, straightening your hips and knees.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control.
description: An Olympic lift that brings a barbell from the floor to your shoulders in one fast move. It works the hamstrings, glutes, quads and calves, and takes strength, timing and practice.

name: Pullup
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together and tighten your abs.
Bend your elbows to pull your chest up toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A bodyweight exercise, hanging from a bar with your palms facing away and pulling your chest up toward it. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Wall Pushup
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back a few feet, with your feet hip-width apart and your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the wall, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup done standing, with your hands on a wall. It's an easier version of the floor pushup that works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Pushup Inside Leg Kick
instructions: Start in a pushup position, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and feet together.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your back straight.
At the bottom, lift one foot off the floor and bend that knee.
Put the foot back down and push up until your arms are straight.
Use the other leg on the next pushup. Keep alternating legs.
description: A pushup where you lift one leg off the floor, knee bent, at the bottom of each rep. It works the glutes and core, along with the chest and arms.

name: Pushup
instructions: Get into a plank on your hands, arms straight, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and feet together.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A basic floor pushup, lowering and raising your body with your arms while keeping it straight from head to heels. It works the chest, plus the triceps and shoulders.

name: Pushup to Side Plank
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your body toward the floor, then push back up.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and turn your body to the right, reaching your right arm up to the ceiling.
Hold the side plank for a few seconds, then come back to the pushup position.
Do another pushup and turn to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A pushup followed by a turn into a side plank with your top arm reaching up. It works the abs, plus the chest, shoulders and triceps, and tests your balance.

name: Pushup with Arm Raise
instructions: Get into a pushup position on your toes, hands under your shoulders, arms straight, body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest until it's just above the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Lift one hand and reach it forward and up past your head, keeping your hips level.
Put the hand back down and do the next pushup, raising the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A pushup with a reach at the top: you lift one hand and stretch it forward past your head. It works the chest, with help from the triceps, shoulders and abs.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, about hip-width apart. Rest your arms at your sides, palms facing down.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A floor exercise where you lie on your back and lift your hips with your knees bent. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Rear Deltoid Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bring your left arm straight across your chest and place your right hand on your left elbow.
Gently pull your left arm toward your right shoulder until you feel a stretch in your left shoulder.
Hold for the set time, then let go and switch arms.
description: A standing stretch that pulls one arm across your chest. It stretches the back of the shoulder and the upper back.

name: Ring Dips
instructions: Grip the rings and hold yourself up above them with your arms straight and your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your shoulders drop below your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip done on gymnastic rings, which move freely, so you need extra strength and balance to stay steady. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Treadmill Run (Time)
instructions: Stand on the treadmill's side rails, one foot on each side of the belt. Clip the safety cord to your clothes if there is one.
Start the belt at a slow walking pace, step on, and walk to warm up.
Raise the speed bit by bit to your running pace.
Run tall with your arms swinging naturally at your sides, landing on the middle of your foot and pushing off with your toes.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Running on a motorized treadmill, where you control the speed and incline. It trains your heart and lungs.

name: Run (Time)
instructions: Warm up with a short walk or an easy jog.
Run at a comfortable pace, landing on the middle of your foot.
Keep your arms bent at 90 degrees and let them swing naturally with each stride.
Stay upright with your head up and your shoulders relaxed.
Keep going for the set time.
description: A run at your own pace, outdoors or on a track, tracked by time. It builds endurance and works your heart, lungs and leg muscles.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Lean back a little, keeping your back straight, and clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Keep your feet on the floor and twist your upper body to the right, bringing your hands toward your right side.
Twist to the left, bringing your hands toward your left side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated twist: lean back with your feet on the floor and turn your upper body from side to side. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Scapular Pullup
instructions: Grab a pullup bar with your palms facing away from you and hang with your arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together so your body rises a little. Keep your arms straight the whole time.
Let your shoulders rise slowly back toward your ears until you're in a full hang again.
description: A small pull from a straight-arm hang where only your shoulder blades move, not your elbows. It works the traps across your upper back and builds shoulder control.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
instructions: Sit on the edge of a flat bench with your legs stretched out in front of you.
Hold the sides of the bench just behind your hips and lean back slightly.
Bend your knees and pull them in toward your chest, bringing your upper body forward to meet them.
Straighten your legs back out and lean back to the start.
description: A seated knee tuck on the edge of a bench, pulling your knees in toward your chest and stretching your legs back out. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Seated Overhead Lat Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor. Let one arm hang at your side.
Raise your other arm straight up overhead.
Reach that hand higher and slightly over your head, leaning a little to the other side, until you feel a stretch under your raised arm.
Hold for the set time, then return slowly to sitting upright and switch arms.
description: A seated stretch where you reach one arm straight overhead and lean slightly away from it. It stretches the lats along the side of your back.

name: Wall Seated Side Crunch
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and slide down until your thighs are level with the floor. Hold this wall sit the whole time.
Rest one hand on your hip and let the other arm hang at your side.
Lean your upper body toward the hanging arm, sliding that hand down your side.
Come back upright, then lean to the other side, switching hands. Keep alternating sides.
description: A side bend done while holding a wall sit. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides, while your thighs hold you in place.

name: Shoulder Tap Pushup
instructions: Get into a pushup position with your arms straight, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, and your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up. At the top, lift your right hand, tap your left shoulder, and put the hand back down.
Do the next pushup and tap your right shoulder with your left hand. Keep alternating sides, and keep your hips level as you tap.
description: A pushup with a tap to the opposite shoulder at the top of each rep. It works the chest and triceps, while your abs work to keep your hips steady during the tap.

name: Captain's Chair Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Support yourself in a captain's chair with your back against the pad and your forearms on the arm pads.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other and let your legs hang down.
Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest, turning your hips so your knees point toward one side.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A knee raise in a captain's chair where your knees come up toward one side instead of straight ahead. It works the abs and the obliques on the sides of your waist.

name: Side Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side, propped up on your bottom forearm, legs straight and stacked. Put your top hand on the floor in front of you.
Keep your top leg straight and lift it until it's about 45 degrees from the floor, without rolling your hips back.
Lower it slowly back onto your bottom leg.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side-lying leg raise where you lift your straight top leg up and lower it. It works the outer hips, with help from the glutes.

name: Side Push Neck Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your left hand on your hip. You can also do this sitting.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Reach your right hand up and rest it on your head, then pull gently to deepen the stretch.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.
description: A neck stretch: tilt your ear toward your shoulder and use the hand on that side to gently pull your head further. It stretches the sides of the neck and the tops of the shoulders.

name: Side Pushup
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, and wrap your bottom arm across your waist.
Place your top hand flat on the floor in front of your chest.
Press through your top hand to straighten that arm and lift your upper body off the floor. Keep your hips and legs on the floor.
Lower slowly until your head is near the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A pushup done lying on your side, pressing your upper body up with your top arm. It works the triceps, with help from the shoulders, chest and core.

name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm straight across the front of your chest at shoulder height.
With your other hand, take hold of its fingers and gently pull them back toward you until you feel a stretch in your forearm.
Hold for the set time, then release and switch arms.
description: A standing stretch where you hold one arm across your chest and pull its fingers back with the other hand. It stretches the forearm and wrist.

name: Single Arm Pushup
instructions: Get into a pushup position with your feet wide apart. Put one hand on the floor under your chest and the other behind your back.
Keep your body straight and your hips level.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest until it's just above the floor.
Push back up until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A pushup done on one arm, with your feet wide for balance and your free hand behind your back. It works the chest, triceps and shoulders, and your abs keep you from twisting.

name: Lying Heel Slide
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and your arms resting at your sides.
Slide one heel along the floor toward your glutes, bending your knee until it points up at the ceiling.
Keep the other leg straight and flat on the floor.
Slide the heel slowly back out until your leg is straight. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A lying move where you slide one heel toward your glutes and back out, bending and straightening the knee. It works the hamstrings on the back of the thigh.

name: Calf Raise on Leg Press
instructions: Sit in a 45-degree leg press. Put just the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the footplate, heels hanging off.
Release the safety handles and straighten your legs without locking your knees.
Push the sled up with the balls of your feet, pointing your toes.
Lower your heels slowly, letting your calves stretch.
Lock the safety handles back in place when you finish.
description: A calf raise on a leg press machine, pushing the sled with the balls of your feet while your legs stay straight. It works the calves, and the machine lets you use heavy weight safely.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplate of the 45-degree leg press to fit you.
Sit with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate. Hold the handles at your sides.
Push the footplate away by straightening your legs, keeping your heels on the plate. Stop just before your knees lock.
Bend your knees to lower the footplate slowly back toward you.
description: A machine press done sitting back, pushing a weighted footplate up and away from you on a 45-degree slant. It works the glutes, plus the quads, hamstrings and inner thighs.

name: Close Stance Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the hack squat platform with your back against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads and feet close together.
Grip the handles by your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Bend your knees to lower yourself until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Push through your feet to straighten your legs back to the start.
description: A hack squat with your feet close together, your back and shoulders braced against pads. It works the glutes and quads, plus the hamstrings and calves.

name: Forward Angled Calf Raise
instructions: Step into a hack squat machine facing the back pad, chest against it and shoulders under the shoulder pads. Hold the handles.
Stand with your feet flat on the footplate, hip-width apart, and your legs nearly straight.
Raise your heels as high as you can, pushing the pads up with your shoulders.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A standing calf raise done in a hack squat machine while facing the back pad, with the weight on your shoulders. It works the calves.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Set the hack squat machine for your height. Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and your shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, and hold the handles by your shoulders.
Bend your knees and hips to lower yourself until your thighs are level with the floor or a little lower. Keep your back flat against the pad.
Push through your heels to straighten your legs and rise back up.
description: A squat done on an angled machine with your back against a sliding pad that guides the movement. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Lying Squat
instructions: Set the weight, then lie on your back on the machine's sliding bench, shoulders under the pads and feet on the footplate.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart, turned slightly out, and hold the handles by your shoulders.
Push through your heels to straighten your legs, which slides your body away from the footplate.
Bend your knees and hips slowly to slide back toward the footplate.
description: A squat done lying on your back, pushing your body away from a fixed footplate on a machine. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Smith Back Shrug
instructions: Stand with your back to a Smith machine bar set just below hip height. Grip it behind you, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing back.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with your arms straight, the bar resting against the backs of your thighs.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears, keeping your arms straight.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug with a Smith machine bar held behind your thighs instead of in front. It works the traps, the muscles between your neck and shoulders.

name: Smith Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench under the Smith machine bar, with the bar over your chest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing toward your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it until it touches your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A bench press on a Smith machine, where the bar runs on fixed rails. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Bent Knee Good Morning
instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward, and the bar across your upper back, just below your neck.
Bend your knees slightly and push your hips back, leaning your torso forward with your back straight.
Lower until your torso is level with the floor and you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up.
description: A Smith machine good morning with bent knees: lean forward from the hips, bar on your upper back, until your torso is level with the floor. It works the glutes, plus the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Smith Chair Squat
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at a comfortable height and step under it so it rests across your upper back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Keep your chest up as you bend your knees and hips to lower yourself slowly.
Go down until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat on a Smith machine, with the bar across your upper back on fixed rails. It works the quads, with help from the glutes, hamstrings and calves.

name: Smith Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench set under the bar of a Smith machine, with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your hands slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart, arms straight above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A bench press on a Smith machine, which guides the bar on a fixed track, done with your hands close together. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Smith Deadlift
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar low, at about shin height. Stand close to it with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Bend your hips and knees to grab the bar, palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Keep your back straight and chest up.
Stand up by straightening your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body, until you're standing tall.
Bend your hips and knees to lower the bar slowly back down, keeping your back straight.
description: A deadlift done on a Smith machine, where the bar runs on fixed rails, which helps while you learn the move. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings, quads and lower back.

name: Smith Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set a decline bench under the Smith machine at the angle you want. Lie on it with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the bar with your palms facing toward your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it slowly to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A Smith machine bench press on a decline bench, with your head lower than your hips. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Decline Reverse Grip Press
instructions: Set a decline bench in the Smith machine. Lie on it, head lower than your hips, with your feet hooked under the foot pads.
Grip the bar with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it toward your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A decline press on a Smith machine, gripping the bar with your palms facing you instead of away. It works the lower chest, plus the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Hack Squat
instructions: Stand with your back to a Smith machine bar set just below knee height, feet hip-width apart.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you, hands just outside your hips, palms facing back. Unhook it.
Stand up tall with your arms straight until the bar is behind your upper thighs.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down until your thighs are level with the floor. Keep your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
description: A squat holding a Smith machine bar behind your legs with straight arms. It works the glutes and quads.

name: Smith Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set a bench under the Smith machine to a 30 to 45 degree incline.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing toward your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it slowly to your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A Smith machine bench press on a bench set to a 30 to 45 degree incline. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Smith Incline Reverse Grip Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees in a Smith machine, with the bar over your upper chest. Lie back, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart with your palms facing toward your face, then unhook it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
description: An incline press on a Smith machine with your palms facing toward you instead of away. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Incline Shoulder Raises
instructions: Place an incline bench, set to about 30 to 45 degrees, in a Smith machine so the bar sits over your upper chest.
Lie back with your feet flat on the floor. Grip the bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing your feet.
Unhook the bar and press it up until your arms are straight.
Keeping your arms straight, push the bar a few inches higher by lifting your shoulders off the bench.
Let your shoulders sink slowly back to the bench, arms still straight.
description: An incline press where your arms stay straight and only your shoulders move, pushing the bar a few inches higher. It works the serratus, the muscles on your ribs under your armpits, and the shoulders.

name: Smith Leg Press
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar low enough to reach with your feet when you lie under it with your knees bent.
Lie on your back, hips under the bar, arms flat on the floor. Put the soles of your feet on the bar, hip-width apart.
Press the bar up until your legs are straight, then unhook it.
Bend your knees and lower the bar slowly until your knees come in toward your chest.
Press the bar back up until your legs are straight.
description: A leg press done lying on the floor, pushing a Smith machine bar up with the soles of your feet. It works the glutes, quads and hamstrings.

name: Smith Narrow Row
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar, feet hip-width apart. Grip it with your hands a little closer than shoulder-width, palms facing your legs.
Unhook the bar, bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with a flat back, arms hanging straight.
Pull the bar up to your stomach, driving your elbows back.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row on a Smith machine with your hands close together. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and the back of the shoulders.

name: Smith Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar set at knee height, feet hip-width apart. Grip it wider than shoulder-width, palms facing your legs.
Unhook the bar, bend your knees slightly, and lean forward from your hips to about 45 degrees. Keep your back flat.
Pull the bar up toward your body with your elbows pointing out to the sides, until your upper arms are level with your back.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row on a Smith machine with a wide grip and your elbows pointing out to the sides. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Smith Reverse Grip Press
instructions: Set a flat bench in a Smith machine so the bar is over your lower chest. Lie back with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart with your palms facing toward your face, then unhook it.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
description: A flat bench press on a Smith machine with your palms facing toward you instead of away. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the seat so the bar is about shoulder height. Sit with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grab the bar with your palms facing forward and unhook it, holding it at shoulder level in front of your face.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to shoulder level.
description: A shoulder press done seated in a Smith machine, with the bar moving on fixed rails in front of your face. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Smith Wide Grip Shoulder Press
instructions: Set the seat in the Smith machine and sit with your back against the pad, feet flat on the floor and shoulder-width apart.
Grab the bar with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and hold it at shoulder level with your elbows bent.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to shoulder level.
description: A seated shoulder press in a Smith machine, with your hands set wider than your shoulders. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Smith Shrug
instructions: Stand at the Smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your palms facing you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Let your arms hang straight and your shoulders relax.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Lower your shoulders slowly back down.
description: A shrug on a Smith machine, holding the bar in front of your thighs. It works the traps, the muscles that run from your neck to your shoulders.

name: Smith Single Leg Split Squat
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar at shoulder height with a flat bench behind it. Step under the bar so it rests across your upper back.
Hold the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward, and unhook it.
Rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you, front foot flat on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lower until your front thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to rise back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat on a Smith machine with your back foot up on a bench. It works the quads of your front leg, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Smith Split Squat
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar at shoulder height. Step under it so it rests across your upper back.
Hold the bar with your hands wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward, and unhook it.
Step one foot forward and the other back into a long stance, back heel off the floor.
Bend both knees to lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back up without moving your feet. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
