description: A split squat with a Smith machine bar across your upper back, feet staying in place as you lower and rise. It works the glutes and quads, with help from the hamstrings.

name: Smith Standing Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand facing a Smith machine bar set at mid-thigh height, feet hip-width apart. Grip it just outside your thighs, palms facing you.
Unhook the bar and stand tall with your arms straight, the bar resting in front of your thighs.
Raise your heels as high as you can, rising onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
description: A standing calf raise holding a Smith machine bar in front of your thighs with straight arms. It works the calves.

name: Smith Standing Military Press
instructions: Stand at the Smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with your palms facing forward, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and bring it down to shoulder level.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to shoulder level.
description: A standing overhead press on a Smith machine, pushing the bar up from your shoulders. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Smith Upright Row
instructions: Stand facing the Smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing you and your arms straight down, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your back straight and pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: An upright row on a Smith machine, pulling the bar up to your chin with your elbows leading. It works the sides of the shoulders, with help from the traps and biceps.

name: Snatch Pull
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the bar over your toes. Squat down and grip it much wider than your shoulders, palms facing you.
Keep your back flat and your arms straight as you stand up, pushing through your feet and keeping the bar close to your legs.
As the bar passes your thighs, push your hips forward, rise onto your toes and shrug your shoulders up.
Lower the bar slowly back to the floor by bending your hips and knees.
description: A barbell pull from the floor with a wide grip, finishing up on your toes with a shrug instead of catching the bar overhead. It works the quads, hamstrings and glutes.

name: Plank Knee to Elbow
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup, arms straight, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and feet together.
Keeping your arms straight, bring your right knee forward toward your right elbow, keeping the foot off the floor.
Return your right foot to the start.
Bring your left knee toward your left elbow, then return it. Keep alternating sides.
description: A move from the top of a pushup where you bring one knee up toward the same-side elbow, then switch sides. It works the glutes and abs, with your chest, shoulders and arms holding you up.

name: Squat Jerk
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a barbell resting on the front of your shoulders. Hold it just outside your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Dip by bending your knees a few inches, keeping your chest up and your upper body upright.
Drive up hard through your legs and push the bar straight overhead.
As the bar rises, drop into a deep squat and catch it overhead with your arms locked straight.
Stand up with the bar overhead, then lower it back to your shoulders.
description: A fast overhead lift where you drive the bar up from your shoulders and catch it in a deep squat with straight arms. It works the quads, glutes and shoulders and takes speed and balance.

name: Standing Lateral Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Raise one arm and put that hand behind your head, elbow pointing up. Let your other arm hang at your side.
Lean your upper body slowly away from the raised elbow until you feel a stretch along that side.
Hold for the set time, then come back up to standing straight and switch sides.
description: A standing side bend with one hand behind your head and that elbow pointing up. It stretches the lats and the side of your waist.

name: Standing Single Leg Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot off the floor, bending your knee.
Curl your right heel slowly up toward your glutes.
Lower your right foot slowly back down.
Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A standing bodyweight curl: balance on one leg and bend the other knee to bring your heel toward your glutes. It works the hamstrings and glutes and tests your balance.

name: Standing Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and an ab wheel on the floor in front of you.
Bend at your waist and hold the wheel's handles.
Roll the wheel slowly forward with your back straight until your body is stretched out as far as you can go.
Roll the wheel slowly back toward your feet.
description: An advanced ab wheel rollout started from standing, not from your knees. It works the abs, with help from the lower back and shoulders.

name: Stationary Bike Walk
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position on the bike to fit you.
Put your feet on the pedals, tighten the straps if there are any, and hold the handlebars.
Pedal at an easy, comfortable pace with your back straight.
Keep a steady rhythm, adding resistance if you want it harder. Keep going for the set time.
description: Easy, steady pedaling on an upright stationary bike. It works your heart and lungs, plus the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Superman Pushup
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight, toes tucked under, and arms stretched out past your head, palms flat on the floor.
Press your hands into the floor and lift your chest, hips and legs off the floor together, so only your hands and toes touch it.
Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels at the top, without letting your hips sag.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
description: An advanced pushup done with your arms stretched out past your head, lifting your whole body off the floor from your hands and toes. It works the chest, shoulders and abs.

name: Suspended Abdominal Fallout
instructions: Attach a suspension trainer or a pair of rings to a high anchor, with the handles at waist height.
Stand with the straps hanging just in front of you, holding the handles in front of your hips with straight arms.
Lean your whole body forward in a straight line, letting your arms rise overhead. Go as low as you can while keeping control.
Pull your body back up to standing, bringing your arms back down in front of you.
description: A standing ab exercise with suspension straps or rings: lean your straight body forward as your arms reach overhead, then pull back up. It works the abs, plus the obliques and the front of the hips.

name: Suspended Pushup
instructions: Set a suspension trainer or a pair of rings so the handles hang a few inches above the floor. Hold one in each hand, palms facing down.
Walk your feet back into a pushup position, arms straight under your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest between the handles until it's level with your hands. Don't let the handles drift apart.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your hands in suspension trainer handles or rings just above the floor, so you have to keep the handles steady. It works the chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Suspended Row
instructions: Hang under a pair of low gymnastic rings, holding one in each hand with your palms facing your feet.
Keep your arms straight, your heels on the floor, and your body straight and nearly level with the floor.
Pull your chest up to the rings, drawing your shoulder blades together and keeping your body straight.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A row on gymnastic rings where you pull your own body up from a nearly flat lean. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Suspended Split Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from a suspension trainer or ring, with the foot cradle hanging at about knee height behind you.
Bend one knee and hook the top of that foot into the cradle. Stand tall on the other leg, arms at your sides.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A split squat with your back foot resting in a suspension trainer strap or ring behind you. It works the quads, glutes and hamstrings of your front leg.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar on the floor with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your hips and knees to reach down and grip the side handles, palms facing your legs.
Keeping your back straight and chest up, push through your heels to stand up straight.
Lower the bar back to the floor by bending your hips and knees, keeping your back straight.
description: A deadlift with a six-sided bar you stand inside, holding handles at your sides. It keeps you more upright than a barbell deadlift and works the glutes, hamstrings, quads and lower back.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Grip the parallel bars of a dip station, palms facing each other, and press up until your arms are straight.
Bend your knees slightly so your feet stay off the floor, and keep your body upright.
Bend your elbows and lower your body, leaning forward slightly, until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip on parallel bars, lowering and pushing up your whole body with your arms. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Tricep Dips Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent and feet flat. Put your palms on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Straighten your arms to lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your hips almost touch the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip done sitting on the floor with your hands behind you and knees bent, lifting and lowering your hips with your arms. It works the triceps, with some help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
instructions: Step into a knee-raise station, back against the pad. Rest your forearms on the arm pads, hold the handles and let your legs hang.
Lift your knees up in front of you until your thighs are level with the floor.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight again.
description: A knee raise done propped up on your forearms in an upright station, lifting your knees to hip height. It works the abs and the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: Weighted Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your legs so your thighs point up and your knees are bent, feet in the air.
Hold a weight plate flat above your chest with straight arms, hands on opposite edges, palms facing each other.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor, pushing the plate straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your shoulders slowly back to the floor, keeping your arms straight and your legs still.
description: A crunch with your legs raised, reaching a weight plate toward the ceiling with straight arms. It works the abs, with some help from the obliques.

name: Weighted Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a weight plate in front of your thighs, hands on opposite edges, palms facing each other.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the plate in front of you to shoulder height without leaning back.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.
description: A front raise holding one weight plate in both hands instead of a dumbbell in each. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Weighted Pullup
instructions: Put on a dip belt (a belt that goes around your hips) and hang a weight plate from it.
Grab a pullup bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, and hang with your arms straight.
Pull yourself up, bringing your elbows down toward your sides, until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A pullup with a weight plate hung from a belt around your hips for extra load. It works the lats, the large muscles down the sides of your back, plus the biceps and forearms.

name: Bus Driver
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a weight plate by its sides, palms facing each other, out in front at shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and turn the plate to one side like a steering wheel, as far as it comfortably goes.
Turn it back through the middle and as far the other way. Keep alternating sides, holding the plate at shoulder height.
description: A shoulder move where you hold a weight plate out at shoulder height and turn it from side to side like a steering wheel. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Legs Up Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Lean back and lift your legs off the floor, together and nearly straight, so your body makes a V shape.
Twist your upper body to the right, bringing the plate toward the floor on your right side.
Twist to the left, bringing the plate toward the floor on your left side. Keep alternating sides with your legs up.
description: A Russian twist done holding a weight plate, with your legs raised off the floor and nearly straight. It works the abs, especially the obliques along your sides, and the front of your hips.

name: Weighted Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet hooked under a support.
Hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands. Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight.
Twist your upper body to the right, bringing the plate toward the floor on your right side.
Twist to the left, bringing the plate toward the floor on your left side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated twist holding a weight plate, leaning back slightly and turning side to side. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand beside an incline bench. Hold the top of the backrest with one hand and a weight plate to your chest with the other.
Rise onto your toes and push your knees forward and down as you lean back, keeping a straight line from knees to head.
Lower until your thighs are almost level with the floor.
Push through the balls of your feet to bring your knees back and stand up tall.
description: A squat where you rise onto your toes, push your knees forward and lean back, holding a weight plate to your chest and a bench for balance. It works the quads.

name: Weighted Squat Between Benches
instructions: Place two flat benches side by side with a gap between them. Put on a dip belt with a weight plate hanging from it.
Stand with one foot on each bench, the plate hanging in the gap, and hold your arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Bend your knees and lower your hips until your thighs are level with the floor, letting the plate sink between the benches.
Push through your feet to stand back up. Don't let your knees cave in.
description: A squat with a weight plate hanging from a belt between your legs, standing on two benches so the plate can drop below your feet. It works the glutes and quads.

name: Weighted Standing Curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a weight plate upright in front of your thighs by its top edge, palms facing you.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the plate up to chest height.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done with one weight plate held by its top edge in both hands, palms facing you. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Pinch a weight plate by its top edge in one hand, palm facing your thigh.
Keep your fingers on the outer face of the plate and your thumb on the side facing your leg.
Let your arm hang straight at your side and squeeze hard so the plate doesn't slip.
Hold for the set time, then switch hands.
description: A grip hold where you pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb at your side, one hand at a time. It works the forearms and grip.

name: Weighted Svend Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a weight plate in front of your chest, squeezed between your palms.
Keep squeezing and press the plate straight out in front of you until your arms are straight.
Bring the plate slowly back to your chest.
description: A standing press that squeezes a weight plate between your palms and pushes it straight out from your chest. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on the floor with an ab wheel in front of you.
Hold the handles with your arms straight out in front of you.
Roll the wheel slowly forward with your back straight until your body is nearly stretched out and your arms reach past your head.
Roll the wheel slowly back toward your knees.
description: An ab wheel rollout done from your knees, rolling out until your body is nearly straight and then pulling back. It works the abs, with help from the lower back.

name: Cable Bent Over Tricep Kickback
instructions: Attach a handle to a low pulley and hold it in one hand, palm facing in. Face the machine and step back, opposite foot forward.
Bend forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with your knees slightly bent. Rest your free hand on your front thigh.
Keeping your arm nearly straight, pull the handle back past your hip as far as you can.
Let your arm swing slowly forward until your hand is in front of your thigh. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A bent-over cable move where you pull a nearly straight arm back past your hip, one arm at a time. It works the triceps and the backs of the shoulders.

name: Cable Seated Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down. Lean forward with your arms straight out, back flat and shoulders relaxed.
Sit up tall as you pull the bar to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the bar go back slowly, leaning forward again until your arms are straight.
description: A seated cable row, pulling a bar from a forward lean in to your stomach. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable High to Low Woodchop
instructions: Set a cable pulley at its highest point with a single handle. Stand side-on to the machine, feet wider than your shoulders.
Reach up and hold the handle with both hands, one wrapped over the other, arms straight toward the pulley.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the handle down and across your body to outside your far hip, turning your shoulders and bending your knees.
Let the handle rise slowly back to the start. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A cable chop from high to low, pulling a handle diagonally down across your body as you turn. It works the abs and obliques.

name: Dumbbell Lying External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor with your head resting on your lower arm.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, palm facing down, in front of your belly. Keep that elbow bent 90 degrees and against your side.
Rotate your forearm up as far as you can, keeping your upper arm against your side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your belly. Do all your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying shoulder rotation, turning a dumbbell up from your belly while your bent elbow stays pinned to your side. It works the rear shoulder and the small muscles that rotate it.

name: Dumbbell Standing External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand. Put your other hand on your hip.
Raise your working arm out to the side to shoulder height. Bend that elbow 90 degrees so the dumbbell hangs down.
Rotate your forearm up until the dumbbell is above your elbow, keeping your upper arm still.
Lower it slowly back down until your forearm points at the floor.
description: A standing shoulder rotation with your upper arm held out at shoulder height, turning a dumbbell from pointing down to pointing up. It works the rear shoulder and the small muscles that rotate it.

name: Lying Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, legs straight out past the end. Hold the bench beside your head with both hands.
Bend your knees and pull them in toward your chest.
Keep pulling until your hips curl up off the bench.
Lower your hips and straighten your legs slowly until they're back out level with the bench.
description: A lying knee tuck on a flat bench that ends with your hips curling up off the pad. It works the abs.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you, and a dumbbell held upright between your feet.
Bend your knees and pull them up to your chest, curling your hips up.
Lower your legs slowly until you hang straight again. Don't swing.
description: A hanging knee raise with a dumbbell squeezed between your feet for extra weight. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Attach a bar to the low pulley and stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up and your elbows close to your sides.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl with a bar on a low cable pulley, which keeps tension on the biceps through the whole lift. It works the biceps.

name: Butt Up
instructions: Get into a forearm plank: elbows under your shoulders, forearms on the floor, hands in loose fists, legs straight and up on your toes.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling until your body makes an upside-down V. Keep your forearms and feet where they are.
Lower your hips slowly until your body is straight from head to heels again.
description: A forearm plank where you lift your hips up high and lower them back down. It works the abs.

name: Tuck Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your legs off the floor, knees bent and feet in the air.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders up off the floor toward your knees, keeping your legs still.
Lower your shoulders slowly back to the floor.
description: A crunch with your legs held up and bent, so only your upper body moves. It works the abs.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms flat along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor until your thighs point straight up.
Tighten your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs point straight up again.
description: A crunch done by curling your hips off the floor and bringing your knees toward your chest. It works the abs, especially the lower part.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
instructions: Strap your ankles to a low pulley and lie on your back, feet toward the machine, arms at your sides, palms down.
Lift your legs so your thighs point straight up and your knees are bent, lower legs level with the floor.
Curl your hips off the floor, pulling your knees in toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor, keeping your knees bent.
description: A reverse crunch with a low cable strapped to your ankles, curling your hips off the floor against the pull. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Cable Standing Crunch
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Stand with your back to the machine and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope with both hands beside your head, elbows bent, with the rope running behind your head.
Use your abs to crunch your upper body forward and down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Rise back up slowly to standing tall.
description: A crunch done standing with your back to a high cable, curling your upper body down while holding a rope at your head. It works the abs, with help from the obliques.

name: Band Alternating Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold an end in each hand with your palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl one hand up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing band curl done one arm at a time, switching arms each rep. It works the biceps.

name: Band Assisted Pullup
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a pullup bar so it hangs down in a loop.
Grab the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than your shoulders, and rest your knees in the loop.
Hang with your arms straight and your shoulders pulled down and back.
Drive your elbows down toward your hips to pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup with a resistance band under your knees to take off some of your weight, a way to build up to regular pullups. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Band Close Grip Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high above you, slightly in front, and sit on a box facing it with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach up and hold the handles with your hands close together, palms facing each other.
Pull your elbows down and back until your hands reach the top of your chest, leaning back slightly.
Let your arms rise slowly until they are straight again.
description: A seated pulldown on a band anchored overhead, with your hands close together. It works the lats along the sides of your back, with the biceps helping.

name: Band Close Grip Pushup
instructions: Lay a band across your upper back and hold one end flat on the floor under each hand.
Get into a pushup position with your hands under your shoulders, palms flat, and your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest almost to the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your hands under your shoulders and a band across your upper back, pinned under each hand for extra resistance. It works the triceps, with the chest and shoulders helping.

name: Band Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your legs wide apart and your feet flat on the floor.
Step on one end of a resistance band with one foot and hold the other end in the hand on that side.
Lean forward a little and rest that elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Curl your hand toward your shoulder, palm facing up, without moving your upper arm.
Lower your hand slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A seated one-arm band curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh, which keeps you from swinging the band up. It works the biceps.

name: Band Front Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand on one end of a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the other end in one hand at your thigh, palm facing your thigh.
Raise your straight arm in front of you until it is level with your shoulder.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
description: A one-arm front raise with a resistance band under your foot, lifting your straight arm to shoulder height. It works the shoulders.

name: Band Front Raise
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and raise them forward until they are level with the floor, at shoulder height.
Lower your arms slowly back to your thighs.
description: A front raise against a resistance band under your feet, lifting both straight arms to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulders.

name: Band Horizontal Pallof Press
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor at chest height.
Stand side-on to the anchor with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold the handle with both hands and step away until the band is tight.
Bring your hands to the middle of your chest, elbows bent and close to your body.
Push your hands straight out in front of you without letting the band turn your body. Hold for a few seconds.
Bring your hands slowly back to your chest.
description: A standing core move where you press a band straight out from your chest while it pulls you sideways, and you stop your body from turning. It works the abs and obliques.

name: Band Bent Over Kickback
instructions: Loop a band around one ankle and anchor the other end low, near the floor, in front of you.
Face a wall, lean forward and press both hands flat on it with your arms straight. Stand on the other leg.
Keeping the banded leg straight, push it back and up until it's almost level with the floor.
Bring it slowly forward and down to just in front of your standing foot. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A kickback done leaning on a wall, pushing one straight leg back against a band anchored low in front of you. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Band Jack Knife Situp
instructions: Loop a band around both ankles, anchored low past your feet. Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Sit up and pull your knees in toward your chest at the same time, lifting your feet off the floor.
Reach your arms forward beside your legs and balance on your hips at the top.
Lower slowly back down until you're lying flat with your legs straight.
description: A sit-up where you pull your knees to your chest as you sit up, against a band anchored past your feet. It works the abs and the hip flexors at the front of the hips.

name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor above head height.
Kneel on one knee facing the anchor and hold the band in one hand, palm facing down.
Reach that arm up toward the anchor, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Pull the band down to your side, bringing your elbow in toward your ribs.
Let your arm rise slowly back up. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm pulldown done kneeling on one knee, pulling a band from a high anchor down to your side. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and upper back.

name: Band Kneeling Twisting Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high behind you. Kneel upright on the floor and hold a handle in each hand beside your head, palms facing in.
Crunch forward and down, rounding your back and turning your shoulders so your head moves toward one knee.
Keep your hands by your head and your hips still.
Rise slowly back to upright. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A kneeling crunch with a twist, pulling against a band anchored high behind you with your hands by your head. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Band Single Arm Overhead Bicep Curl
instructions: Anchor a band at shoulder height and stand side-on to it, feet hip-width apart, other hand on your hip.
Hold the handle in the hand nearer the anchor, arm straight out to the side at shoulder height, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm still and level, bend your elbow to curl the handle toward the side of your head.
Straighten your arm slowly back out to the side. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm band curl done with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height, curling your hand toward your head. It works the biceps.

name: Band Single Arm Single Leg Split Squat
instructions: Stand a big step in front of a box and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Anchor a band low in front of you and hold its handle in one hand at your hip, palm facing in.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is about level with the floor.
Keep your chest up and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat with your back foot up on a box, holding a band anchored low in front of you in one hand. It works the quads, with the glutes and hamstrings helping.

name: Band Single Arm Standing Low Row
instructions: Anchor the band near the floor. Stand facing it with one foot in front of the other and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the band in one hand, palm facing in, and step back until it's tight. Lean forward a little, back straight.
Pull the band back to your hip, drawing your shoulder blade back.
Let your arm straighten slowly. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm row with a band anchored low in front of you, pulling your hand back to your hip. It works the upper back.

name: Band Single Arm Twisting Chest Press
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height. Sit on the floor with your legs out in front, knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle in one hand beside your chest, palm facing in (thumb up), elbow pointing back. Rest your other hand on your hip.
Press the handle straight forward until your arm is straight, letting that shoulder turn forward as you reach.
Return slowly to the start. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm band press done sitting on the floor, turning your upper body as you push forward. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Band Single Arm Twisting Seated Row
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you at about chest height. Sit on the floor facing it with your legs straight.
Hold the handle in one hand, palm facing in (thumb up), arm straight and that shoulder reaching forward. Rest your other hand on your hip.
Pull the handle to the side of your waist, driving your elbow back and turning your chest toward that side.
Return slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm band row done sitting on the floor, turning your upper body as you pull. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Band Pull Through
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor at floor level.
Stand facing away from the anchor with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the band with both hands between your legs.
Step forward until the band is tight, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lean forward until your upper body is level with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand up straight.
description: A hip drive against a band anchored low behind you and held between your legs: push your hips back, then drive them forward to stand. It works the glutes and hamstrings, plus the lower back.

name: Band Push Situp
instructions: Anchor the band behind your head. Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Hold the band with both hands, arms straight up above your chest.
Tighten your abs and sit all the way up, pushing your hands forward until your arms point straight ahead.
Lower yourself slowly until your back is on the floor and your arms point up again.
description: A full situp against a band anchored behind you, pushing your arms forward as you rise. It works the abs, while the shoulders and chest steady your arms.

name: Band Reverse Fly
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height. Stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band in both hands, arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your arms straight and at shoulder height as you open them out to your sides, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Bring your arms slowly back in front of you.
description: A band fly where you pull your straight arms apart, from in front of you out to your sides. It works the back of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Band Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a box, bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor and the middle of a resistance band under your feet.
Hold the band with your palms facing down, wrapping it around your fingers.
Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang past your knees.
Bend your wrists to lift the backs of your hands up.
Lower your hands slowly.
description: A wrist curl with your palms facing down, lifting the backs of your hands against a band under your feet. It works the muscles on top of your forearms.

name: Seated Internal Hip Rotation
instructions: Sit tall on a box with your knees bent and your hands resting on the box beside your hips.
Loop a band around one ankle and anchor it low on the inside, past your other leg, so it pulls that foot inward.
Keeping your knee still, swing that foot out to the side as far as you can.
Let it come back slowly toward your other foot. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A seated hip move where you swing one foot outward against a band while your knee stays still, turning the thigh inward. It works the glutes and outer hips.

name: Band Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with one foot in front of the other and the middle of a resistance band under your front foot.
Hold an end in each hand at shoulder height, elbows bent, palms facing forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower your hands slowly back to shoulder height.
description: An overhead press using a resistance band under your front foot instead of weights. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Band Side Tricep Extension
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and stand side-on to it, feet hip-width apart, near hand on your hip.
Hold the handle in your far hand, palm facing forward, with that upper arm out to the side and the hand behind your head.
Keeping your upper arm still, straighten your elbow until your arm points straight out to the side.
Bend your elbow slowly to bring your hand back behind your head. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm triceps extension against a band anchored to your side, straightening your arm out to the side from behind your head. It works the triceps.

name: Band Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on a low step on one foot, with the band under that foot. Hold the other end of the band in one hand.
Hold a wall or other steady object with your free hand if you need help with balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-leg calf raise on a low step, standing on a band for extra resistance. It works the calves and tests your balance.

name: Single Leg Tibialis Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on a low step with only your heel on it and the front of your foot hanging off the edge.
Hook your other foot behind your ankle and rest one hand on a wall for balance.
Keeping your heel on the step, lift the front of your foot up toward your shin as far as you can.
Lower your toes slowly below the edge of the step. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg toe raise with your heel on a step, lifting the front of your foot toward your shin. It works the muscle on the front of the shin.

name: Band Single Leg Split Squat
instructions: Stand a big step in front of a box and rest the top of your back foot on it.
Stand on the middle of a band with your front foot and hold a handle in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is about level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat with your back foot up on a box and a band under your front foot, held at your sides. It works the quads, with the glutes and hamstrings helping.

name: Band Lying Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Loop a band around both ankles, anchored low past your feet. Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands behind your head.
Keeping your legs straight and together, raise them until they point straight up at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly back to the floor.
description: A lying leg raise against a band anchored past your feet, lifting straight legs until they point at the ceiling. It works the abs and the hip flexors at the front of the hips.

name: Band Squat Row
instructions: Anchor the band at waist height. Stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other and your arms straight out in front of you.
Bend your knees and sit down into a deep squat, keeping your back straight, chest up and arms straight.
Stand up, and as you rise, pull the handles in to your waist.
Straighten your arms slowly as you squat back down.
description: A deep squat with a band row: you pull the band to your waist as you stand up. It works the glutes, hamstrings and quads, along with the back.

name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand on the middle of a long band with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to squat down until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Don't let your knees cave in.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
description: A squat done standing on a long band, holding its handles at your shoulders so the band gets tighter as you stand up. It works the glutes and quads, with help from the hamstrings and calves.

name: Band Standing Crunch
instructions: Anchor the band high behind you. Stand facing away from it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands beside your head, elbows bent.
Tighten your abs and crunch forward, bringing your chest toward your knees.
Return slowly to standing tall.
description: A crunch done standing, pulling against a band anchored high behind you with your hands by your head. It works the abs, with help from the obliques.

name: Band Standing Twisting Crunch
instructions: Anchor a band high behind you and stand tall facing away from it, feet hip-width apart.
Hold a handle in each hand at the top of your chest, elbows down, palms facing you.
Crunch your chest down toward your hips while turning your shoulders to one side.
Keep your hips still and your hands at your chest.
Rise slowly back to standing. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing crunch with a twist, pulling against a band anchored high behind you. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Band Stepup
instructions: Stand facing a box with one foot on top of it and a band under that foot.
Hold the band's handles in front of your shoulders, elbows down, palms facing you.
Push through the foot on the box to step up until that leg is straight, letting your other foot hang behind you.
Lower slowly back down until your other foot touches the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A step-up onto a box while standing on a band held at your shoulders, so the band gets tighter as you rise. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Band Straight Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a handle in each hand, arms straight, palms facing your legs.
Keeping your knees only slightly bent, bend forward at the hips and reach the handles down toward your feet.
Stand back up by pushing your hips forward until you're upright.
description: A deadlift done standing on a band with your legs almost straight, bending forward at the hips until your hands reach your feet. It works the glutes and hamstrings, with help from the lower back.

name: Band Seated Twist
instructions: Anchor a band to one side of you at chest height. Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front.
Hold the handle in both hands, one wrapped over the other, thumbs up. Turn toward the anchor with your hands near your chest.
Turn your chest away from the anchor and push your arms straight out until they point over your feet.
Return slowly to the start. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated twist on the floor against a band anchored to your side, turning away from it as you straighten your arms. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Band Twisting Overhead Press
instructions: Anchor the band near the floor to one side of you. Stand with your feet wide.
Hold the band in the hand nearer the anchor, at your shoulder, palm facing forward.
Press the band up on a diagonal, turning your torso away from the anchor, until your arm is straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
description: A one-arm band press that drives up on a diagonal from a low anchor, twisting your torso as you go. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and core.

name: Band Underhand Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high above you, slightly in front, and sit on a box facing it with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach up and hold the handles about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you.
Pull your elbows down to your sides until your hands reach your upper chest, leaning back slightly.
Let your arms rise slowly until they are straight again.
description: A seated pulldown on a band anchored overhead, holding the handles with your palms facing you. It works the lats along the sides of your back, with the biceps helping.

name: Band V-up
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around both ankles from a low anchor past your feet. Stretch your arms on the floor past your head.
Lift your straight legs and your upper body at the same time, reaching your hands toward your ankles.
Stop when your body forms a V, balancing on your buttocks.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A V-up with a band running from a low anchor to your ankles, lifting your legs and upper body together. It works the abs, with help from the hip flexors at the front of the hips.

name: Band Vertical Pallof Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, side-on to a band anchored at chest height, far enough away that it's tight. Hold it with both hands at mid-chest.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are straight overhead. Don't let the band twist your body toward the anchor.
Lower your hands slowly back to your chest. Do all your reps on one side, then turn around and switch.
description: A standing core exercise where you press a band from your chest straight overhead while your side faces the anchor. Your abs and obliques work to keep the band from twisting you.

name: Band Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a box, bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor and the middle of a resistance band under your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing up, and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Bend your wrists to curl your hands up.
Lower your hands slowly.
description: A wrist curl with your palms facing up, curling your hands against a band under your feet. It works the forearms.

name: Band Y-raise
instructions: Stand on a resistance band with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold an end in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Keep your arms straight and lift them up and out until they are overhead and your body makes a Y shape.
Lower your arms slowly back to your thighs.
description: A raise where you lift straight arms up and out against a band until your body forms a Y. It works the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Band Shrug
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an end in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight and relaxed at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as you can.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
description: A shrug against a resistance band under your feet, lifting your shoulders toward your ears. It works the traps, the muscles along the top of your shoulders.

name: Band Standing Rear Delt Row
instructions: Anchor a band above head height. Facing it, hold an end in each hand, palms facing down, and step back with one foot ahead, arms straight.
Pull the band toward your face, bending your elbows and lifting them out to the sides.
Stop when your hands are in front of your shoulders and your upper arms are level with the floor.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing band row pulled toward your face with your elbows high and wide. It works the rear shoulders, along with the upper back and biceps.

name: Band Straight Back Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, feet hip-width apart, holding a handle in each hand with your arms straight and palms facing your legs.
With a slight bend in your knees, push your hips back and lean forward until the handles are just below your knees. Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand up tall, keeping your arms straight.
description: A deadlift standing on a band, bending forward from the hips with a flat back and nearly straight legs. It works the glutes, along with the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Burpee
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and put your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back so you're in a plank on straight arms, body straight from head to heels.
Jump your feet back in toward your hands.
Jump up fast and reach your arms overhead. Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
description: A full-body move that links a squat, a plank and a jump. It raises your heart rate and builds strength and endurance.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Raise your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, crossing one over the other.
Swing both arms open wide to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing forward, until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Swing them back in front of you until they cross again. Keep the swings smooth, without stopping.
description: Arm swings that cross your arms in front of you, then open them wide to the sides. They loosen up and stretch the chest and the fronts of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Burpee
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Squat down and set the dumbbells on the floor in front of your feet, keeping hold of the handles.
Jump your feet back into a plank with your arms straight, body in a line from head to heels.
Jump your feet back in toward your hands, landing in a squat.
Stand up quickly with the dumbbells and jump straight up, keeping them at your sides. Land softly and start the next rep.
description: A burpee done holding a dumbbell in each hand: squat, jump back to a plank on the dumbbells, jump in, then stand and jump. It works the whole body and raises your heart rate.

name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Set the machine for your height. Stand with the balls of your feet on the foot platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Bend forward at the hips so the pad rests on your lower back, and rest your forearms on the front pad, holding the handles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A calf raise on a machine, bent forward at the hips with a weighted pad on your lower back. It works the calves, and bending over lets them stretch further than in a standing raise.

name: Band Bench Press
instructions: Wrap a resistance band under a flat bench and lie flat on your back on it, feet flat on the floor.
Hold a handle in each hand at your chest, palms facing your feet, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower your hands slowly back to your chest, until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
description: A bench press with a resistance band wrapped under the bench instead of a barbell. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked under the pads and your head lower than your hips.
Grip the bar with your palms facing your head, hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lift the bar off the rack and lower it slowly to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A decline bench press with your palms facing your head instead of your feet. It works the lower chest, with extra work for the triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie back on it with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your palms facing your head, hands slightly wider than your shoulders, and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: An incline bench press with your palms facing your head instead of your feet. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Barbell Wide Reverse Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back against the bench.
Grip the bar wide, hands wider than your shoulders, with your palms facing your head.
Lift the bar off the rack and hold it straight above your chest with your arms straight.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides and your wrists straight.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A flat bench press with a wide grip and your palms facing your head. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Cable Standing Crossovers
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold a handle in each hand, palms facing down, with your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Keep your arms straight and bring your hands down and together in front of your body, crossing them over each other.
Return slowly until your arms are back out to the sides, keeping them straight.
description: A standing cable move that brings your straight arms from out at your sides to crossed low in front of you. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Chest and Front of Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a band in front of your hips with your hands wide apart, palms facing your thighs.
Lift the band up and over your head, bending your elbows as it rises.
Bring it down behind your head until your elbows point out to the sides and bend at about a right angle.
Reverse the path slowly to bring the band back to your hips.
description: A standing stretch that lifts a band from your hips up and over to behind your head. It stretches the chest and the front of the shoulders.

name: Clap Push Up
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your abs tight.
Push up hard enough that your hands leave the floor, and clap once in the air.
Land with your hands back where they started.
description: An explosive pushup where you push off the floor hard enough to clap your hands before landing. It works the chest, plus the triceps and shoulders, and builds upper body power.

name: Deep Push Up
instructions: Set two dumbbells on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Grip them, palms facing each other, and get into a pushup position with your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest between the dumbbells. Keep your elbows close to your body.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms and come back up.
description: A pushup with your hands raised on dumbbells, so you can lower further than on the floor. It works the chest through a bigger range, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Drop Push Up
instructions: Set two flat benches end to end, slightly more than shoulder-width apart. Get into a pushup, one hand on each bench, palms down.
Lower your chest between the benches, then push back up until your arms are straight.
Drop both hands off the benches to the floor in the gap and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up hard so your hands leave the floor, land them back on the benches, and bend your elbows as you land.
description: A pushup that switches between two benches and the floor, with a hard push to get back up onto the benches. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head at the low end, holding a dumbbell in one hand on your thigh.
Use your thigh to help lift the dumbbell up over your chest, arm straight and palm facing in toward your body.
Lower the dumbbell slowly out to your side in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Sweep it back up the same way until it's over your chest. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm fly on a decline bench: you lower a dumbbell out to the side and sweep it back up. It works the lower chest, with help from the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench to 30 to 45 degrees. Sit on it with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh.
Lie back with your feet flat on the floor and hold the dumbbell straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc, elbow slightly bent, until your arm is level with the floor.
Bring it back up along the same arc until it's over your chest.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A chest fly done one arm at a time on an incline bench, lowering the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc. It works the upper chest, plus the front of the shoulders and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh.
Lie back and bring the dumbbell to shoulder level, palm facing toward your feet.
Press the dumbbell up and slightly inward until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to shoulder level.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: An incline dumbbell press done one arm at a time. It works the upper chest, plus the shoulders and triceps, and makes you work to keep your body steady.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Fly
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh. Lie back, keeping it pressed against your thigh.
Use your free hand to help lift the dumbbell up over your shoulder, arm straight and palm facing the middle of your body.
Lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc, elbow slightly bent, until your arm is level with the floor.
Bring it back up along the same arc until it's over your shoulder.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A flat-bench chest fly done one arm at a time, lowering the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc. It works the chest and the front of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Decline Chest Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked over the high end and your feet under the pads.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your chest, with your back pressed against the bench.
Press the dumbbell up toward the ceiling until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm dumbbell press on a decline bench, with your head lower than your hips. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Raise your arms straight out in front of you to chest height and press your palms together.
Squeeze your chest as hard as you can, pressing your palms into each other with your arms straight.
Hold for the set time, then relax your arms and chest.
description: A standing chest squeeze where you press your palms together with straight arms and hold the tension. It works the chest with no equipment.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand, arm straight up over your chest, palm facing toward your feet.
Bend your elbow to lower the kettlebell until it's just above your chest, keeping your upper arm close to your body.
Push it back up until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm press done lying on the floor, pushing a kettlebell straight up over your chest. It works the middle of the chest, plus the triceps and shoulders.

name: Incline Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat and backrest to fit you, then sit with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the handles with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Press the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring the handles back toward your chest.
description: A seated machine press set at an incline, pushing the handles forward and away from your chest. It works the upper chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Decline Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest to fit you, then sit with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the handles with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Press the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are straight.
Bring the handles slowly back toward your chest.
description: A seated machine press set at a decline, pushing the handles forward from your chest. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Machine Inner Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Hold the upright handles with your palms facing each other (thumbs up) and your elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your elbows are back at 90 degrees.
description: A seated machine press with your palms facing each other, pushing the handles straight forward from your chest. It works the middle of the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Plyo Push Up
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push up hard enough that your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with your hands back where they started.
description: An explosive pushup where you push hard enough for your hands to leave the floor. It works the chest, plus the triceps, shoulders and abs, and builds upper body power.

name: Smith Wide Grip Bench Press
instructions: Set a flat bench in the Smith machine and lie on it with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands spaced wider than shoulder-width.
Unhook the bar and lower it slowly to your chest, keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A flat bench press on a Smith machine with your hands set wide. It works the chest, plus the triceps and shoulders, and the fixed bar path makes it easier to control.

name: Smith Wide Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions: Set a decline bench to the angle you want under a Smith machine bar.
Lie on the bench with your feet hooked under the foot pads.
Grip the bar wide, hands wider than your shoulders, and unhook it from the rack.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, letting your elbows point out to the sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A decline bench press on a Smith machine with your hands set wide. It works the lower chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Weighted Drop Push Up
instructions: Set two flat benches end to end with a gap a little wider than your shoulders.
Get into a pushup position in the gap, one hand on the end of each bench and a weight plate on your upper back.
Lift your hands off the benches and drop them to the floor in the gap, catching yourself with your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up hard enough for your hands to leave the floor.
Land your hands back on the benches, lower your chest between them, and press up until your arms are straight.
description: An explosive pushup with a weight plate on your back, dropping your hands from two benches to the floor and pushing back up onto them. It works the chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Wide Hand Push Up
instructions: Get into a pushup position on straight arms, hands wider than shoulder-width apart, body straight from head to toe.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to lower your chest toward the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back up.
description: A pushup with your hands set wide, which puts more of the work on your chest than a standard pushup. The triceps and shoulders help.

name: Unilateral Row
instructions: Stand on one leg facing the machine. Rest your other knee on the rear pad and that same side's forearm on the front pad, back flat.
With your free hand, hold the low cable handle, arm hanging straight down and palm facing in.
Pull the handle up to the side of your waist, driving your elbow back past your body.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm cable row done bent forward, with one knee and forearm resting on the machine's pads. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Row
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Lie face down with your chest on the pad and your feet on the floor behind you.
Grab the barbell below you with your palms facing forward (a reverse grip), hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your back straight and pull the bar up toward your upper belly.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A barbell row done lying face down on an incline bench, with your palms facing forward (a reverse grip). It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Palm Rotational Row
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle in one hand, palm facing down, and step back until the cable is tight.
Bend your knees into a half squat and lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight.
Pull the handle toward your waist, turning your palm to face up as you pull.
Let the handle go back slowly, turning your palm down again, until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm row from a low cable where your palm turns from down to up as you pull. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Upper Row
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to the low pulley and sit on the bench facing the machine, feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down, hands close together, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your torso still and pull the bar up toward your upper chest, lifting your elbows out to the sides until they're level with your shoulders.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated cable row pulled high to your upper chest with your elbows out wide. It works the upper back and rear shoulders, with help from the biceps.

name: Chinup
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your palms facing you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Tighten your abs and pull yourself up, leading with your chest, until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup with your palms facing you and your hands shoulder-width apart, pulling until your chin clears the bar. It works the lats, plus the biceps and forearms.

name: Close Grip Chinup
instructions: Grab a pullup bar with your palms facing you and your hands close together.
Hang with your arms straight and your feet off the floor.
Pull yourself up, keeping your elbows close to your body, until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chinup with your hands close together and your palms facing you. It works the lats, with a lot of help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Delt Row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest on the pad, holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms hang straight again.
description: A two-dumbbell row done lying face down on an incline bench, so your chest is supported. It works the upper back and the backs of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at your hips with your knees slightly bent and your back straight. Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing your body.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Turn your palms as you pull so they face away from your body at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly, turning your palms back to face your body.
description: A bent-over row with two dumbbells where you turn your palms as you pull. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Kettlebell Two Arm Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, holding a kettlebell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at your hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the kettlebells up toward your chest, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the kettlebells slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row with a kettlebell in each hand, pulling both up together. It works the upper back.

name: Kneeling Lat Stretch
instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Slide one hand forward along the floor until that forearm rests flat on it. Keep your other hand where it is.
Let your chest sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch down that side of your back.
Hold for the set time, then slide your hand back slowly and switch sides.
description: A stretch on your hands and knees, sliding one arm forward along the floor and letting your chest sink. It stretches the lats along the side of your back and the shoulder.

name: Single Arm Lateral Wide Pulldown
instructions: Sit facing a plate-loaded pulldown machine, thighs under the knee pad. Reach up with one hand and hold the handle, palm facing your head.
Pull the handle straight down beside your head until your hand is next to your shoulder and your elbow is by your side.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arm is straight overhead. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm pulldown on a plate-loaded machine, pulling a high handle straight down beside your head. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and upper back.

name: Reverse T-Bar Row
instructions: Set the foot platforms for your height. Lie face down on the angled pad with your chest on it and your feet on the platforms.
Grab the handles, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the handles up toward your chest, pulling your shoulder blades together. Keep your back straight.
Lower the handles slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A T-bar row done lying chest down on an angled pad, so your chest is supported. It works the upper back as you pull your shoulder blades together.

name: Seated Row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests. Sit with your chest against the pad and your feet on the footrests.
Hold the handles with your palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and pull the handles toward your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let the handles go forward slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated row on a machine with a chest pad, pulling the handles back toward you. It works the upper back.

name: T-Bar Reverse Grip Row
instructions: Stand on the T-bar row's foot plates facing the weight, knees slightly bent. Lean forward, back flat, and hold the handles, palms facing forward.
Pull the handles up toward your belly, driving your elbows back past your body.
Lower the handles slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing, bent-over row on a T-bar machine, holding the handles with your palms facing forward. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Lower Back Curl
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your arms by your sides.
Tighten your glutes and hamstrings, then slowly lift your chest and upper body off the floor, curling your back up.
Lower your upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A face-down exercise where you lift your chest off the floor with your arms at your sides. It works the lower back, plus the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Medicine Ball Catch and Overhead Throw
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball in both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at your hips, back straight, so the ball hangs low between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand up, swinging the ball up to chest height with straight arms.
Keep it moving overhead and bend your elbows to bring the ball behind your head, then throw it straight up.
Catch it on the way down and swing it back between your legs into the hinge.
description: A power move: you swing a medicine ball from between your legs to behind your head, then throw it overhead. It works the lats, shoulders and core.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Slam
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball above your head with both hands.
Keep your back straight and your abs tight.
Bend your knees slightly and slam the ball down hard onto the floor in front of you, driving with your whole body.
Catch the ball on the bounce and lift it back above your head.
description: A power move where you lift a medicine ball overhead and throw it hard into the floor. It works the upper back, shoulders and abs.

name: Single Arm Lat Stretch Against Wall
instructions: Stand with one side close to a wall, about a foot away, feet hip-width apart.
Raise the arm nearest the wall, bend the elbow, and rest your elbow and upper arm on the wall with your hand behind your head.
Lean your body toward the wall until you feel a stretch down the side of your back.
Hold for the set time, then ease back out slowly and switch sides.
description: A standing stretch with your bent arm raised and your elbow against a wall, leaning in. It stretches the lats down the side of your back, plus the shoulder and triceps.

name: Single Arm Lateral High Row
instructions: Set the seat height on a high row machine and sit facing it.
Hold one handle with one hand and keep your back straight.
Pull the handle toward your body, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Let the handle go back slowly until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm row on a seated high row machine. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Side Lying Floor Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked, bottom arm stretched along the floor past your head. Rest your top hand on your hip.
Reach your top arm over your head to meet your bottom hand.
At the same time, bend your top knee and let it drop forward to the floor, until you feel a stretch along your side.
Hold for the set time, then straighten your top leg, bring your arm back to your hip and switch sides.
description: A stretch lying on your side, reaching your top arm overhead while your top knee drops forward. It stretches the lats along the side of your back, and the obliques.

name: Smith Bent Over Row
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at hip height and stand facing it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar up toward your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row in a Smith machine, pulling the bar toward your lower chest. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Smith Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at hip height and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips with your back straight. Grip the bar with your palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar up toward your lower chest, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bent-over row on a Smith machine with your palms facing up. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Sphinx
instructions: Lie face down with your forearms flat on the floor and your elbows right under your shoulders.
Lift your chest up, keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold for the set time, keeping your neck long and in line with your back, then lower your chest slowly back down.
description: A gentle back bend: lie face down and prop your chest up on your forearms. It stretches the lower back and helps it bend more easily.

name: Spine Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor, legs straight, feet hip-width apart. Hold your arms straight out in front at shoulder height, palms facing down.
Tuck your chin and round your back forward, reaching your hands toward or past your feet.
Roll back up slowly until you're sitting tall again.
description: A seated stretch where you round your back forward over straight legs, arms reaching ahead. It stretches the lower back, with some stretch in the hamstrings.

name: Standing Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your hands on your hips.
Tighten your stomach and tuck your hips under, flattening your lower back as if pressing it toward a wall behind you.
Hold for a few seconds, then relax back to the start.
description: A small standing move where you tilt your pelvis to flatten your lower back. It helps the lower back move better and trains your abs to brace.

name: Upper Back Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height and lace your fingers together.
Push your hands forward and let your upper back round, so your shoulder blades spread apart.
Hold for the set time, then let go and lower your arms back to your sides.
