description: A standing stretch where you push your clasped hands forward at shoulder height and round your upper back. It stretches the upper back and the backs of the shoulders.

name: Upward Facing Dog
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight out behind you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your lower ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and straighten your arms, lifting your upper body and thighs off the floor.
Roll your shoulders back and down, open your chest and look up toward the ceiling.
Hold for the set time, then lower slowly back to the floor.
description: A yoga pose where you press up from lying face down, arms straight and chest lifted. It stretches the spine, chest and shoulders and strengthens the arms and back.

name: Ankle Circles
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and your weight on one leg.
Lift your other foot just off the floor.
Turn that ankle in slow circles, moving only your foot. Do all your circles on one foot, then switch.
description: A standing warm-up where you turn one lifted foot in slow circles. It loosens the ankle and works the calves and the small muscles that keep the ankle steady.

name: Barbell Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the floor with your feet hip-width apart and a barbell resting across your upper back.
Hold the bar with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your legs straight and rise onto the balls of your feet, lifting your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
description: A standing calf raise on flat ground with a barbell across your upper back. It works the calves.

name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back, holding it with both hands.
Stand with your feet close together, the balls of your feet on a weight plate and your heels on the floor.
Raise your heels as high as you can, rising onto your toes.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A standing calf raise with a barbell across your upper back and the balls of your feet on a weight plate. It works the calves.

name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on flat floor with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Rest your hands on a wall or something steady for balance.
Raise your heels slowly, lifting your weight onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
description: A calf raise on flat floor using only your body weight, rising up onto the balls of your feet. It works the calves.

name: Cable Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform of a cable machine, facing the machine, with your feet close together.
Attach the low cable at your hips and hold the machine's handles in front of your chest for balance.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A standing calf raise on a cable machine, with the cable adding weight as you rise. It works the calves.

name: Calf Stretch with Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on the wall at shoulder height.
Step one foot back, keeping that leg straight and the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean toward the wall until you feel a stretch in your back calf.
Hold for the set time, then switch legs.
description: A wall stretch for the calf: you lean into the wall with one leg back and its heel pressed to the floor.

name: Lying Calf Stretch with Band
instructions: Lie on your back, legs straight, with a band looped around the ball of one foot. Hold a handle in each hand by your hips.
Bend that knee and pull it in toward your chest, using the band to draw your toes back toward your shin.
Stop when your thigh points straight up and you feel a stretch in your calf.
Hold for the set time, then straighten your leg slowly back to the floor and switch legs.
description: A lying calf stretch with a band looped around one foot, pulling your knee in toward your chest and your toes toward your shin. It stretches the calf.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a weight plate and your heels hanging off its edge.
Stand a dumbbell on end on each knee and hold them steady with your hands.
Raise your heels as high as you can, pushing up onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A seated calf raise with a dumbbell resting on each knee for extra weight. It works the calves.

name: Hack Calf Raise
instructions: Stand in a hack squat machine with your back against the pad, shoulders under the shoulder pads, and feet hip-width apart on the platform.
Hold the handles by your shoulders and stand with your legs straight.
Keep your legs straight and push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A calf raise done in a hack squat machine, with your back against the pad and the weight on your shoulders. It works the calves.

name: Hack Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand in a hack squat machine, back on the pad, shoulders under the pads. Put the ball of one foot on the platform's lower edge.
Lift your other foot off the platform and keep your standing leg straight.
Push through the ball of your foot to raise your heel as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly back down. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg calf raise in a hack squat machine, with the weight on your shoulders through the pads. It works the calves.

name: Seated Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate, hip-width apart, knees bent toward your chest.
Hold the handles at your sides.
Push through your feet to straighten your legs, sliding the seat back, and stop just before your knees lock.
Bend your knees slowly to let the seat slide forward to the start.
description: A leg press done sitting upright, pushing against a footplate so the seat slides back. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Single Leg Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Stand a long step from the end of a flat bench. Bend forward and rest your hands on it, palms down, arms straight.
Bend one knee and lift that foot behind you so all your weight is on the other foot.
Rise up onto the ball of your standing foot, lifting your heel as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg calf raise done bent forward with your hands on a bench for balance. It works the calves.

name: Single Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on a wall or something sturdy for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor and balance on the other.
Rise slowly onto the ball of your foot, lifting your heel off the floor.
Lower your heel slowly back down.
Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A calf raise done on one leg on flat floor, with your hands on a wall for balance. It works the calves.

name: Peroneals Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and that foot on the floor.
Loop the band around the ball of one foot and hold a handle in each hand.
Straighten that leg and gently pull the band toward you, drawing your toes back until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Hold for the set time, then relax and switch legs.
description: A seated stretch where you loop a band around your foot and pull your toes back. It stretches the calf, ankle and foot.

name: Posterior Tibialis Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and that foot on the floor.
Loop the band around the ball of one foot and hold a handle in each hand.
Straighten that leg and gently pull the band toward you, drawing your toes back until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Hold for the set time, then relax and switch legs.
description: A seated stretch where you loop a band around your foot and pull your toes back. It stretches the calf, including a deep muscle behind the shin.

name: Seated Calf Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, feet hip-width apart, hands on the floor beside your hips.
Lean forward from your hips and grab your toes, one hand on each foot.
Gently pull your toes back toward you until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Hold for the set time, then let go and sit back up tall.
description: A seated stretch where you reach forward and pull your toes back toward you. It stretches the calves, and the hamstrings too.

name: Single Leg Calf Press on Leg Press
instructions: Sit in a 45-degree leg press with your back against the pad and rest one foot on the floor.
Put the ball of your other foot on the platform's bottom edge, heel hanging off. Straighten that leg and release the safety handles.
Keeping your leg straight, point your toes to push the platform up as far as your ankle allows.
Let your heel sink slowly back toward you. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A calf raise done one leg at a time on a 45-degree leg press, pushing the platform with the ball of your foot. It works the calves.

name: Smith Single Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Stand in a Smith machine with the bar across your upper back. Hold it a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing forward.
Unhook the bar. Bend one knee and lift that foot behind you so you stand on one foot.
Rise onto the ball of your standing foot, lifting your heel as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg calf raise on the floor with a Smith machine bar across your upper back. It works the calves.

name: Smith Seated Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench in a Smith machine, the bar across one thigh just above the knee. Hold it with both hands, palms facing down.
Keep that foot flat on the floor under your knee and rest your other foot farther forward.
Push through the ball of your foot to lift your heel as high as you can, raising the bar.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A one-leg seated calf raise with a Smith machine bar resting across your thigh just above the knee. It works the calves.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a flat bench and put one heel on it, toes pointing up. Keep your standing leg straight.
Bend forward from your hips and hold the toes of your raised foot with both hands, letting that knee bend a little.
Keep holding your toes and push your hips back to straighten the raised leg, until you feel a stretch in your calf.
Hold for the set time, then bend the knee a little to ease off and switch legs.
description: A standing stretch with one heel up on a bench, holding your toes as you straighten that leg. It stretches the calf, and the hamstring once the leg is straight.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a flat bench and grip the edge beside your hips, palms down, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet out until your legs are straight with your heels on the floor, and slide your hips off the bench.
Keep your back close to the bench and bend your elbows to lower your hips until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Press through your hands until your arms are straight again.
description: A dip with your hands on a bench behind you and your legs straight out on the floor. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Muscle Up
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you, arms straight.
Pull yourself up hard, bending your knees, until your chest reaches the bar.
Lean your chest forward over the bar and push down until your arms are straight and you're propped above the bar.
Bend your arms to lower back over the bar, then lower slowly until you're hanging with straight arms.
description: A pullup that keeps going over the bar until you're propped up on straight arms. It works the lats, biceps and triceps, and your forearms for grip.

name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your hands behind your back. You can also do this sitting.
Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.
description: A gentle neck stretch: tilt your ear toward your shoulder and hold. It stretches the sides of the neck.

name: Back Pec Stretch
instructions: Raise an adjustable bench's back pad to a high incline. Stand a long step from its top edge and rest your hands on it, palms down.
Keep your legs and arms straight and bend forward from your hips until your back is level with the floor.
Let your chest and head sink down below your arms until you feel a stretch under your arms and across your chest.
Hold for the set time, then rise back up until your back is level again.
description: A standing stretch with your hands on a raised bench pad, letting your chest sink below your arms. It stretches the lats, with some stretch in the chest and shoulders.

name: Calf Push Stretch with Hands Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and put your palms flat on it at chest height.
Set one heel on the floor by the wall with the ball of that foot up against the wall, leg straight. Step the other foot back.
Bend your elbows and lean your hips and chest toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the front leg's calf.
Hold for the set time, then ease back slowly and switch legs.
description: A standing calf stretch with your toes propped up against a wall, leaning in with your hands on the wall. It stretches the calf, with some stretch in the hamstrings.

name: Band Hip Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Run a band across your hips, each end pinned under a weight plate.
Press your palms down on the plates to hold them in place.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly until your hips almost touch the floor.
description: A glute bridge with a band across your hips, held down by weight plates at your sides. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and quads.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Rest a barbell across your hips and hold it in place with both hands.
Push your hips up until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A glute bridge on the floor with a barbell across your hips for extra weight. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell across your upper back.
Take a big step to the side with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee to lower your body, keeping your left leg straight.
Push off your right foot to return to the start, then do the same stepping out with your left foot.
description: A side lunge with a barbell across your upper back, bending one knee while the other leg stays straight. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Cable Reverse Single Arm Curl
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handle in one hand with your palm facing down, arm straight and elbow close to your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow at your side.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm cable curl done with your palm facing down. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your chest against the pad.
Rest one arm straight over the pad, holding a dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm on the pad.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm preacher curl done with your palm facing down. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench, feet flat, and lean forward. Rest one forearm along your thigh with your hand just past your knee.
Hold a dumbbell in that hand, palm facing in and thumb on top, with the dumbbell tipped forward and down.
Keeping your forearm on your thigh, lift the top of the dumbbell up with your wrist until it stands upright.
Lower it slowly back to the tipped position. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated wrist exercise with your forearm on your thigh, tilting a dumbbell up and down with your thumb on top. It works the forearms.

name: Hug Knees to Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and hands resting on your knees.
Lift your feet and pull both knees in toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug your knees in close, letting your lower back round.
Hold for the set time, then let go and lower your feet back to the floor.
description: A lying stretch where you pull both knees into your chest and hug them. It stretches the glutes and the lower back.

name: Iron Cross Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing up.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body toward the floor on the other side, letting your hips turn.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and go until you feel a stretch in your hip and lower back.
Bring the leg back and straighten it on the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A lying twist where one bent leg crosses over your body while your arms stay out wide. It stretches the glutes, lower back and the sides of your waist.

name: Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor and arms at your sides, palms facing down.
Tighten your glutes and abs, then tilt your pelvis up and lift your hips off the floor into a bridge.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A bridge that starts by tilting your pelvis, then lifts your hips off the floor while you lie on your back. It works the glutes, plus the hamstrings and abs.

name: Reverse Hyper on Flat Bench
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the end and your legs hanging off.
Hold the bench to keep yourself steady.
Keep your legs straight and raise them toward the ceiling as high as you can.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
description: A face-down leg raise off the end of a flat bench, lifting your straight legs behind you. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Seated Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front of you and your hands on the floor behind you.
Bend one knee and cross that ankle over your other thigh, near the knee.
Lean your chest forward toward the crossed shin, reaching your hands to the floor in front, until you feel a stretch in your glute.
Hold for the set time, then sit back up and switch legs.
description: A seated stretch where you cross one ankle over the other thigh and lean your chest toward it. It stretches the glutes and helps the hips move freely.

name: Single Leg Press
instructions: Sit in a 45-degree leg press and put one foot in the middle of the footplate.
Rest your other foot to the side, or let it hover near the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the weight by bending your knee toward your chest.
Push through your heel to straighten your leg, without locking your knee.
Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
Lock the safety handles back in place when you finish.
description: A leg press done one leg at a time on a 45-degree machine. It works the glutes, quads and hamstrings and can help even out strength differences between your legs.

name: Standing Cross Leg Outer Hip Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides.
Cross one leg behind the other and set that foot down on its toes, just outside your front foot.
Push your back leg's hip out to the side and lean your upper body the other way until the outside of that hip stretches.
Uncross your legs and stand tall. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing stretch with one leg crossed behind the other, pushing that hip out to the side. It stretches the outer hip and glutes.

name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Stand with your elbows bent at your sides and your forearms pointing forward.
Relax your hands, keeping them open.
Circle both hands at the wrists, keeping your forearms still.
description: A warm-up where you circle your wrists. It loosens the wrists and forearms before harder work.

name: Wide Grip Pullup
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup with your hands set wider than your shoulders and your palms facing away. It works the lats, plus the biceps and forearms.

name: Smith Machine Clean Grip Front Squat
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at shoulder height and stand facing it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Rest the bar across the front of your shoulders and collarbones, then step back.
Keep your chest up and bend your knees and hips to sit back, as if into a chair.
Stop when your thighs are level with the floor or a little below, then push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A front squat in a Smith machine, with the bar resting across the front of your shoulders and your hands holding it in place. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Smith Squat
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at upper-back height. Stand under it with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Rest the bar across your upper back and hold it with your hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your legs to lift the bar off the hooks, and step back.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, keeping your chest up, until your thighs are level with the floor or a little below.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat in a Smith machine, with the bar across your upper back. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting low on your upper back, across the backs of your shoulders.
Keep your chest up, push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor or a little below.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat with the barbell sitting lower on your back, across the backs of your shoulders. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Barbell High Bar Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Rest a barbell high on your upper back, on the muscles just below your neck.
Keep your chest up, push your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
description: A back squat with the barbell resting high on your upper back, just below your neck. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Finger Curls
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up, and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Open your fingers to let the dumbbells roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers to roll the dumbbells back into your palms.
description: A grip move where you let dumbbells roll down to your fingertips and curl them back up. It works the forearms and grip.

name: Kettlebell Seated Two Arm Military Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press both kettlebells straight up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to your shoulders.
description: A seated overhead press with a kettlebell in each hand, pressing both together. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Single Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel beside a flat bench and lean over it, holding a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Rest that forearm across the bench with your wrist and hand hanging off the far edge.
Bend your wrist to lift the back of your hand and the dumbbell up as far as you can.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your wrist bends down. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm wrist curl with your palm facing down, lifting the back of your hand while your forearm rests on a bench. It works the top of the forearm.

name: Seated Dip
instructions: Set the seat so your feet are flat on the floor and your knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Grab the handles at your sides with your palms facing down and your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight. Stay seated; only the handles move.
Let the handles rise slowly back to the start.
description: A machine version of the dip: you stay seated and press handles down at your sides. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Barbell Standing Close Grip Military Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grip a barbell with your palms facing forward, hands slightly closer than shoulder-width.
Bring the bar up to the front of your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the bar straight up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower the bar back to the front of your shoulders.
description: A standing barbell overhead press with your hands a little closer than shoulder-width. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Barbell Standing Wide Military Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a barbell with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Bring the bar up to the front of your shoulders, with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are fully straight.
Lower the bar slowly back to the front of your shoulders.
description: A standing barbell press from the front of your shoulders to overhead, with your hands a little wider than shoulder-width. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: EZ Bar Seated Curls
instructions: Sit upright on a flat bench, feet flat. Hold an EZ bar on its angled grips, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing up, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl with an EZ bar, done sitting upright on a bench. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing behind you.
Keep your back straight and bend forward from your hips, lowering the dumbbells toward the floor. Let your knees bend slightly.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs.
Push through your heels and tighten your glutes to stand back up.
description: A dumbbell deadlift where you bend forward from your hips while your knees stay only slightly bent. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Step forward with your right leg and lower your body until your back knee is just above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push off your right foot and bring your left foot forward into the next lunge.
Keep alternating legs as you walk forward at a steady pace.
description: Lunges that travel forward, each step taking you into the next lunge on the other leg. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Twist Hip Lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and your hands on your chest.
Push through your feet to lift your hips off the floor.
Twist your hips toward one side, rolling onto that shoulder, and reach your other arm overhead. Keep your knees pointing up.
Lower your hips back to the floor, then twist the other way. Keep alternating sides.
description: A hip lift that twists your hips to one side and reaches one arm overhead at the top. It works the glutes, with help from the obliques along the sides of your waist.

name: Pushup on Lower Arms
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders, arms straight, body straight from head to heels.
Keep your hands in place and bend your elbows to lower onto your forearms, keeping your body straight.
Press your palms into the floor to straighten your arms and push back up to the high plank.
description: A pushup where you lower from your hands onto your forearms and press back up. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Crab Twist Toe Touch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Put your hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet, and lift your hips off the floor.
Kick one leg up straight in front of you and reach the opposite hand to touch your toes.
Put your hand and foot back down, then switch sides. Keep alternating sides.
description: A crab-position ab exercise: with your hips up on your hands and feet, kick one leg up and touch it with the opposite hand. It works the abs, plus the obliques and the front of the hips.

name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you're in a pushup position with straight arms, your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Walk your hands back toward your feet, keeping your legs as straight as you can.
Stand back up once your hands reach your feet.
description: A bodyweight move where you walk your hands out from your feet to a pushup position and back again. It works the abs, with the shoulders and hamstrings helping.

name: Forward Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees to lower into a squat and swing your arms back.
Jump forward hard, straightening your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, sinking into a squat, and go straight into the next jump.
description: A jump forward from a squat with an arm swing, landing softly and going straight into the next one. It works the quads, with the calves, hamstrings and glutes helping.

name: Backward Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat.
Push off both feet and jump backward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees into a squat to soak up the landing.
description: A jump backward off both feet, landing softly in a squat. It works the quads, with the hamstrings, glutes and calves helping, and trains balance and coordination.

name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a stride in front of a box, facing away. Rest the top of one foot on it behind you, hands on your hips.
Bend your front knee and lower straight down until your front thigh is level with the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A split squat with your back foot up on a box behind you, using just your body weight. It works the glutes and quads, with help from the hamstrings.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand next to an incline bench and hold the top of its backrest with one hand. Set your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Rise onto your toes and push your knees forward as you lean back, keeping a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower until your thighs are about level with the floor, or as far as you can comfortably go.
Push through the balls of your feet and straighten your knees to come back up.
description: A bodyweight squat where you rise onto your toes and lean back as your knees move forward. It works the quads, with help from the calves and glutes.

name: Staircase Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a stair or sturdy step with your toes on it and your heels hanging off.
Hold a railing or wall for balance if you need to.
Raise your heels as high as you can, lifting your weight onto the balls of your feet.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
description: A calf raise on the edge of a stair, so your heels can travel further than they do on flat floor. It works the calves.

name: Butterfly Yoga Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, letting your knees drop out to the sides.
Hold your ankles or feet with your hands.
Lean forward over your feet and gently press your knees toward the floor until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold for the set time, then sit up, bring your knees back up and straighten your legs.
description: A seated stretch with the soles of your feet together and your knees out to the sides. It stretches the inner thighs and loosens the hips.

name: Quadriceps Stretch
instructions: Get on your hands and knees, hands flat under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Lift one knee off the floor and raise that leg behind you, knee bent, until your thigh is level with the floor.
Reach back with the same-side hand and hold the top of that foot until the front of your thigh stretches.
Hold for the set time, then let go, lower your knee back to the floor and switch sides.
description: A quad stretch done on hands and knees, lifting one leg behind you and holding the foot. It stretches the quads on the front of the thigh.

name: Barbell Full Zercher Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Hold a barbell in the bends of your elbows, with your hands gripping the bar to keep it steady.
Keep your chest up and sit your hips back and down, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, or deeper if you can do it comfortably.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
description: A deep squat with the barbell held in the bends of your elbows instead of on your back. It works the glutes and quads, and your abs work hard to keep you upright.

name: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and a band looped around one ankle.
Bend that knee, run the band over your shoulder, and hold it with both hands in front of your head.
Pull the band to draw your heel toward your glutes until the front of your thigh stretches. Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for the set time, then ease off slowly until your shin points straight up and switch legs.
description: A face-down stretch using a band over your shoulder to pull your heel toward your glutes. It stretches the quads on the front of the thigh.

name: Leg Up Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee and pull it toward your chest, holding your thigh or shin.
Straighten that leg up toward the ceiling as far as you can, keeping it raised.
Hold for the set time, then lower the leg and switch sides.
description: A lying stretch where you pull one knee to your chest, then straighten that leg toward the ceiling. It stretches the hamstrings on the back of the thigh, and the glutes.

name: Reclining Big Toe Pose with Band
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your arms by your sides.
Loop a band or strap around the ball of your right foot and hold an end in each hand.
Raise your right leg slowly toward your chest, keeping your knee straight and your toes pulled back toward you.
Hold for the set time, then lower your leg slowly to the floor and switch legs.
description: A lying hamstring stretch: loop a strap around one foot and use it to raise your straight leg toward your chest. It stretches the hamstrings on the back of the thigh.

name: Runners Stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Step one foot a short way forward and rest it on the heel, toes pointing up.
Keep your front leg straight, bend your back knee slightly, and fold forward from your hips to reach both hands toward your front toes.
Hold for the set time, then rise slowly back to standing, bring your feet together and switch legs.
description: A standing stretch where you fold over a straight front leg with the toes pulled up. It stretches the hamstrings and calves of the front leg.

name: Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and spread wide, hands resting on your thighs.
Pull your toes back toward you and tighten the fronts of your thighs.
Lean forward from your hips over one leg, sliding both hands down toward that foot, until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold for the set time, then rise slowly back to sitting upright and switch sides.
description: A seated wide-legged stretch where you fold forward over one leg, reaching for that foot. It stretches the hamstrings.

name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch with Band
instructions: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold one end in each hand.
Keep your legs straight and hinge forward from your hips, back straight, sliding your hands down to about knee height.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the backs of your thighs and calves.
Hold for the set time, then stand back up slowly.
description: A standing stretch where you fold forward from the hips with straight legs, holding a band looped under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Step into a long, low lunge with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Lean forward and put both hands on the floor inside your right foot.
Straighten your back leg until you feel the stretch, and hold for a few seconds.
Bend your back knee and lift your chest back up into the lunge.
Switch to your left foot forward and repeat.
description: A deep lunge stretch with both hands on the floor inside your front foot. It stretches the hamstrings, glutes, quads and calves.

name: Hammer Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat height. Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and your upper arms resting on it.
Hold the handles with your palms facing each other (thumbs up).
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl the handles up toward your forehead.
Lower the handles slowly back to the start.
description: A machine preacher curl with handles that keep your palms facing each other, thumbs up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit in the preacher curl machine with your armpits on top of the pad. Hold the handles with your palms facing down.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad, arms nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl the handles up toward your forehead.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight again.
description: A machine preacher curl done with your palms facing down. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Hammer Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked under the pads.
Hold a dumbbell on your chest in one hand, palm facing in (thumb toward your head).
Press the dumbbell straight up, stopping just before your elbow locks.
Lower it toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Press it back up. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm dumbbell press on a decline bench with your palm facing in. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline Single Arm Hammer Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Lean back and use your thigh to help lift the dumbbell to shoulder height. Turn your wrist so your palm faces in toward your body.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm dumbbell press on an incline bench with your palm facing in. It works the triceps, with help from the shoulders and chest.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Reverse Grip Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold one dumbbell at the bottom of your chest with your palm facing your head and your elbow close to your side.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight above your shoulder.
Lower it slowly back to your chest. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm dumbbell press on a flat bench, holding the weight with your palm facing your head. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Bench Press
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench, feet on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing toward your head.
Start with the dumbbells just above your lower chest, handles in one line, elbows close to your sides.
Press the dumbbells straight up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Lower them slowly back to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
description: A flat dumbbell press with your palms facing your head and your elbows tucked close to your sides. It works the upper chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Smith Machine Decline Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Set a bench to a decline under a Smith machine bar and lie on it with your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly closer than shoulder-width and unhook it from the rack.
Lower the bar slowly until it is just above your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: A decline bench press on a Smith machine with your hands set close together. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: EZ Bar Close Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your back straight and rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with your palms facing up and your hands close together, arms straight.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A curl with an EZ bar on a preacher bench, hands close together and upper arms braced on the pad. It works the biceps.

name: Barbell Standing Wide Grip Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with your palms facing up and your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing barbell curl with your hands set wider than your shoulders. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Cable Close Grip Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up and your hands close together, no wider than your shoulders.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A cable curl on a straight bar with your hands close together and palms facing up. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench at a low pulley with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the handle in one hand, palm facing up, and rest that elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl from a low cable, done sitting with your elbow braced against your thigh. It works the biceps.

name: Cable Drag Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and stand facing the machine. Hold the bar at your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Pull your elbows back behind you as you curl, sliding the bar up the front of your body.
Stop when the bar reaches your lower chest.
Lower slowly along the same path until your arms are straight.
description: A cable curl where your elbows move back so the bar slides up your body instead of swinging out. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Cable Lying Bicep Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and lie face up on a flat bench, with the pulley at your feet.
Put your feet flat on the floor. Hold the bar with your palms facing up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Start with your arms straight and your elbows close to your sides.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done lying face up on a bench, pulling a cable bar from a low pulley at your feet. It works the biceps, and the cable keeps them under tension the whole way.

name: Cable Seated Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and sit on a flat bench in front of it, feet flat on the floor and back straight.
Hold the bar with your palms facing up and your arms straight.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl done sitting on a flat bench, pulling a straight bar from a low cable. It works the biceps, with steady tension from the cable.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand.
Straighten your arms and turn your palms to face each other (thumbs up).
Keeping your upper arm on the pad, curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A preacher curl done one arm at a time with your palms facing each other, thumbs up. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad and let your arms straighten fully.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl one dumbbell up to shoulder level.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A dumbbell curl on a preacher bench, one arm at a time, with your upper arms braced on the pad. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a backrest, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging down and your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight, your elbows close to your sides and your palms facing in (thumbs up) the whole time.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder level, keeping your upper arm still.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight, then curl the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated curl done one arm at a time with your palms facing each other, thumbs up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supine Bicep Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with your head supported and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and let your arms hang straight down below the sides of the bench, palms facing up.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A dumbbell curl done lying on your back on a flat bench, with your arms hanging below the bench. Lying down keeps your body still, so the biceps do the work.

name: Dumbbell Lying Wide Curl
instructions: Lie on your back on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Hold your arms straight out wide to your sides, about level with the bench.
Keeping your upper arms still and out wide, curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A curl done lying on a flat bench with your arms held out wide to the sides. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the back of one upper arm on the pad. Hold a dumbbell in that hand, palm facing in (thumb up).
Start with that arm nearly straight.
Keep your upper arm on the pad and curl the dumbbell up toward your face, thumb still pointing up.
Lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm preacher curl done with your palm facing in, thumb up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell High Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and raise your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms facing up.
Keep your upper arms level with the floor and still.
Bend your elbows to curl the dumbbells in toward the sides of your head.
Straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides, keeping them at shoulder height.
description: A curl done with your upper arms held out to the sides at shoulder height. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your arm hanging at your side, palm facing in (thumb up).
Keep your elbow at your side and curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, palm still facing in.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated one-arm curl with your palm facing in, thumb up, and your back supported. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Standing Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in one hand, arm straight down, palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm still and curl the dumbbell up until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A standing dumbbell curl done one arm at a time. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Standing Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand, arm hanging at your side, palm facing your thigh.
Keep your elbow at your side and your palm facing in (thumb up) the whole time.
Curl the dumbbell up until it reaches your shoulder.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
description: A one-arm curl done standing, with your palm facing in and thumb up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Hammer Curl
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor, elbows slightly bent, palms facing each other (thumbs up).
Keep your upper arms still and curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms hang straight down again.
description: A curl done lying chest down on an incline bench, with your palms facing each other. Lying on the bench cuts out swinging, so the biceps and forearms do the work.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit up straight on a bench with a back rest, feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-arm dumbbell curl done sitting against a back rest, which keeps your body from swinging. It works the biceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a back rest, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight down and palms facing your body.
Keep your upper arms still and your palms facing in (thumbs up) as you curl both dumbbells up to shoulder level.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A two-arm curl done sitting against a back rest, with your palms facing each other, thumbs up. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Preacher Curl on Incline Bench
instructions: Raise a bench's backrest to about 45 degrees. Stand behind it and lean over the top so the back of one upper arm rests flat on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in that hand with your arm nearly straight down the pad, palm facing up.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your upper arm pressed into the pad.
Lower it slowly until your arm is nearly straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm curl done standing behind an incline bench, with the back of your upper arm resting on the backrest. It works the biceps and the forearms.

name: EZ Bar Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and lean forward.
Hold an EZ bar with your palms facing up and your hands close together.
Rest your elbows against the insides of your thighs, just above the knees.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A seated curl with an EZ bar, hands close together and elbows braced against your inner thighs. Bracing your elbows keeps the work on the biceps.

name: Smith Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Set the Smith machine bar at waist height and stand facing it, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing forward, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing barbell curl in a Smith machine, with the bar moving on a fixed track. It works the biceps.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a deep squat.
Stand back up and rise onto your toes, reaching both arms overhead toward the ceiling.
Lower your arms and heels as you squat down again.
description: A deep bodyweight squat that finishes on your toes with both arms reaching overhead. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Squat to Overhead Reach with Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to lower into a squat.
Stand back up, reaching your arms overhead and turning your upper body to one side.
Turn back to face forward, then squat again and turn to the other side this time. Keep alternating sides.
description: A bodyweight squat that ends with an overhead reach and a twist, turning to the other side each rep. It works the quads and glutes, plus the abs and obliques.

name: Lunge with Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and lower into a lunge.
Twist your upper body to the right as you lower, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee.
Turn back to face forward and push off your right foot to stand up.
Do the same with your left foot forward, twisting to the left. Keep alternating sides.
description: A forward lunge with a twist of your upper body toward the front leg. It works the abs, with the quads, glutes and hamstrings helping, and trains balance.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Bend your knees slightly to dip down.
Straighten your legs hard and use that drive to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders.
description: An overhead dumbbell press where a quick knee dip and leg drive help push the weights up. It works the front of the shoulders, with the triceps and abs helping.

name: Medicine Ball Close Grip Push Up
instructions: Get into a pushup position with both hands together on a medicine ball. Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the ball, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with both hands together on a medicine ball. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Barbell Incline Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie back on it with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly closer than shoulder-width and lift it off the rack.
Lower the bar slowly until it touches your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
description: An incline bench press with your hands closer than shoulder-width. It works the triceps, with help from the upper chest and shoulders.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at the end and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a barbell with your hands shoulder-width apart and your palms facing your face.
Press the bar straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows in and your wrists straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly toward your forehead, keeping your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms to raise the bar back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps extension with a barbell, held with your palms facing you instead of away. It works the triceps, with the forearms helping.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Stand facing away from the machine and lean forward.
Hold the rope with both hands and straighten your arms overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your head, and bend your elbows to lower the rope behind your head.
Straighten your arms to bring the rope back overhead.
description: A triceps extension with a rope from a high pulley, done standing with your back to the machine and leaning forward. It works the triceps.

name: Cable Single Arm Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle in one hand, palm facing down, with your elbow bent and tucked at your side.
Keeping your upper arm still, push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let the handle rise slowly until your elbow is fully bent again. Do all your reps with one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm triceps pushdown on a high cable with a single handle. It works the triceps, with some help from the forearms.

name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Grip Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to the low pulley and stand with your back to the machine. Hold the handle in one hand, palm facing up.
Raise that elbow so it points at the ceiling, with the handle behind your head and the cable running down behind you.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow to press the handle straight up overhead.
Bend your elbow slowly to lower the handle back behind your head. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: A one-arm overhead tricep extension with a low cable behind you and your palm facing up. It works the triceps on the back of the upper arm.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Alternate Kickback
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Bend forward at the waist until your back is straight and level with the floor.
Push one dumbbell straight back, keeping your arm close to your body, until your arm is fully straight.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back down, then do the other arm. Keep alternating sides.
description: A triceps kickback done sitting on a bench and bent forward, straightening one arm back at a time. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Incline Tricep Extension
instructions: Set a bench to a steep incline and sit with your back against it, feet flat on the floor.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both palms cupped under its top end, and press it straight up above your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up, close to your head, and bend them to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms to raise it back above your head.
description: An overhead tricep extension done sitting back on an incline bench, holding one dumbbell with both hands. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward from your hips with your back straight. Lift your elbows back so your upper arms run along your sides, elbows bent.
Straighten both arms back, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells slowly back to the start.
description: A seated, bent-forward move where you straighten both arms behind you with dumbbells. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Single Arm Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, bend your knees, and lean forward from your hips until your back is almost level with the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing in. Raise your elbow so your upper arm is level with your back, forearm hanging down.
Keep your upper arm still and straighten your elbow, pushing the dumbbell back until your arm is straight.
Bend your elbow slowly to bring the dumbbell back down. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A bent-over, one-arm move that straightens your elbow to push a dumbbell back behind you. It works the triceps.

name: Dumbbell Twisting Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand straight up over your chest, palms facing your feet, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells toward your chest, elbows close to your body, turning your wrists so your palms face toward you at the bottom.
Press the dumbbells back up, turning your wrists until your palms face your feet again.
description: A flat dumbbell bench press where you turn your wrists on the way down and back up. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: EZ Bar Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at the end of it and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold an EZ bar with your hands close together, palms facing up, and press it straight up over your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the bar slowly behind your head.
Straighten your arms to bring the bar back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps extension where you lower an EZ bar behind your head by bending only your elbows, then straighten your arms. It works the triceps.

name: Medicine Ball Supine Chest Throw
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a medicine ball in both hands with your arms straight up over your chest.
Lower the ball to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push the ball up hard, straightening your arms, and throw it as high as you can.
Catch it and bring it back down to your chest for the next throw.
description: A power drill where you lie on the floor and throw a medicine ball straight up from your chest. It works the triceps, chest and shoulders.

name: Smith Machine Incline Tricep Extension
instructions: Set an incline bench in a Smith machine with the bar at shoulder height. Sit back against the pad, feet flat on the floor.
Hold the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your arms to lift the bar off the hooks and hold it over your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your head and bend them to lower the bar slowly toward your forehead.
Straighten your arms to push the bar back up over your chest.
description: A lying triceps extension on an incline bench in a Smith machine, lowering the bar toward your forehead. It works the triceps.

name: Weighted Tricep Dips
instructions: Put on a dip belt with a plate hanging from the chain. Grip the parallel bars of a dip station, palms facing each other.
Push up until your arms are straight, and bend your knees so your feet are off the floor.
Lean slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are about level with the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip on parallel bars with a weight plate hanging from a belt at your waist. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with your palms facing you.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the floor.
Bend forward at the hips with your back straight, reaching your right leg straight back behind you.
Lower the bar toward the floor, keeping it close to your body and your left knee slightly bent.
Lift your upper body back up to standing. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-leg deadlift with a barbell, reaching your free leg back as you lean forward. It works the glutes, with the hamstrings and lower back helping, and tests your balance.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the floor.
Bend forward at the hips with your back straight, lowering the dumbbell toward the floor as your right leg reaches straight back.
Keep your left knee slightly bent and go down until your upper body and right leg are level with the floor.
Lift your upper body back up to standing. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-leg deadlift holding a dumbbell, reaching your free leg back as you lean forward. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back, and tests your balance.

name: Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Have a partner kneel at your feet and hold them down.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your upper body up off the floor until your torso is upright.
Lower your upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A situp with a partner holding your feet down, so you can curl all the way up. It works the abs.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms straight out in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the floor and hold that leg straight out in front of you.
Bend your left knee and push your hips back to lower yourself, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your left thigh is level with the floor, or as low as you can.
Push through your left heel to stand back up. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A hard one-leg squat with your free leg and both arms held straight out in front. It works the glutes and quads and needs good balance.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell upright against your chest with both hands.
Keep your chest up, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat holding one dumbbell upright against your chest. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight and your palms facing away from you.
Lift your knees toward your chest, twisting your body so they come up to one side.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
Raise your knees again, twisting to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A hanging knee raise with a twist, bringing your knees up to one side, then the other. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides.

name: Hanging Leg Hip Raise
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your arms straight and your palms facing away from you.
Bend your knees and lift them toward your chest until your thighs are level with the floor.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight again.
description: A hanging raise where you lift your bent knees until your thighs are level with the floor. It works the abs and the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your feet anchored under a strap or something sturdy, or held down by a partner.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, with your hands ready in front of you.
Lower your body forward slowly by straightening your knees, using your hamstrings to control how fast you go down.
Go as far as you can under control, and catch yourself on your hands if needed.
Push off the floor lightly if you need to, and use your hamstrings to pull yourself back up.
description: A kneeling move where you lower your body forward with your feet held down, then pull yourself back up. It works the hamstrings hard, especially on the way down.

name: Bicep Leg Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a low stool with your feet flat on the floor and your knees wide apart.
Reach your right hand down and hook it under your left knee, palm facing up.
Curl your right hand up, lifting your left knee toward your chest. Let the leg hang loose so your arm does the work.
Lower the leg slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A seated curl that uses your own leg as the weight, with one hand hooked under the opposite knee. It works the biceps and forearms.

name: Bodyweight Kneeling Tricep Extension
instructions: Kneel on the floor and lean forward onto your forearms, elbows under your shoulders, palms flat on the floor in front of your face.
Keep your hips above your knees.
Press your palms into the floor and straighten your arms, lifting your elbows and chest off the floor.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower your forearms back to the floor.
description: A kneeling bodyweight move that presses you up from your forearms onto straight arms. It works the triceps, with help from the shoulders and chest.

name: Elbow Lift Reverse Pushup
instructions: Set two padded stools of the same height side by side, a little wider than your shoulders apart.
Lie face up between them with your legs straight and heels on the floor. Rest one elbow on each pad, forearms pointing up.
Press your elbows down into the pads to lift your chest and hips until your body is straight from heels to shoulders.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: A face-up lift where you press your elbows down into two raised pads to raise your body into a straight line. It works the upper back, with help from the shoulders.

name: Side Bridge Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, with your elbow right under your shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body is in a straight line from head to feet.
Raise your top leg as high as you can without letting your hips turn.
Lower the leg back down. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side plank on your forearm with a top-leg raise. It works the outer hips and glutes, with the obliques helping hold you up.

name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side next to a flat bench, propped on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, top hand on your chest.
Rest your top foot on the bench with that leg straight, and let your bottom leg lie on the floor.
Lift your hips until your body is in a straight line, raising your bottom leg up to meet the bench.
Lower your hips and bottom leg slowly toward the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side plank with your top foot on a bench, lifting your bottom leg up to meet it. It works the inner thighs, with help from the obliques and glutes.

name: Farmers Walk (Time)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps, staying upright.
Keep going for the set time.
description: A carry where you walk holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. It works the quads, calves, forearms and grip, and your abs work to keep you upright.

name: Weighted Front Plank
instructions: Lie face down with your forearms on the floor and your elbows under your shoulders.
Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back, or set it there yourself before you lift.
Straighten your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body so you rest on your forearms and toes, straight from your head to your heels. Hold for the set time.
description: A forearm plank with a weight plate on your upper back for extra load. It works the abs, with help from the shoulders and lower back.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a back rest. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, elbows bent, palms facing you.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight, turning your wrists as you go so your palms face forward at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to your shoulders, turning your palms to face you again.
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press that turns your palms from facing you to facing forward as you press. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper chest.

name: Hands Bike (Time)
instructions: Set the seat height and handles so you can reach the handles comfortably.
Sit tall with your feet on the footplate. Hold a handle in each hand with your elbows bent at about a right angle.
Turn the handles in circles with your hands, pushing and pulling at a smooth, steady pace.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Cardio on an arm bike: you sit and turn the handles in circles with your hands instead of your feet. It works your heart and lungs, plus the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Elliptical (Time)
instructions: Set the elliptical's resistance and incline to the level you want.
Step onto the pedals and hold the moving handles lightly.
Push down with your feet and pull the handles toward you. Keep pushing and pulling in turn, in a walking or running motion.
Keep a steady pace and your abs tight.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Cardio on an elliptical machine that is easy on the joints, your legs moving in a walking or running motion while your arms push and pull the handles. It works your heart and lungs, plus your legs and glutes.

name: Ski Ergometer (Time)
instructions: Stand facing the ski machine and hold a handle in each hand, arms reaching up overhead.
Pull the handles down hard while bending forward at your hips.
Let your arms swing back as you finish the pull.
Stand back up and reach overhead again, keeping a steady rhythm.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Cardio on a ski machine, pulling two handles down from overhead as you bend at the hips, like poling in cross-country skiing. It works your heart and lungs, plus the shoulders, forearms and abs.

name: Dumbbell Standing Around World
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight down in front of your thighs, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms straight and your palms facing forward as you raise the dumbbells out to your sides.
Keep going in a wide arc until the dumbbells meet above your head.
Lower them slowly along the same arc back to your thighs.
description: A raise that sweeps straight arms out to the sides and all the way overhead. It works the side shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands and straighten your arms overhead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.
description: A seated triceps extension, lowering one dumbbell behind your head with both hands. It works the triceps.

name: Pullover
instructions: Set the seat and handles to fit you. Sit with your back against the pad.
Reach up and grip the handles above your head, palms facing forward, arms slightly bent.
Pull the handles forward and down in a wide arc until they reach your belly.
Let the handles rise slowly back above your head.
description: A seated machine pullover: you sweep your arms from overhead down to your belly. It works the lats, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Alternate Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplates, then sit with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footplates.
Hold the handles or the sides of the machine.
Push one footplate away by straightening that leg until it's almost fully straight.
Bend the leg slowly to bring the plate back, then press with the other leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A machine leg press where each leg pushes its own footplate, one at a time. It works the quads, with the hamstrings and glutes helping.

name: Gripper Hands
instructions: Adjust the seat height, sit down and grip the machine's handle.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze the handle and hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly until your hand opens back up.
description: A hand squeeze against a loaded handle on a seated grip machine. It works the forearms and your grip.

name: Calf Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your legs straight out in front of you.
Put the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, heels hanging off. Hold the handles at your sides.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes, keeping your legs straight.
Let the platform come back slowly, bending your ankles to stretch your calves.
description: A machine calf raise done sitting with your legs straight, pushing a platform away with the balls of your feet. It works the calves.

name: Dumbbell Standing Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your torso upright and pull the dumbbells up and back along your sides until they reach your waist, elbows pointing out and back.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A row done standing upright, pulling the dumbbells up and back along your sides with your elbows out. It works the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Inverted Row with Feet on Bench
instructions: Set a Smith machine bar at about waist height and place a flat bench where your heels will rest when you lie under the bar.
Lie under the bar and grab it with your palms facing toward your feet, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Rest your heels on the bench and hang with your arms straight and your body straight from head to heels.
