Pull your chest up to the bar, keeping your body straight.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: An inverted row under a Smith machine bar with your heels up on a bench, which makes it harder than with your feet on the floor. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Inverted Row Bent Knees
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at about waist height and lie on your back underneath it.
Grab the bar with your palms facing toward your feet, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor, keeping your body straight from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest up to the bar, pulling your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row done hanging under a bar with your knees bent and feet flat, which makes it easier than the straight-leg version. It works the upper back.

name: Stairmaster (Time)
instructions: Set the stair machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the stairs and rest your hands on the handrails for support.
Climb one step at a time, stepping up with one foot and then the other.
Stay upright and keep your abs tight.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Cardio on a stair-climbing machine, stepping up moving stairs while you hold the handrails. It works your heart and lungs, plus your legs.

name: Lying Elbow to Knee
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Cross one ankle over the other knee.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing out.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor and twist to bring your opposite elbow toward the raised knee.
Lower slowly back to the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch legs.
description: A crunch with one ankle crossed over the other knee, twisting your opposite elbow toward it. It works the abs and the obliques.

name: Spine Twist
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs straight in front of you, toes pointing up.
Fold your arms in front of your chest at shoulder height, elbows out.
Keep your hips and legs still and twist your upper body to one side as far as you can.
Turn back through the middle and twist to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated twist with straight legs and your arms held in front of your chest. It works the abs and the obliques.

name: Assault Bike
instructions: Sit on the bike with your feet on the pedals and your hands on the handles.
Pedal while you push and pull the handles.
Keep a steady pace, or switch between hard and easy bursts for intervals.
Pedal and push faster to make it harder. The fan pushes back more the faster you go.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Cardio on a fan bike, pedaling while you push and pull the handles, with the fan pushing back harder the faster you go. It works your heart and lungs and your whole body.

name: Seated Calf Press
instructions: Sit in a leg press machine with your back against the pad and hold the handles at your sides.
Place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the footplate, heels off, and straighten your legs.
Keep your legs straight and point your toes to push the footplate away.
Let your heels come back slowly toward you until you feel a stretch in your calves.
description: A calf raise done on a seated leg press, pushing the footplate with your toes while your legs stay straight. It works the calves.

name: Kneeling Wide Grip Chest Dip
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and kneel on the pad.
Grip the handles with your hands wide apart and your elbows slightly bent.
Bend your elbows to lower your body until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Straighten your arms to push yourself back up.
description: A dip on an assisted machine, kneeling on a pad that takes some of your weight, with your hands wide. It works the lower chest, with the triceps and shoulders helping.

name: Split Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, then step one foot about two feet in front of the other.
Keep your back straight and bend both knees and hips to lower your body.
Stop when your front thigh is level with the floor and your back knee is just above it.
Push through your front heel to rise back up, keeping your feet in place.
Do all your reps on one side, then switch legs.
description: A bodyweight squat in a split stance, one foot in front of the other, with your feet staying in place. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Scott Press
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your face, elbows bent and in front of your chest, palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells straight up, turning your palms to face forward, until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower them slowly back to the front of your face, elbows forward, turning your palms to face each other again.
description: A standing dumbbell press that starts with the weights in front of your face and your elbows forward. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps.

name: Kneeling Close Grip Pushup
instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your knees hip-width apart and your hands close together under your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest until it's just above the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
description: A pushup from your knees with your hands close together, easier than a full close-grip pushup. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Cable Seated Twist
instructions: Set the pulley at shoulder height. Sit on a bench with the machine at your side and your feet flat on the floor.
Turn toward the machine and hold the handle with both hands, arms straight.
Turn your upper body slowly away from the machine, pulling the cable across your body.
Turn back slowly toward the machine.
Sit facing the other way to work the other side.
description: A seated twist against a cable, turning your upper body with your arms straight out in front. It works the abs, especially the obliques at your sides.

name: Frog Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head, elbows out.
Bend your knees, let them fall out to the sides, and press the soles of your feet together.
Curl your head and shoulders up while lifting your feet and pulling your knees toward your chest.
Lower your upper body and feet slowly back to the floor, soles still together.
description: A crunch with the soles of your feet together and knees out to the sides, pulling your knees in as you curl up. It works the abs and the front of the hips.

name: Cable Kayak Row
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley. Stand facing the machine a step back, feet hip-width apart.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight out in front at shoulder height.
Keep your arms straight and pull the bar down and across to one hip, turning your torso slightly toward that side.
Let the bar rise slowly back to shoulder height, then pull it down to the other hip. Keep alternating sides.
description: A standing straight-arm cable pull from a high pulley, sweeping the bar down to one hip and then the other like a paddle stroke. It works the lats, with help from the abs and obliques as you turn.

name: Cross Body Bridge Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your arms straight, hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Lift your right foot and bring your right knee across your body toward your left elbow.
Put your right foot back, then bring your left knee toward your right elbow.
Keep alternating sides at a controlled pace, with your hips level, not raised or sagging.
description: A mountain climber where each knee crosses your body toward the opposite elbow. It works the abs, with the shoulders, arms and legs helping.

name: Dumbbell Side Lying Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on the floor with your head resting on your bottom arm.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand on the floor in front of your face, palm facing down.
Keep your arm straight and raise the dumbbell until your arm points straight at the ceiling.
Lower slowly back to the floor in front of your face. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm raise done lying on your side, lifting the dumbbell from the floor until your arm points at the ceiling. It works the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
instructions: Sit on a stool with your feet flat. Cross one ankle over the other knee.
Rest one hand on the crossed ankle and the other hand on your other knee.
Lean your chest forward over your crossed leg until you feel a stretch in the hip of that leg.
Hold for the set time, then sit back up slowly and switch sides.
description: A seated stretch with one ankle crossed over the other knee as you lean your chest forward. It stretches the glutes and outer hip of the crossed leg.

name: Rocking Frog Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your knees spread wide and your lower legs on the floor behind you.
Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders and your hips over your knees.
Rock your hips back toward your heels until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs.
Rock forward slowly until your hips are over your knees again.
description: A kneeling stretch with your knees spread wide, rocking your hips back and forth while resting on your forearms. It stretches the inner thighs.

name: Horizontal Single Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee bends to about 90 degrees when your foot is on the footplate.
Sit with your back against the backrest and hold the handles at your sides.
Put one foot on the footplate and keep the other foot off it.
Press through your foot to straighten your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Bend your knee slowly to return to the start. Do all your reps with one leg, then switch.
description: A leg press done one leg at a time on a seated, horizontal machine. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold a handle in each hand, palms facing in. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes toward your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and jump again as the rope comes back around.
description: Jumping in place over a rope you swing around your body. It raises your heart rate and works the calves, with help from the quads, hamstrings and glutes.

name: Cable Lateral Pulldown with V Bar
instructions: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and sit on a bench facing the machine.
Reach up and hold the V-bar with both hands, palms facing each other.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pulldown with a V-shaped handle that keeps your palms facing each other, done sitting on a bench at a high pulley. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation on Floor
instructions: Lie on your side with your head resting on your bottom arm. Hold a dumbbell loaded on one end in your top hand.
Rest your top upper arm along your side and bend that elbow so your forearm points out in front of your stomach.
Start with your thumb pointing up, palm facing toward your head, and the weighted end hanging toward the floor.
Turn your forearm to swing the weighted end up until it points at the ceiling and your thumb points at the floor.
Turn slowly back to the start. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A forearm twist done lying on your side, turning your thumb from up to down to swing a one-ended dumbbell up. It works the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supination on Floor
instructions: Lie on your side, propped on your bottom arm, hand flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell loaded on one end in your top hand.
Rest your top upper arm along your side and bend that elbow so your forearm points out in front of your stomach.
Start with your thumb pointing at the floor, palm facing toward your feet, and the weighted end hanging toward the floor.
Turn your forearm to swing the weighted end up until it points at the ceiling and your thumb points up.
Turn slowly back to the start. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A forearm twist done lying on your side, turning your thumb from down to up to swing a one-ended dumbbell up. It works the forearms.

name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit in the lever pulldown machine with your thighs under the pad and your feet flat.
Reach up and hold the handles with your palms facing you.
Pull the handles down, bringing your elbows down to your sides, until your hands reach your shoulders.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight overhead.
description: A plate-loaded lever pulldown done with your palms facing you. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and upper back.

name: EZ Bar Standing Wide Grip Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar with your palms facing up and your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl with an EZ bar, hands set wider than your shoulders. It works the biceps, with help from the forearms.

name: Dumbbell Stepup Lunge
instructions: Set two flat benches in a line with about a stride's gap between them. Stand in the gap facing the front bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing your thighs. Reach one foot back and rest its top on the rear bench.
Lift your standing foot off the floor and place it flat on the front bench, so you're in a lunge with both feet up.
Step that foot back down to the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A step-up done with your back foot resting on a bench behind you, lifting your front foot onto a second bench into a lunge. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Twisted Leg Raise
instructions: Step into a captain's chair, the upright station with forearm pads. Rest your forearms on the pads and grip the handles, legs hanging straight.
Keep your legs straight and together, turn your hips to one side, and raise your legs up and out toward that side.
Stop when your legs are level with your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs hang straight. Do all your reps to one side, then switch.
description: A straight-leg raise on a captain's chair that brings your legs up toward one side. It works the abs, with the twist adding the obliques.

name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
instructions: Stand on the footplate of the support stand with the roller in front of your ankles and the knee-high pad right behind you.
Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest, both palms cupped under its top end.
Keep your chest up, push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are level with the floor and you touch the pad.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
description: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest, sitting back until you touch a knee-high pad behind you. It works the quads, with help from the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift with Stepbox Support
instructions: Stand with a step box behind you, holding a dumbbell in your right hand. Rest your left foot on the box.
Keep your back straight and hinge forward at your hips, lowering the dumbbell toward the floor. Your back foot stays on the box.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your right thigh.
Push through your right foot to stand back up. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-leg deadlift with a dumbbell, hinging forward on your front leg while your back foot rests on a step box. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and lower back.

name: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise
instructions: Hold yourself up in a captain's chair with your forearms on the arm pads, hands on the handles, and back against the back pad.
Let your legs hang straight down and keep your upper body still.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them in front of you until they're level with the floor, or as high as you can.
Lower your legs slowly back down.
description: A straight-leg raise done while held up on your forearms in a captain's chair. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Weighted Close Grip Chinup
instructions: Put on a dip belt with a weight plate hanging from the chain.
Grab the pullup bar with your palms facing you, hands a few inches apart, and hang with your arms straight and knees bent.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chinup with your hands close together, palms facing you, and a weight plate hanging from a belt at your waist. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Resistance Band Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Loop a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees, and hold the sides of the seat for support.
Push your knees apart slowly against the band.
Bring your knees slowly back together.
description: A seated move where you push your knees apart against a band looped just above them. It works the outer hips, with help from the glutes.

name: Resistance Band Leg Extension
instructions: Loop a band around both ankles. Sit on the edge of a flat bench, feet flat on the floor, hands on the bench beside your hips.
Keep one foot on the floor and straighten the other knee, lifting that foot forward against the band until your leg is straight.
Bend your knee slowly to lower the foot back to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A seated leg extension with a loop band around both ankles, straightening one knee at a time against the band. It works the quads on the front of the thigh.

name: Hands Elevated Scapula Pushup
instructions: Place your hands on a flat bench, shoulder-width apart, palms down. Walk your feet back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Keep your arms straight and let your chest sink toward the bench, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Push the bench away to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
description: A small straight-arm push with your hands on a bench, moving only your shoulder blades. It works the serratus muscles along the sides of your ribs, with help from the shoulders.

name: Scapula Dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a flat bench, knees bent and feet flat. Place your hands on the edge beside your hips, palms down, fingers forward.
Straighten your arms and slide your hips just off the front of the bench.
Keep your arms straight and let your body sink as your shoulders rise toward your ears.
Push your shoulders down away from your ears to lift your body back up.
description: A small dip with straight arms and your hands on a bench, raising your body by pushing your shoulders down. It works the traps, with help from the upper back and shoulders.

name: Curlup
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat, and your other leg straight on the floor.
Slide your hands, palms down, under the small of your back.
Keep your lower back still and lift your head and shoulders just off the floor.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
description: A small curl-up with one knee bent, the other leg straight and your hands under your lower back. It works the abs.

name: Barbell Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand at a barbell on the floor with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips until your torso is nearly level with the floor, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Grip the bar with your palms facing down, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar from the floor up to your upper stomach, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar all the way back to the floor and let it stop before the next rep.
description: A bent-over barbell row where your torso stays nearly level with the floor and the bar goes back to the floor every rep. It works the upper back.

name: Bench Assisted Pullup
instructions: Place a flat bench beside you under a pullup bar.
Grab the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands a little wider than your shoulders. Rest one foot on the bench, knee bent.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar, pushing through the foot on the bench only as much as you need.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup with one foot on a bench, so your leg can take some of your weight. It works the lats, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Scapula Pushup
instructions: Get into a pushup position on straight arms, hands directly under your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Keep your arms straight and let your chest sink toward the floor by pulling your shoulder blades together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart and raise your chest back up.
description: A small move in the pushup position where your arms stay straight and only your shoulder blades move. It works the serratus, the muscles along your ribs just below your armpits, and builds shoulder control.

name: Band Fixed Back Underhand Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band with two handles high above you and sit on a box beneath it, feet flat on the floor.
Reach up and hold a handle in each hand, palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull the handles down in front of you, driving your elbows down to your sides, until your hands reach your chest.
Let your arms rise slowly until they are straight overhead.
description: A seated pulldown with a band anchored overhead, pulling with your palms facing you. It works the lats, with help from the biceps, upper back and rear shoulders.

name: Band Fixed Back Close Grip Pulldown
instructions: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy point above you, such as a pullup bar or beam.
Sit on a box, bench or chair facing the band, feet flat on the floor and knees bent.
Hold the band with your hands close together, palms facing you, and keep your back straight.
Pull the band down toward your chest, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms rise slowly until they are straight.
description: A seated pulldown on a band anchored above you, with your hands close together and palms facing you. It works the lats, the big muscles along the sides of your back.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms straight out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing down.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, swinging your arms forward until they point straight ahead.
Lower until your thighs are about halfway to level with the floor, keeping your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand up, opening your arms back out to your sides.
description: A squat with no weight, swinging your arms forward as you sit back to help you balance. It works the glutes and quads.

name: Resistance Band Seated Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower your hands slowly back to shoulder height.
description: A seated overhead press using a resistance band. It works the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Resistance Band Seated Bicep Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold the resistance band with your palms facing forward and your arms straight down by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still and curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower your hands slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl done sitting down, using a resistance band instead of weights. It works the biceps.

name: Resistance Band Seated Chest Press
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Wrap a resistance band behind your back and hold a handle in each hand, palms facing down, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Push your hands straight forward until your arms are straight.
Let your hands come back slowly until your elbows are bent to 90 degrees again.
description: A seated chest press with a resistance band wrapped behind your back. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders and triceps.

name: Potty Squat with Support
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly, holding the top of an incline bench or another steady support for balance.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a deep squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A deep bodyweight squat done holding onto a support for balance, which helps while you learn to squat. It works the glutes.

name: Smith Sumo Squat
instructions: Step under the Smith machine bar and rest it across your upper back and shoulders.
Set your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing out.
Keep your chest up, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A wide-stance squat in a Smith machine, with your toes pointing out and the bar across your upper back. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Resistance Band Seated Straight Back Row
instructions: Sit on a bench with an upright back pad, legs straight out in front of you. Loop the band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the band with your palms facing each other.
Sit tall with your back straight and pull the band toward you until your hands reach your sides, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms straighten slowly.
description: A band row done sitting on an upright bench, legs out straight and the band looped around your feet. It works the upper back.

name: Pushup Plus
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup, hands a little wider than your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows, keeping them close to your sides, until your chest is just above the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Push your upper back toward the ceiling so your shoulder blades spread apart.
Let your shoulder blades come back together, then lower into the next pushup.
description: A pushup with an extra push at the top that spreads your shoulder blades apart. It works the chest and the muscles that hold your shoulder blades steady.

name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, your feet flat on the floor and your hands by your sides.
Tighten your abs and tilt your pelvis up, pressing your lower back flat into the floor.
Hold for a few seconds.
Relax and let your pelvis tilt back down.
description: A small move done lying on your back, tilting your pelvis to press your lower back into the floor. It works the abs and is often used in rehab or as a first core exercise.

name: Bodyweight Standing Single Arm Row
instructions: Stand facing wall bars with your toes near the base. Grab a rung at chest height with one hand, palm facing down.
Lean back until your arm is straight, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the bars, driving your elbow back past your side.
Lower yourself slowly until your arm is straight. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A one-arm row using your body weight, leaning back from wall bars and pulling your chest in. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and forearms.

name: Bodyweight Towel Standing Row
instructions: Loop a towel around a wall bar rung at chest height. Hold one end in each hand, palms facing each other, with your toes near the base.
Lean back until your arms are straight, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the bars, driving your elbows back past your sides.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row on a towel looped around a wall bar, leaning back and pulling your chest in with both hands. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Bodyweight Standing Row
instructions: Stand facing a fixed bar at about chest height, such as a rung on wall bars, with your feet shoulder-width apart near its base.
Hold the bar with your palms facing down and lean back until your arms are straight, keeping your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly back until your arms are straight.
description: A standing row where you lean back from a fixed bar and pull your body toward it. It works the upper back, with help from the biceps and shoulders.

name: Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Adjust a glute ham raise machine to fit your body, then kneel on the pad with your ankles locked under the foot pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and kneel upright, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your upper body forward slowly, keeping your hips straight, until your body is nearly level with the floor.
Use your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up to kneeling upright.
description: A kneeling move on a glute ham raise machine where you lower your body forward and pull yourself back up with the backs of your legs. It works the hamstrings, with help from the glutes and lower back.

name: Frankenstein Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and rest a barbell on the front of your shoulders.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, palms down, with your hands off the bar.
Bend your knees and hips to sit back as if into a chair. Keep your back straight.
Lower until your thighs are level with the floor, or as low as you comfortably can.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat with the barbell balanced on the front of your shoulders and your arms held straight out, which makes you stay upright. It works the glutes, quads and hamstrings.

name: Quarter Situp
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight and together, arms straight along your sides, palms facing down.
Curl your head and shoulders a few inches off the floor, keeping your lower back down.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
description: A small situp with straight legs, lifting only your head and shoulders a few inches off the floor. It works the abs.

name: Arms Overhead Full Situp
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and together and your arms straight on the floor above your head.
Swing your arms up and forward as you sit up, peeling your back off the floor.
Keep your legs straight on the floor and fold forward over them until your hands reach your toes.
Roll back down slowly until your back and arms are flat on the floor again.
description: A full situp with straight legs that starts with your arms overhead and ends folded forward, hands at your toes. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips and the lower back.

name: Kneeling Pushup
instructions: Kneel on the floor and lean forward onto your hands, placed flat under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup done from your knees, an easier version of the full pushup. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Basic Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms reaching straight overhead.
Bend forward at the waist and reach your hands down toward your toes.
Keep your legs as straight as you can, with a slight bend in your knees.
Rise slowly and reach your arms back overhead.
description: A standing forward bend from arms overhead down to your toes. It stretches the glutes, hamstrings and calves.

name: Arms Apart Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms straight overhead, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms straight and bend forward at the hips, sweeping your hands down toward your toes.
Rise back up, reaching your straight arms out in front of you in a wide arc until they're overhead again.
At the top, lean back a little with your arms overhead, then fold forward again for the next rep.
description: A standing move that sweeps straight arms down to your toes and back up overhead in a wide arc. It works the glutes and stretches the hamstrings.

name: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Lace your fingers together, turn your palms up toward the ceiling, and straighten your arms overhead.
Fold forward from your hips and reach your clasped hands down to your toes.
Keep your hands clasped and sweep them around and up in a wide circle, reaching out in front of you as you rise.
Come up to standing and lean back a little with your arms overhead, then fold forward again for the next rep.
description: A standing stretch with your hands clasped overhead: fold down to touch your toes, then circle your arms back up. It works the glutes and stretches the backs of the legs.

name: Chest Tap Pushup
instructions: Get into a pushup position on straight arms, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up. At the top, lift your right hand, tap your chest, and put the hand back down.
Do the next pushup and tap with your left hand. Keep alternating sides.
description: A pushup with a one-handed chest tap at the top of each rep, so you balance on one hand for a moment. It works the chest, with help from the triceps and shoulders.

name: Modified Hindu Pushup
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your arms straight, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and feet hip-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Push through your hands and lift your hips up and back until your body makes an upside-down V, arms straight.
Lower your hips back down into the pushup position, then start the next rep.
description: A pushup that flows into an upside-down V: lower your chest, push your hips up high, then drop back into a plank. It works the chest, with help from the triceps, shoulders and abs.

name: Hands Clasped Circular Toe Touch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms straight overhead, hands clasped together.
Bend your knees slightly and fold forward at your hips, bringing your clasped hands down toward your toes as far as you can without straining.
Sweep your arms back up in front of you until they are overhead, and lean back slightly.
Keep your arms overhead and circle your upper body around: over to one side, then forward, then back up to standing tall.
description: A standing toe touch with your hands clasped: fold down to your toes, rise back up, then circle your upper body around with your arms overhead. It works the glutes and the backs of the legs.

name: Scissor Jumps
instructions: Stand in a split stance, one foot forward, knees slightly bent. Reach the arm opposite your front leg forward and the other arm back.
Jump up and switch your legs in the air, bringing your back foot forward and your front foot back.
Swap your arms as you switch, so the arm opposite your front leg is always forward.
Land softly and jump again right away. Keep alternating legs as fast as you can.
description: A jumping drill where you switch your feet front to back in midair while your arms swing the opposite way. It raises your heart rate and works the legs.

name: Semi Squat Jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower into a shallow squat.
Jump up hard, straightening your hips and knees and swinging your arms to help.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, sinking back into the squat, and go straight into the next jump.
description: A jump from a shallow squat, landing back in the squat and going again right away. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Hyght Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Sit on a bench set to a steep incline, back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging down and out beside your hips, palms facing in, elbows slightly bent.
Keeping that bend, raise the dumbbells out and up in a wide arc until they meet above your head, palms facing each other.
Lower them slowly along the same arc back beside your hips.
description: A fly on an incline bench where the dumbbells sweep from beside your hips up to meet above your head. It works the chest and the front of the shoulders.

name: Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Load the free end of a barbell set in a floor landmine. Stand side-on to it with the anchor out to your right.
Hold the bar end in front of your left hip with your right hand, palm facing down. Let your left arm hang.
Keeping your arm nearly straight, raise the bar out to your right side and up until your hand is well above shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly back across your body to your left hip. Do all your reps on one side, then turn around and switch hands.
description: A one-arm side raise using the end of a landmine barbell, lifting from across your hips out and up past shoulder height. It works the side of the shoulders, with help from the upper back.

name: Kneeling Plank Tap Shoulder
instructions: Kneel and rest your forearms on the floor under your shoulders, hands in loose fists, with your hips raised higher than your shoulders.
Rock forward and lower your hips until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your head.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, keeping your hips level.
Put that forearm back down and push your hips back up. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A forearm plank on your knees that rocks forward into a tap on the opposite shoulder. It works the abs, with the shoulders and triceps holding you up.

name: Weighted Ring Pull Up
instructions: Hang a weight plate from a dip belt around your waist.
Grab two gymnastic rings, palms facing away from you, and hang with your arms straight, knees bent and feet behind you.
Pull yourself up until your hands are level with your shoulders and your chin is above your hands.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A pullup on gymnastic rings with extra weight hanging from a belt at your waist. It works the lats and biceps.

name: Elbow Dips
instructions: Grip a pair of parallel bars, palms facing each other, and push up until your arms are straight and your legs hang below you.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bars.
Lower your forearms onto the bars and bring your upper body upright, so you are propped up on your forearms.
Press down through your hands to lift your elbows off the bars and straighten your arms back to the start.
description: A dip on parallel bars that goes all the way down onto your forearms before you press back up. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Korean Dips
instructions: Stand with your back to one bar of a dip station. Reach behind you and grip it with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing down.
Press up until your arms are straight and your feet are off the floor, body upright in front of the bar.
Bend your elbows and lean forward, letting your legs swing back under the bar, until your upper arms are level with the floor.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms and return upright.
description: A dip with your hands on a bar behind your back, leaning forward as you lower. It works the lower chest, front shoulders and triceps.

name: Impossible Dips
instructions: Grip a pair of parallel bars, palms facing each other, and press up until your arms are straight.
Hold your legs straight and together, angled forward in front of you, and keep them there the whole time.
Bend your elbows and let them travel back as you lower, leaning your body back, until your forearms are almost flat along the bars.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the start.
description: A dip on parallel bars with your legs held straight out in front, leaning back as you lower until your forearms nearly touch the bars. It works the triceps, with help from the chest and shoulders.

name: Weighted One Hand Pull Up
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and grab a pullup bar with the other, palm facing away from you.
Hang with your arm straight and the dumbbell hanging at your side.
Bend your elbow to pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arm is straight again.
description: An advanced one-arm pullup done holding a dumbbell in your free hand for extra weight. It works the lats, the large muscles down the sides of your back, plus the biceps and forearms.

name: Stalder Press
instructions: Place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart and kick up into a handstand, arms straight and legs together.
Spread your legs wide and lower them slowly out to the sides, keeping your arms and legs straight.
Keep lowering until your hips are just above the floor behind your hands, legs still straight and wide.
Lean your shoulders forward over your hands and press your hips back up, raising your legs until you're back in a handstand with legs together.
description: An advanced gymnastics move: lower from a handstand into a low, wide-legged support on your hands, then press back up to the handstand. It works the triceps and shoulders, with the core holding the shape.

name: Archer Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands a bit wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull yourself up, bending one arm and bringing that elbow toward your side while the other arm stays straight.
Keep pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until both arms are straight, then pull up on the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A wide pullup where one arm does the pulling while the other stays straight, switching sides each rep. It works the lats, the wide muscles of your back.

name: Archer Push Up
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Shift your weight toward one hand and keep the other arm straight out to the side.
Bend the elbow of the working arm to lower your chest toward that hand, keeping your back straight.
Push back up, then shift to the other side and lower toward the other hand. Keep alternating sides.
description: A wide pushup where you lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight out to the side, so one arm takes most of your weight. It works the chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a pullup bar with your hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you.
Tighten your abs and pull your shoulders down and back, away from your ears.
Tuck your knees to your chest, then straighten your legs out until your whole body is level with the floor, face up.
Hold for the set time, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your legs slowly back down to a hang.
description: An advanced hold where you hang from a bar with straight arms and keep your whole body level with the floor, face up. It works the abs, plus the lats, shoulders and forearms.

name: Back Lever
instructions: Hang from a pair of gymnastics rings with your arms straight and palms facing each other.
Tuck your knees to your chest and roll backward so your hips pass up between your arms and you're upside down.
Straighten your body and lower it behind you until it's level with the floor, face down, arms straight. Keep your body in one straight line.
Hold for a few seconds, then tuck your knees and roll back the way you came to a hang.
description: An advanced hold on gymnastics rings: you hang face down with your body straight and level with the floor, arms straight behind you. It works the upper back, with the biceps, forearms and core helping.

name: Straddle Planche
instructions: Crouch and place your hands flat on the floor about shoulder-width apart, arms straight.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands until your feet lift off the floor.
Straighten your legs and spread them wide, raising your hips until your body is level with the floor. Keep your arms straight the whole time.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower your feet slowly to the floor.
description: A straight-arm hold on your hands with your body level with the floor and your legs spread wide. It works the abs, with the shoulders, triceps and chest holding you up.

name: Full Planche
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Tighten your abs and slowly shift your weight forward until your feet lift off the floor.
Keep shifting forward until your body is level with the floor, balanced on your hands with your legs together.
Hold for the set time, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
description: An advanced hold with your whole body level with the floor, balanced only on your hands. It works the abs, with the shoulders and arms working hard to hold you up.

name: Lean Planche
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Tighten your abs and slowly lean forward until your shoulders are past your hands, toes still on the floor.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight.
Hold for the set time, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lean back slowly to where you started.
description: A pushup-position hold where you lean forward until your shoulders pass your hands, toes on the floor. It works the abs, with the shoulders, chest and triceps helping.

name: Frog Planche
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body toward the floor, keeping your back straight.
Lift your feet off the floor as you lower, and bring your knees in to rest on your elbows, head low.
Hold for the set time, keeping your back straight.
Put your feet down, extend your legs back out and push back up to the pushup position.
description: A balance on your hands with your knees resting on your bent elbows and your feet off the floor. It works the abs, with the shoulders, chest and triceps holding you up.

name: Handstand
instructions: Stand in an open space with your arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward and reach down to place your hands on the floor, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your back leg up and bring the other to meet it, until you are upside down over your hands with no wall behind you.
Hold for the set time, keeping your body in a straight line. Push through straight arms and use your shoulders and abs to stay up.
Lower your legs slowly back to the floor.
description: Balancing upside down on your hands after kicking up from standing, with no wall for support. It works the triceps and shoulders, and your abs help you hold the balance.

name: Flag
instructions: Grip a vertical pole with both hands, one above the other, palms facing each other and arms straight.
Tighten your abs and lift your feet off the floor, legs straight.
Raise your legs until your body is straight and level with the floor.
Hold for the set time, keeping your body in a straight line.
Lower your legs slowly back to the floor.
description: An advanced hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body straight out to the side, level with the floor. It works the abs, along with the shoulders and grip.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to lower into a squat.
Drive through your heels to stand up fast, pressing the bar overhead as you rise.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders as you sink into the next squat.
description: A front squat that flows straight into an overhead press with a barbell. It works the front of the shoulders, with the legs helping drive the bar up.

name: Weighted Muscle Up
instructions: Put on a belt with a weight hanging from it. Grab a pullup bar, palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms straight and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows to pull your chest to the bar, keeping your body straight.
Push down on the bar as your chest reaches it, driving your elbows back to lift your body above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to a hang.
description: A muscle up with extra weight hung from a belt: a pullup that turns into a dip above the bar. It works the lats, plus the biceps, triceps, shoulders and forearms.

name: Weighted Straight Bar Dip
instructions: Hang a weight plate from a dip belt around your waist.
Face one bar of a dip station and grip it with both hands, shoulder-width apart, palms facing down.
Push up until your arms are straight and the bar is at your hips, knees bent and feet behind you.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A dip with both hands on a single bar in front of you and a weight plate hanging from a belt. It works the lower chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Straddle Maltese
instructions: Lie face down and place your hands flat on the floor well wider than your shoulders, level with your waist.
Straighten your arms and lean forward to lift your whole body just off the floor.
Keep your legs straight and spread wide, and your body flat and close to the floor.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower slowly back to the floor.
description: An advanced floor hold on straight arms with your hands out wide, your body flat just above the floor and your legs spread apart. It works the abs, with the shoulders and chest holding you up.

name: Full Maltese
instructions: Lie face down and place your hands flat on the floor well wider than your shoulders, level with your waist.
Straighten your arms and lean forward to lift your whole body just off the floor.
Keep your legs straight and together, and your body flat and close to the floor.
Hold for a few seconds, then lower slowly back to the floor.
description: A floor hold on straight arms with your hands out wide, body flat just above the floor and legs together, which makes it harder than the straddle version. It works the abs, with the shoulders and chest holding you up.

name: Full Planche Pushup
instructions: Get into a pushup position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean forward over your hands and lift your feet off the floor, balancing on your hands with your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows, keeping them close to your sides, until your chest is just above the floor.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms, keeping your feet off the floor.
description: An advanced pushup done balancing on your hands with your whole body, feet included, held off the floor. It works the chest, shoulders, triceps and abs.

name: Bear Crawl (Time)
instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the floor, keeping your back flat.
Move your right hand and left foot forward together, then your left hand and right foot.
Keep crawling forward at a steady pace, alternating sides.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Crawling forward on your hands and feet with your knees just off the floor. It raises your heart rate and works the abs, shoulders and triceps.

name: Skater Hops
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump to the right and land on your right foot.
Swing your left leg behind your right as you land and tap the floor with your left toes.
Jump to the left, land on your left foot and tap your right toes behind it. Keep alternating sides.
description: Side-to-side hops from one foot to the other, like a speed skater. They raise your heart rate, work the legs and train agility and coordination.

name: L-pullup
instructions: Grab a pullup bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you, and hang with your arms straight.
Lift your legs straight out in front of you until they are level with the floor, making an L shape.
Hold the L and pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your legs up.
description: A pullup done while holding your legs straight out in front of you. It works the lats and biceps, and your abs work hard to hold the legs up.

name: L-sit on Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Tighten your abs and lift your straight legs off the floor, aiming to get them level with the floor so your body makes an L.
Hold as long as you can.
Lower your legs slowly back to the floor.
description: A seated hold with your hands beside your hips and your straight legs lifted level with the floor. It works the abs and the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: V-sit on Floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight in front of you. Place your hands flat on the floor beside your hips, arms straight.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips just off the floor.
At the same time, raise your straight legs until they point up at the ceiling, close to your chest.
Lower your legs and hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A V-sit done on straight arms: with your hands on the floor beside your hips, you lift your hips and raise straight legs until they point up. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot and lower your body.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping it over your ankle.
Push off your right foot to step back to the start, then lunge with your left leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A lunge stepping forward from standing, then pushing back to where you started. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Glute Bridge Two Legs on Bench
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your heels resting on a flat bench, knees bent, arms flat at your sides with palms down.
Press your heels into the bench and lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A glute bridge with your heels up on a bench and your back on the floor. It works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell Incline Y-raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Let your arms hang straight down, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms forward and up past your head in a Y shape, until they're in line with your body.
Lower your arms slowly until they hang straight down again.
description: A raise done lying face down on an incline bench, lifting the dumbbells up past your head in a Y shape. It works the upper back and the backs of the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Incline T-raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to 45 degrees. Lie face down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping them straight, until they're level with the floor and make a T with your body.
Lower your arms slowly until they hang straight down again.
description: A raise done lying face down on an incline bench, lifting straight arms out to the sides in a T shape. It works the backs of the shoulders and the upper back.

name: Bodyweight Drop Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and push your hips back to lower into a deep squat.
Jump up hard, straightening your hips, knees and ankles, and bring your feet together in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your feet together.
Hop your feet back out to shoulder-width and drop straight into the squat again.
description: A jump squat where you land with your feet together, then hop them apart and drop back into a deep squat. It works the glutes, with the quads, hamstrings and calves helping.

name: Bodyweight Incline Side Plank
instructions: Rest your forearm on a flat bench, elbow under your shoulder, hand in a loose fist. Walk your feet out and stack them on the floor.
Rest your top arm along your side.
Keep your hips up so your body forms a straight line from head to feet. Don't let your hips sag.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with your forearm up on a bench, which makes it easier than doing it on the floor. It works the abs and the obliques along your sides, with the shoulder helping hold you up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on your thighs.
Lean back and use your thighs to help lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then press the other one. Keep alternating sides.
description: An incline dumbbell press done one arm at a time. It works the upper chest, with the shoulders and triceps helping.

name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell straight up overhead while the other stays at your shoulder.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then press the other one up. Keep alternating sides.
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press done one arm at a time, alternating sides. It works the front of the shoulders, with help from the triceps and upper back.

name: Dumbbell Seated Bicep Curl to Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms straight down and your palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Turn your wrists so your palms face forward once your forearms are upright, then press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Reverse the movement: lower the dumbbells to your shoulders, turn your palms back toward you and lower your arms until they're straight.
description: A seated dumbbell curl that flows into an overhead press. It works the biceps and the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Carry
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is straight overhead.
Walk forward with the dumbbell held overhead, keeping your back straight.
Keep walking for the set time, then switch hands.
description: A walk with one dumbbell held straight overhead. It works the shoulders, while your upper back and abs keep you steady.

name: Glute Bridge March
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Keep your hips up and lift one foot, bringing that knee toward your chest.
Put the foot back down and lift the other knee. Keep alternating legs, like marching.
description: A glute bridge held at the top while you lift one knee at a time, as if marching. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and quads.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge Two Legs on Bench
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your heels resting on a flat bench and knees bent.
Set a loaded barbell across your hips. Hold it with your hands just outside your hips, palms facing down.
Press your heels into the bench and lift your hips and the bar until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
description: A glute bridge with your heels up on a bench, your back on the floor and a barbell across your hips. It works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: Cable Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable pulley and stand facing the machine, feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the handle with one hand, palm facing away from you, arm fully straight.
Keep your back straight and pull the handle down toward your side, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arm is straight again. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A standing pulldown from a high cable, one arm at a time. It works the lats, the wide muscles of your back, with the biceps and forearms helping.

name: Lunge with Jump
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your elbows bent at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push off your front foot and jump up, driving your back knee up to hip height.
Land softly on your front foot, set the other foot down beside it, and stand tall.
Step the other foot back for the next rep. Keep alternating sides.
description: A reverse lunge that ends in a jump, driving your back knee up to hip height as you leave the floor. It works the glutes and quads, with help from the hamstrings and calves.

name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in your right hand at your side, palm facing in, and your left hand on your hip.
Step forward with your left foot and bend both knees until your back knee is just above the floor.
Push through your front foot to step back to standing.
Do all your reps on one side, then hold the dumbbell in your left hand and step with your right foot.
description: A forward lunge holding one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg. It works the glutes and quads, and your trunk works to keep you from leaning.

name: High Knee Against Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart and lean in with your hands on the wall.
Lift your right knee toward your chest, keeping your left foot on the floor.
Switch quickly, bringing your left knee up as your right foot comes down.
Keep alternating legs fast, like running in place, with your knees as high as you can and your upper body steady.
description: Running in place with high knees while leaning on a wall for support. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves.

name: Bent Knee Lying Twist
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms straight out to the sides on the floor.
Lift your feet off the floor and raise your bent knees above your hips.
Lower your knees slowly to one side, toward the floor, keeping them together.
Use your abs to lift them back to the middle, then lower them to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A lying twist where you lower your bent, raised knees from side to side while your arms stay out on the floor. It works the abs and the obliques at your sides.

name: Knee Touch Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Rest your hands on the tops of your thighs.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor, sliding your hands up your thighs until your fingertips reach your knees.
Lower slowly until your shoulders are back on the floor.
description: A crunch where you slide both hands up your thighs to touch your knees. It works the abs.

name: Weighted Kneeling Step with Swing
instructions: Kneel tall on the floor with your knees hip-width apart and your hips over your knees.
Hold a weight plate flat in front of your hips, one hand on each side, palms facing each other.
Step one foot forward onto a flat foot while you swing the plate up in front of you to overhead, arms straight.
Lower the plate to your hips as you step back to kneeling, then step with the other foot. Keep alternating sides.
description: A step from tall kneeling onto one foot while you raise a weight plate overhead with straight arms. It works the front of the shoulders, while your core and legs keep you steady.

name: Weighted Stretch Lunge
instructions: Stand in a long split stance: one foot far in front with the knee bent, the back leg nearly straight with the heel up.
Hold a weight plate by its top edge with both hands, palms facing you, arms straight so it hangs in front of your hips.
Keep your upper body upright and bend both knees to sink your hips straight down until your back knee is just above the floor.
Push back up until your back leg is nearly straight, keeping your feet in place. Do all your reps on one side, then switch legs.
description: A lunge where your feet stay planted in a long split stance and you sink low holding a plate. It works the glutes and quads and stretches the front of the back hip.

name: Weighted Cossack Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly. Hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping your other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while keeping your balance and your chest up.
Push through the heel of your bent leg to return to the middle, then go to the other side. Keep alternating sides.
description: A wide-stance squat that drops onto one leg at a time while the other stays straight, holding a plate at your chest. It works the glutes, quads and hamstrings.

name: Weighted Lunge with Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your hips.
Step forward with your right foot and lower into a lunge.
Swing the plate forward and up overhead as you lunge, keeping your arms straight.
Push off your right foot to step back to standing, swinging the plate back down.
Do the next rep with your left leg. Keep alternating legs.
description: A forward lunge where you swing a weight plate overhead with straight arms as you step. It works the glutes, with help from the quads, hamstrings and calves, and tests your balance and coordination.

name: Single Leg Bridge with Outstretched Leg
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Straighten one leg out in front of you, in line with your other thigh.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body makes a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor. Do all your reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A glute bridge on one leg, with the other leg held straight in line with your thigh. It works the glutes, with help from the hamstrings and quads.

name: Walking High Knees Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee toward your chest as high as you can, balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and lower into a lunge, both knees bent to 90 degrees.
Push off your right foot and lift your left knee toward your chest, then step forward into a lunge on that side.
Keep alternating legs as you move forward at a steady pace.
description: Lunges that move forward, with a high knee lift before each step. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves.

name: Short Stride Run (Time)
instructions: Find an open space and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start running with short, quick steps.
Keep your feet close to the ground and don't reach too far forward with each step.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Running with short, quick steps instead of long strides. It raises your heart rate, works the quads, hamstrings and calves, and can help you run more smoothly.

name: Pike to Cobra Pushup
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows, keeping them close to your body, and lower your chest toward the floor as you shift your weight forward.
Straighten your arms and lift your chest up, letting your hips drop low so your back arches.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest again, then push back up into the upside-down V.
Lower your hips back down to the pushup position.
description: A flowing pushup: start in an upside-down V, swoop your chest down close to the floor, then rise into an arch with your chest lifted. It works the chest, with help from the shoulders, triceps and abs.

name: Reverse Tabletop Leg Lift
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Place your hands flat on the floor behind you, under your shoulders.
Lift your hips until your body is flat from shoulders to knees, like a tabletop, with your arms straight.
Straighten one leg and kick it up toward the ceiling, keeping your hips up.
Lower that foot back to the floor, then lift the other leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A face-up tabletop hold on your hands and feet, knees bent and hips level, where you kick one straight leg up at a time. It works the abs, glutes and hamstrings, with the shoulders holding you up.

name: Dumbbell Side Plank with Rear Fly
instructions: Start in a high plank on straight arms with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand just off the floor under your chest, palm facing your other hand.
Keep your hips up and roll into a side plank on your other arm, lifting the dumbbell with a straight arm toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell slowly as you turn back into the plank. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A plank that turns into a side plank as you lift a dumbbell toward the ceiling with a straight arm. It works the upper back and shoulders while your core holds you steady.

name: Plank with Opposite Arm and Leg Raise
instructions: Start in a high plank: hands on the floor under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a line from head to heels.
Lift one arm straight out in front of you to about head height, then put the hand back down.
Lift the opposite leg straight back to about hip height, then lower it. Keep your hips level.
Repeat with the other arm, then its opposite leg. Keep alternating sides.
description: A high plank where you lift one arm forward, then the opposite leg back, switching sides as you go. It works the abs, with the shoulders and glutes helping hold you steady.

name: Walking on Incline Treadmill (Time)
instructions: Set the treadmill incline to suit how hard you want to work.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, keeping your back straight.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Uphill walking on a treadmill, with the incline raised to make it harder. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Side Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side, propped up on your straight bottom arm. Bend your top knee and set that foot flat on the floor in front of your bottom leg.
Put your top hand on the floor in front of your chest and keep your bottom leg straight.
Lift your bottom leg off the floor as high as you can.
Lower it slowly until it almost touches the floor. Do all your reps on one side, then switch.
description: A side-lying leg lift where your top foot is planted in front and you raise your straight bottom leg off the floor. It works the inner thighs.

name: Standing Archer
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your back straight and raise both arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your left arm straight and pull your right arm back like drawing a bow, turning your upper body as you go.
Lower your arms to your sides, then repeat, pulling your left arm back. Keep alternating sides.
description: A no-weight standing move where you pull one arm back as if drawing a bow while turning your upper body. It works the upper back, with the shoulders and arms helping.

name: Weighted Decline Situp
instructions: Lie back on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the foot pads and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate flat above your chest with straight arms, gripping its edges with your palms facing each other.
Keep your arms straight and pointing at the ceiling as you sit up until your upper body is upright.
Lower slowly until your back is on the bench again.
description: A decline bench situp holding a weight plate straight up above you the whole time. It works the abs, with help from the front of the hips.

name: Ski Step
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips. Put one foot about a step ahead of the other, knees slightly bent and back heel up.
Bring your feet together under your hips.
Keep moving them past each other so the back foot ends up in front and the front foot behind.
Switch back the same way, staying light on your feet. Keep alternating sides.
description: A cardio drill where you stand with your hands on your hips and switch your feet forward and back past each other, like skis. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves.

name: Situp with Arms on Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Sit all the way up, lifting your upper body off the floor toward your knees.
Lower your upper body slowly back to the floor.
description: A full situp with your arms crossed over your chest. It works the abs, with help from the muscles at the front of your hips.

name: Shoulder Tap
instructions: Start in a pushup position with your arms straight, hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Lift your right hand and tap your left shoulder.
Put your right hand back down, then tap your right shoulder with your left hand.
Keep alternating sides, keeping your hips and upper body still.
description: A pushup-position hold where you lift one hand at a time to tap the opposite shoulder. It works the abs, with the shoulders and triceps helping.

name: Seated Good Morning
instructions: Sit on a cable row bench facing the low pulley, feet on the foot plates, knees bent. Hold the handle in both hands, palms facing each other, arms straight.
Keep your arms straight and your back flat as you fold forward from your hips until your chest is close to your thighs.
Pull your upper body back up from the hips until you're sitting tall, leaning slightly back.
description: A forward bend done sitting at a low cable: holding the handle with straight arms, you fold forward from the hips and sit back up. It works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: Curtsey Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together.
Step your right foot back and across, behind your left leg.
Bend both knees to lower your body, as if curtsying. Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the start, then step your left foot back behind your right leg.
description: A squat where one leg steps back and across behind the other, like a curtsy. It works the glutes, with help from the quads and hamstrings.

name: Hands Elevated Box Pushup
instructions: Put your hands on the edge of a sturdy box, a bit wider than your shoulders. Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge of the box, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
description: A pushup with your hands up on a box and your feet on the floor, which makes it easier than a floor pushup. It works the chest, mainly the lower part, plus the triceps and shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, chest up and back straight. Lower the dumbbell toward the floor, close to your body.
Straighten your hips, knees and ankles fast, driving the dumbbell straight up close to your body.
Turn your hand as the dumbbell passes your shoulder and punch it overhead, catching it with your arm straight and your knees and hips slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell back down under control. Do all your reps on one arm, then switch.
description: An explosive move that lifts one dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion, driven by your hips and legs. It works the glutes, hamstrings and quads, plus the shoulders and abs.

name: Run (Distance)
instructions: Warm up with a short walk or an easy jog.
Run at a comfortable pace, landing on the middle of your foot.
Keep your arms bent at 90 degrees and let them swing naturally with each stride.
Stay upright with your head up and your shoulders relaxed.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: A run at your own pace, outdoors or on a track, tracked by distance. It builds endurance and works your heart, lungs and leg muscles.

name: Treadmill Run (Distance)
instructions: Stand with a foot on each side rail, straddling the belt. Clip the safety cord to your clothes if the treadmill has one.
Start the belt at a slow walk to warm up, then raise the speed gradually to your running pace.
Run tall, with your arms swinging naturally at your sides.
Land on the middle of your foot and push off with your toes.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Running on a treadmill, with the pace and incline under your control and no weather to deal with. It trains your heart and lungs.

name: Short Stride Run (Distance)
instructions: Find an open space and stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start running with short, quick steps.
Keep your feet close to the ground and don't reach too far forward with each step.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Running with short, quick steps instead of long strides. It raises your heart rate, works the quads, hamstrings and calves, and can help you run more smoothly.

name: Walking on Incline Treadmill (Distance)
instructions: Set the treadmill incline to suit how hard you want to work.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, keeping your back straight.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Uphill walking on a treadmill, with the incline raised to make it harder. It raises your heart rate and works the quads, hamstrings and calves.

name: Bear Crawl (Distance)
instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the floor, keeping your back flat.
Move your right hand and left foot forward together, then your left hand and right foot.
Keep crawling forward at a steady pace, alternating sides.
Keep going for the set distance.
