description: Crawling forward on your hands and feet with your knees just off the floor. It raises your heart rate and works the abs, shoulders and triceps.

name: Farmers Walk (Distance)
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps, staying upright.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: A carry where you walk holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. It works the quads, calves, forearms and grip, and your abs work to keep you upright.

name: Stairmaster (Distance)
instructions: Set the stair machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the stairs and rest your hands on the handrails for support.
Climb one step at a time, stepping up with one foot and then the other.
Stay upright and keep your abs tight.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Cardio on a stair-climbing machine, stepping up moving stairs while you hold the handrails, with distance usually counted in floors. It works your heart and lungs, plus your legs.

name: Elliptical (Distance)
instructions: Set the elliptical's resistance and incline to the level you want.
Step onto the pedals and hold the moving handles lightly.
Push down with your feet and pull the handles toward you. Keep pushing and pulling in turn, in a walking or running motion.
Keep a steady pace and your abs tight.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Cardio on an elliptical machine that is easy on the joints, your legs moving in a walking or running motion while your arms push and pull the handles. It works your heart and lungs, plus your legs and glutes.

name: Ski Ergometer (Distance)
instructions: Stand facing the ski machine and hold a handle in each hand, arms reaching up overhead.
Pull the handles down hard while bending forward at your hips.
Let your arms swing back as you finish the pull.
Stand back up and reach overhead again, keeping a steady rhythm.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Cardio on a ski machine, pulling two handles down from overhead as you bend at the hips, like poling in cross-country skiing. It works your heart and lungs, plus the shoulders, forearms and abs.

name: Mountain Climber (Time)
instructions: Start at the top of a pushup, hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Bring your right knee toward your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee in.
Keep switching legs in a running motion at a steady pace, keeping your hips low.
Keep going for the set time.
description: A running motion done from the top of a pushup, driving your knees toward your chest one at a time. It raises your heart rate and works the abs, shoulders and triceps.

name: Burpee (Time)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Kick your feet back into a plank, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Jump your feet back in toward your hands, then jump straight up, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep. Keep going for the set time.
description: A full-body move that links a squat, a plank and a jump, done for time. It gets your heart rate up and builds stamina.

name: Dumbbell Burpee (Time)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Squat down and set the dumbbells on the floor just in front of your feet, keeping hold of the handles.
Jump your feet back so you're in a pushup position with your hands on the dumbbells and your body straight.
Jump your feet back in toward your hands, then stand up, lifting the dumbbells at your sides.
Jump straight up with the dumbbells at your sides, land softly and go straight into the next rep. Keep going for the set time.
description: A burpee done holding a pair of dumbbells: squat, jump back to a pushup position on the dumbbells, jump in, stand and jump. It works the whole body and gets your heart rate up.

name: Jump Rope (Time)
instructions: Hold a handle in each hand, palms facing in. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and hop over it with both feet as it comes down.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and jump again as the rope comes back around.
Keep going for the set time.
description: Jumping over a rope you swing around your body, bouncing on both feet. It raises your heart rate, builds stamina and works the calves, with help from the quads, hamstrings and glutes.

name: Hands Bike (Distance)
instructions: Set the seat height and handles so you can reach the handles comfortably.
Sit tall with your feet on the footplate. Hold a handle in each hand with your elbows bent at about a right angle.
Turn the handles in circles with your hands, pushing and pulling at a smooth, steady pace.
Keep going for the set distance.
description: Cardio on an arm bike: you sit and turn the handles in circles with your hands instead of your feet. It works your heart and lungs, plus the chest, shoulders and triceps.
